autonomy.sentence: Parents give the child autonomy to make her favorite juice.
autonomy.sentenceTrans: 父母给了这个孩子自主权去做她喜欢的果汁。
autonomy.mnemonic: auto自己 + nomy系统，统治 → 自己统治 → autonomy自治

autumn.definitionEn: the season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes colder
autumn.sentence: In autumn, leaves turn orange and yellow before falling to the ground.
autumn.sentenceTrans: 在秋天，树叶会变黄然后落地。

availability.definitionEn: the fact that something is possible to get, buy or find
availability.sentence: Even in the desert my wireless service's availability is 100%!
availability.sentenceTrans: 即使在沙漠里，我的无线服务都是百分之百可以使用的！
availability.mnemonic: avail效用 + ability可……性 → 可效性

available.definition: 可获得的，可用的；有空的
available.definitionEn: that you can get, buy or find; (of a person) free to see or talk to people
available.sentence: The receptionist told me that there was only one room available.
available.sentenceTrans: 前台接待员告诉我只有一个房间可以入住。
available.mnemonic: avail利用 + able能……的 → 能够利用的；可得到的

avenue.definition: 林荫道，道路；大街；方式，手段
avenue.definitionEn: a wide straight road with trees on both sides, especially one leading to a big house
avenue.sentence: The avenue is lined with lush green trees.
avenue.mnemonic: a向 + ven来，走 + ue → 让人可以走来走去 → avenue大路，道路

average.definition: 平均数；  v.平均为；  adj.平均的；平庸的，普通的
average.definitionEn: the result of adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
average.sentence: His height equals the average of his parents' heights.
average.sentenceTrans: 他的身高等于他父母身高的平均数。

aviation.definitionEn: the designing, building and flying of aircraft
aviation.sentence: Aviation is one of my biggest interests—I love airplanes.
aviation.sentenceTrans: 航空是我最大的爱好之一 ——我喜欢飞机。
aviation.mnemonic: avi鸟 + ation表示行为、状态 → 像鸟一样在空中 → aviation航空

avoid.definitionEn: to prevent something bad from happening; to keep away from somebody/something; to try not to do something
avoid.sentence: The driver avoided hitting the dogs on the road.
avoid.sentenceTrans: 司机避免了撞到路上的狗。
avoid.mnemonic: a=out处于 ＋ void空 → 空出来 → avoid避开，避免

awake.definition: 醒着的；  v.（使）醒来；唤起，被唤起
awake.definitionEn: not asleep (especially immediately before or after sleeping)
awake.sentence: It's already 3:22 a.m., but she is still awake.
awake.sentenceTrans: 现在已经是凌晨3点22分了，但她还醒着。
awake.mnemonic: a加强意义 + wake醒着 → awake唤醒，使醒

award.definition: 奖品；奖学金；  v.授予；奖励
award.definitionEn: (often in names of particular awards) a prize such as money, etc. for something that somebody has done
award.sentence: The actress got an award for her movie.
award.sentenceTrans: 这个女演员凭其电影赢得了这个奖项。

aware.definitionEn: knowing or realizing something; noticing that something is present, or that something is happening
aware.sentence: The teacher is aware that the student is cheating in the exam.
aware.sentenceTrans: 老师察觉到那个学生在考试中作弊。
aware.mnemonic: a使 + ware注视 → aware意识到的

awareness.definitionEn: knowing something; knowing that something exists and is important; being interested in something
awareness.sentence: He tries to raise people's awareness of the importance of recycling.
awareness.sentenceTrans: 他试图增强人们对回收利用的重要性的意识。
awareness.mnemonic: aware知道 ＋ ness表名词 → awareness意识，知觉

away.definitionEn: to a different place or in a different direction
away.mnemonic: a来自，朝向 + way道路 → 从某个方向来 → away离开，远离

awful.definition: 糟糕的，讨厌的；极大的，极多的
awful.definitionEn: dislike a person or thing or think that they are not very good
awful.sentenceTrans: 这只企鹅的英语水平很糟糕。
awful.mnemonic: aw=awe敬畏 + ful形容词后缀 → 使人畏惧的 → awful糟糕的，可怕的

awkward.sentence: It was awkward when he farted in the library.
awkward.sentenceTrans: 他在图书馆放了个屁，真是尴尬。
awkward.mnemonic: awk错误方向 + ward朝向 → 转错方向 → awkward尴尬的

baby.definitionEn: a very young child or animal
baby.sentence: What a cute hat for a baby!

bachelor.definitionEn: a man who has never been married
bachelor.sentence: After four years of hard work, I finally got my bachelor's degree!
bachelor.sentenceTrans: 经过四年的努力学习，我终于拿到了我的学士学位！

back.definition: 背部，背影；  adv.回原处；向后；  adj.后面的；  v.支持；资助
back.definitionEn: the part of the human body that is on the opposite side to the chest, between the neck and the tops of the legs; the part of an animal’s body that corresponds to this
back.sentence: His back hurt so much that he couldn't stand up straight.

background.definitionEn: the part of a picture, photograph or view behind the main objects, people, etc.; a colour or design on which something is painted, drawn, etc.
background.sentence: They come from different cultural backgrounds.
background.sentenceTrans: 他们来自不同的文化背景。
background.mnemonic: back背后 + ground场地 → background背景，后台

backward.definition: 向后地；  adj.落后的；向后的，倒行的
backward.definitionEn: towards a place or position that is behind
backward.sentence: He leaned backward to stretch his back after sitting for hours.
backward.sentenceTrans: 坐了几个小时后，他向后仰伸展了下背部。
backward.mnemonic: back后边 + ward向 → backward 向后的

backwards.definitionEn: towards a place or position that is behind
backwards.sentence: When we both bend backwards, we almost make a complete circle.
backwards.sentenceTrans: 当我们都向后仰的时候，我们几乎组成了一个完整的圆。
backwards.mnemonic: back后 + wards表副词，向… → backwards向后

bacteria.definitionEn: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered plants
bacteria.sentence: You can't see bacteria without a microscope.
bacteria.sentenceTrans: 没有显微镜你看不到细菌。
bacteria.mnemonic: bact细菌的 + er表示物 + ia总称 → bacteria细菌（都是球状或者棍状的）

bad.definition: 糟糕的；坏的，恶的，错的；  adv.非常，不好地
bad.definitionEn: unpleasant; full of problems; of poor quality; below an acceptable standard
bad.sentence: The bad weather has seriously affected people's daily lives.
bad.sentenceTrans: 糟糕的天气严重影响了人们的日常生活。

badly.definitionEn: used to emphasize how serious a situation or an event is
badly.mnemonic: bad坏的 + ly副词后缀 → badly恶劣地

bag.definitionEn: (often in compounds) a container made of paper or plastic, that opens at the top, used especially in shops/stores; a strong container made from cloth, plastic, leather, etc., usually with one or two handles, used to carry things in when shopping or travelling
bag.sentence: This white bag is so big! You can put so much in it.
bag.sentenceTrans: 这个白色的包真大！你可以放很多东西进去。

baggage.definitionEn: bags, cases, etc. that contain somebody’s clothes and things when they are travelling
baggage.sentence: The young man is waiting for his baggage.
baggage.sentenceTrans: 这个年轻人正在等他的行李。
baggage.mnemonic: bagg=bag包 + age表示集合名词、总称 → baggage行李

bake.definitionEn: to cook food in an oven without extra fat or liquid; to be cooked in this way
bake.sentence: I've put some sesame crackers in the oven to bake.
bake.sentenceTrans: 我已经把几片芝麻脆饼放进烤箱里烤了。

balance.definition: 平衡，平衡能力；天平；余额；  v.平衡；抵消
balance.definitionEn: the ability to keep steady with an equal amount of weight on each side of the body
balance.sentence: Look! He can keep balance on that rope.
balance.sentenceTrans: 看！他能在那根绳索上保持平衡。
balance.mnemonic: ba=bi两个的 + lance天平刻度，盘子 → 天平的两端保持一致 → balance平衡

bald.definitionEn: having little or no hair on the head; without any of the usual hair, marks, etc. covering the skin or surface of something
bald.sentence: Wait, why am I combing my hair?-I'm bald, I don't have any hair.
bald.sentenceTrans: 等等，我为什么要梳头？我是秃头，我根本没有头发。

ball.definitionEn: a round object used for throwing, hitting or kicking in games and sports
ball.sentence: Kick the ball into the net!

balloon.definitionEn: a small bag made of very thin rubber that becomes larger and rounder when you fill it with air or gas. Balloons are brightly coloured and used as decorations or toys.
balloon.sentence: We bought many colorful balloons for the party.
balloon.sentenceTrans: 我们为聚会买了许多五颜六色的气球。
balloon.mnemonic: ball球 + oon表名词 → balloon气球

ban.definition: 明令禁止；  n.禁止，禁令
ban.definitionEn: to order somebody not to do something, go somewhere, etc., especially officially
ban.sentence: Smoking is banned in public places.

banana.definitionEn: a long curved fruit with a thick yellow skin and soft flesh, that grows on trees in hot countries
banana.sentenceTrans: 香蕉是我最喜欢的水果。

band.definitionEn: a small group of musicians who play popular music together, often with a singer or singers
band.sentence: The band's live performance fascinated their fans.
band.sentenceTrans: 这个乐队的现场表演让他们的粉丝为之疯狂。

bang.sentence: He gave the door a loud bang.
bang.sentenceTrans: 他给了门一声响亮的重击。

bank.definition: 银行；岸；  v.把钱存入银行
bank.definitionEn: an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money
bank.sentence: Is the bank a safe place to keep my money?
bank.sentenceTrans: 银行是保管钱的安全之所吗？

bankrupt.definition: 破产的；  n.破产者；  v.使破产
bankrupt.definitionEn: without enough money to pay what you owe; completely lacking in anything that has value
bankrupt.sentence: With no more money, I'm completely bankrupt.
bankrupt.mnemonic: bank柜台 + rupt断裂 → 柜台断了 → 破产了 → bankrupt破产的

bankruptcy.sentence: A number of different debts drove the company into bankruptcy.
bankruptcy.sentenceTrans: 许多不同的债务迫使这家公司破产了。
bankruptcy.mnemonic: bank柜台 + rupt断裂 + cy名词后缀 → 破产

banquet.definitionEn: a formal meal for a large number of people, usually for a special occasion, at which speeches are often made

bar.definitionEn: a place where you can buy and drink alcoholic and other drinks
bar.sentence: This old man used a huge bar as a weapon.
bar.sentenceTrans: 三代火影用巨大金箍棒作为武器。

barbecue.definition: 烧烤；户外烧烤；烤肉；烧烤架；  v.烧烤
barbecue.definitionEn: to cook (food) on a barbecue; to broil or roast (meat, fish, etc.) over hot coals or an open fire
barbecue.sentence: They are having a barbecue together.
barbecue.sentenceTrans: 他们正在一起烧烤野餐。

barber.definitionEn: a person whose job is to cut men’s hair and sometimes to shave them; a shop where men can have their hair cut
barber.sentence: I asked my barber to give me a new style this time.
barber.sentenceTrans: 这一次我让我的理发师给我理一个新发型。
barber.mnemonic: barb胡子 + er人 → 修理胡子的人 → barber理发师

bare.definition: 赤裸的；光秃秃的；贫瘠的；勉强够的；  v.使裸露，暴露
bare.definitionEn: not covered by any clothes; (of trees or countryside) not covered with leaves; without plants or trees; (of surfaces) not covered with or protected by anything; (of a room, cupboard, etc.) empty
bare.sentence: He is running around in bare feet.

barely.definitionEn: in a way that almost does not happen or exist
barely.sentenceTrans: 他差一点就赶不上火车了。

bargain.definition: 讨价还价；经讨价还价成交；  n.交易；便宜货；契约
bargain.definitionEn: to discuss prices, conditions, etc. with somebody in order to reach an agreement that is acceptable
bargain.sentence: The lady is trying to bargain with the seller.
bargain.sentenceTrans: 这位女士试图和卖方砍价。

barrier.definitionEn: something that exists between one thing or person and another and keeps them separate
barrier.sentence: There is a barrier on the road so we can't go this way.
barrier.sentenceTrans: 路上有障碍物，所以我们不能走这条路。
barrier.mnemonic: barr棒，阻拦 + ier名词后缀，表示物 → barrier栅栏

base.definition: 根基；基础；底部；  v.以……作基础
base.definitionEn: the bottom or lowest part of something; the part on which something rests or stands
base.sentence: A firm base is very important for building a house.
base.sentenceTrans: 稳固的根基对于建造房屋十分重要。

basic.definitionEn: a simple language used for programming computers
basic.sentence: The brand's bags came in both basic and limited editions.
basic.sentenceTrans: 这一品牌的包既有基础款也有限量款。
basic.mnemonic: bas=basis基础 + ic形容词，...的 → basic基本的

basically.definitionEn: used when you are giving your opinion or stating what is important about a situation
basically.sentence: Basically, all the students are depressed during a hard English examination.
basically.sentenceTrans: 在这场困难的英语考试中，基本上所有学生都很郁闷。
basically.mnemonic: basic基础的 + ally……地 → basically基本上

basin.definitionEn: a round container that is wide but not very deep, used for holding liquids
basin.sentence: The basin in our bathroom is very clean.
basin.sentenceTrans: 我们浴室的水池很干净。

basis.definitionEn: the important facts, ideas or events that support something and that it can develop from
basis.sentence: The English alphabet is the basis of written English.
basis.sentenceTrans: 英文字母表是书面英语的基础。

basket.definitionEn: a container for holding or carrying things. Baskets are made of thin strips of material that bends and twists easily, for example plastic, wire or wicker.
basket.sentence: The shared bike has a practical basket for carrying belongings.
basket.sentenceTrans: 共享单车配备了实用的车筐，方便携带物品。

basketball.definitionEn: the ball used in this game of basketball
basketball.sentence: Girls love to play basketball too, and they can play it very well.
basketball.sentenceTrans: 女生们也喜欢打篮球，而且她们打得不错。

bat.definition: 蝙蝠；球棒，球拍；  v.用球板击球
bat.definitionEn: an animal like a mouse with wings, that flies and feeds at night (= it is nocturnal). There are many types of bat.
bat.sentence: Bats hang themselves upside down when they sleep.
bat.sentenceTrans: 蝙蝠睡觉的时候会将身体倒挂起来。

bath.definitionEn: an act of washing your whole body by sitting or lying in water; a large, long container that you put water in and then get into to wash your whole body
bath.sentence: I took a long bath to relax myself.
bath.sentenceTrans: 我泡了很长时间的澡来放松自己。

bathe.definitionEn: to wash something with water, especially a part of your body
bathe.sentence: The dog, cat, and duck love to bathe together.
bathe.sentenceTrans: 狗、猫和鸭子喜欢在一起洗澡。

bathroom.definitionEn: a room with a sink and toilet and usually a bathtub or shower
bathroom.sentence: This bathroom contains a washbasin, a toilet and a shower.
bathroom.sentenceTrans: 这个浴室有一个洗脸盆，一个马桶和一个淋浴器。
bathroom.mnemonic: bath洗澡 + room房间 → bathroom 浴室

battery.definitionEn: a device that is placed inside a car engine, clock, radio, etc. and that produces the electricity that makes it work
battery.sentence: My phone is out of battery. It'll shut off soon.
battery.sentenceTrans: 我的手机没电了，很快就会关机。

battle.definitionEn: a fight between armies, ships or planes, especially during a war; a violent fight between groups of people
battle.sentence: The knight killed many enemies bravely in the battle.
battle.sentenceTrans: 骑士在战役中英勇地杀了很多敌人。
battle.mnemonic: batt打，走 + le表名词 → battle战斗

bay.definitionEn: a part of the sea, or of a large lake, partly surrounded by a wide curve of the land
bay.sentence: The bay cuts into the land and makes a perfect place to go swimming.
bay.sentenceTrans: 嵌入陆地的海湾正是绝佳的游泳场所。

be.definitionEn: have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)

beach.definitionEn: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), beside the sea or a lake
beach.sentence: We spent a wonderful day at the beach.
beach.sentenceTrans: 我们在海滩上度过了美妙的一天。

bear.definition: 熊；  v.带有；忍受；承受，支撑（重量）；生育
bear.definitionEn: a heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws (= pointed parts on the ends of its feet). There are many types of bear.
bear.sentence: Look! The bear is eating honey.

beast.definitionEn: an animal, especially one that is large or dangerous, or one that is unusual
beast.sentence: Lions, tigers, wolves and leopards are all dangerous wild beasts.
beast.sentenceTrans: 狮子、老虎、狼和豹子都是危险的野兽。

beat.definition: 敲打；打败，击败；有节奏地跳动；搅拌，搅打（用叉等）快速搅拌；  n.敲打；节拍
beat.sentence: He is beating the drum hard with two sticks.
beat.sentenceTrans: 他正用两根鼓槌使劲击鼓。

beautiful.definitionEn: having beauty; pleasing to the senses or to the mind
beautiful.sentence: She looks beautiful in her new black shirt.
beautiful.sentenceTrans: 她穿着新买的黑色衬衫，真好看。
beautiful.mnemonic: beauti美丽 + ful……的 → beautiful美的，美丽的

beauty.definitionEn: a person or thing that is beautiful
beauty.sentence: She is such a beauty that many people take pictures of her.
beauty.sentenceTrans: 她是个大美人，许多人为她拍照。

because.sentence: The tooth is in pain because its master ate lots of sugar.
because.sentenceTrans: 这颗牙齿很痛苦，因为它的主人吃了太多甜食。

become.sentence: The bud became a beautiful rose.
become.sentenceTrans: 花蕾变成了美丽的玫瑰。
become.mnemonic: be成为，变得 + come到达，出现 → become变成

bed.definitionEn: a piece of furniture for sleeping on

bedroom.sentence: There is a double bed and a dresser in the bedroom.
bedroom.sentenceTrans: 卧室里有一张双人床和一个梳妆台。

bee.definitionEn: a black and yellow flying insect that can sting and that is often kept in hives for the honey that it produces
bee.sentence: There's a bee on the yellow flower.
bee.sentenceTrans: 这朵黄花上有一只蜜蜂。

beef.definitionEn: meat that comes from a cow
beef.sentence: This is a pack of beef steaks.

beer.definitionEn: an alcoholic drink made from malt and flavoured with hops. There are many types of beer.; a glass, bottle or can of beer
beer.sentence: Drinking too much beer can make a person fat.
beer.sentenceTrans: 喝太多啤酒能让一个人变胖。

before.definitionEn: used to say that somebody/something is in a position in front of somebody/something
before.mnemonic: be在 + fore在前的 → before在…以前

beforehand.sentence: Dinner is ready when she arrives at the restaurant, because she ordered beforehand by phone.
beforehand.sentenceTrans: 她到餐厅时，晚餐已经准备好了，因为她预先用手机点了菜。

beg.definitionEn: to ask (someone) in a very serious and emotional way for something needed or wanted very much; to ask somebody for money, food, etc., especially in the street
beg.sentence: The little dog is begging his master for food.
beg.sentenceTrans: 这只小狗正在向主人乞求食物。

begin.definitionEn: to start doing something; to do the first part of something
begin.sentence: The bell rings and class begins.

beginning.definitionEn: the point or time at which something begins; a starting point
beginning.sentence: I won the race! I was ahead from the beginning.
beginning.sentenceTrans: 我赢得了跑步比赛！我从一开始就遥遥领先。
beginning.mnemonic: begin开始 + n + ing名词后缀 → beginning 开始

behalf.definition: 代表（某人），因为某人；利益；赞同，支持
behalf.definitionEn: as the representative of somebody or instead of them
behalf.sentence: "I'll destroy you on behalf of the moon!"

behave.definitionEn: to do things in a way that people think is correct or polite
behave.sentence: The dog behaved well while bathing.
behave.sentenceTrans: 这条狗在洗澡时表现得很好。
behave.mnemonic: be使 + have持有 → 一个人拥有的动作 → behave举止端正

behavior.definitionEn: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
behavior.sentence: Your behaviors are really childish! You are scientists!
behavior.sentenceTrans: 你俩的行为可真是幼稚！你们可是科学家！
behavior.mnemonic: be表示动作 + hav持有 + ior表名词 → 人持有的动作 → behavior举止行为

behaviour.definitionEn: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
behaviour.sentence: I will not tolerate this bad behaviour in my classroom!
behaviour.sentenceTrans: 我不能容忍在我的教室里有这种不良行为！

behind.definition: 在……后面；  adv.（时间或空间上）在后面
behind.definitionEn: at or towards the back of somebody/something, and often hidden by it or them
behind.sentence: He was one of the few rich criminals that was actually put behind bars.
behind.sentenceTrans: 他是为数不多真正入狱的富有罪犯之一。
behind.mnemonic: be构成介词 + hind藏在后面 → behind在......后面

being.definition: 存在；生物；生命；  v.存在，处于；是
being.sentence: The universe came into being as a result of a big bang.
being.sentenceTrans: 宇宙的出现是大爆炸的结果。
being.mnemonic: be存在，成为 + ing名词后缀 → being存在

belief.definitionEn: a strong feeling that something or somebody exists or is true
belief.sentence: Her personal belief gives her strength to face life's hardships.
belief.sentenceTrans: 她的个人信仰给了她面对人生苦难的力量。
belief.mnemonic: be关于 + lief关心，爱 → belief信仰

believe.definitionEn: to regard the existence of God as a fact; to have religious beliefs
believe.sentence: Some people believe that investment is a good way to make a fortune.
believe.sentenceTrans: 有些人相信投资是个发财致富的好方法。

bell.definitionEn: a hollow metal object, often shaped like a cup, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes
bell.sentence: The sound of the church bell echoed through the quiet village, marking the start of a new day.
bell.sentenceTrans: 教堂的钟声在宁静的村庄中回荡，宣告新一天的开始。

belong.definitionEn: to be in the right or suitable place
belong.mnemonic: be使 + long长 → 使长久拥有 → belong属于

beloved.sentence: He prepares a gift for his beloved wife.
beloved.sentenceTrans: 他为心爱的妻子准备了一份礼物。
beloved.mnemonic: be是 + loved被爱，所爱 → beloved 心爱的

below.definition: 在……之下；在…… 下方；（数量）少于；（标准）低于；  adv.在（或到）下面
below.definitionEn: at or to a lower level or position than somebody/something
below.sentence: Most of the iceberg is hidden below the water.
below.sentenceTrans: 大部分冰山都隐藏在水下。
below.mnemonic: be表强调 ＋ low在下面 → below在…下面

belt.definitionEn: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the waist
belt.sentence: Each belt represents a different taekwondo level.
belt.sentenceTrans: 在跆拳道中，每种腰带代表不同的级位。

bench.definitionEn: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood
bench.sentence: There are many benches along the street.

bend.definition: （使）弯曲，把...弄弯；  n.弯曲，弯曲处
bend.definitionEn: (especially of somebody’s body or head) to lean, or make something lean, in a particular direction; if you bend your arm, leg, etc. or if it bends, you move it so that it is no longer straight; to force something that was straight into an angle or a curve; to change direction to form a curve or an angle; to make something change direction in this way
bend.sentence: First bend to the right, and then to the left.
bend.sentenceTrans: 先向右弯曲，再向左弯曲。

beneath.definitionEn: in or to a lower position than somebody/something; under somebody/something
beneath.sentence: Most of the iceberg is beneath the sea surface.
beneath.sentenceTrans: 冰山的大部分在海面之下。
beneath.mnemonic: be是 + neath下面 → beneath在下面

beneficial.definitionEn: improving a situation; having a helpful or useful effect
beneficial.sentence: Eating nutritious food and exercising are beneficial to our health.
beneficial.sentenceTrans: 吃有营养的食物和锻炼身体对我们的健康有益。
beneficial.mnemonic: bene好 + fic做 + ial形容词，“有…的” → 有好处的 → beneficial有益的

benefit.definition: （政府）补助金，救济金；利益，好处；  v.得益于
benefit.definitionEn: an advantage that something gives you; a helpful and useful effect that something has
benefit.sentence: The government provides benefits to the unemployed.
benefit.sentenceTrans: 政府为失业者提供各种形式的补助。
benefit.mnemonic: bene善，好 + fit做 → 做事后的好处 → benefit利益，好处

beside.definitionEn: next to or at the side of somebody/something
beside.sentence: The loyal dog is lying beside its owner.
beside.sentenceTrans: 这只忠诚的狗正趴在主人旁边。
beside.mnemonic: be构成介词 + side旁边 → beside在……旁边

besides.definitionEn: in addition to somebody/something; apart from somebody/something
besides.sentence: There's a bride, and more women besides!
besides.sentenceTrans: 这里有一个新娘，此外，还有些女人！
besides.mnemonic: be构成介词 + side边 + s表副词 → besides此外，而且

best.definitionEn: of the most excellent type or quality; most enjoyable; happiest; most suitable or appropriate
best.sentence: The restaurant in the middle is the best of the three.
best.sentenceTrans: 中间那家餐厅是三家当中最好的。

bet.definition: 赌，赌注；  v.打赌；敢断定
bet.definitionEn: an arrangement to risk money, etc. on the result of a particular event; the money that you risk in this way
bet.sentence: The man made a bet on the score of a game.
bet.sentenceTrans: 这个人在比赛比分上赌了一把。

better.definition: （good的比较级）更好的；  adv.（well的比较级）更好地
better.definitionEn: of a higher standard or less poor quality; not as bad as something else
better.sentence: The boy gets better grades after studying hard.
better.sentenceTrans: 这个男孩在认真学习后，成绩越来越好。

between.definitionEn: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.
between.sentence: There is a pear between an apple and an orange.
between.sentenceTrans: 在苹果和橙子中间有一个梨。
between.mnemonic: be强调 + tween二 → between在...之间

beyond.definitionEn: on or to the further side of something; later than a particular time; more than something; used to say that something is not possible; too far or too advanced for somebody/something
beyond.sentence: I couldn't hit him as he was beyond my reach.
beyond.sentenceTrans: 我打不了他，因为我够不着他。
beyond.mnemonic: be强调 + yond那边 → 超过

bible.sentence: He's reading from the Bible in a church.

bicycle.definitionEn: a road vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet
bicycle.sentence: We are riding bicycles for a trip.
bicycle.sentenceTrans: 我们正在骑自行车旅行。
bicycle.mnemonic: bi两 + cycle轮转 → bicycle自行车

bid.definition: 出价；投标；吩咐；  n.出价；投标；努力争取
bid.definitionEn: an offer to pay a particular amount of money for something
bid.sentence: The two superheroes bid for the batman suit.
bid.sentenceTrans: 这两位超级英雄都在竞拍蝙蝠侠的衣服。

big.definitionEn: large in size, degree, amount, etc.
big.sentence: It's a big hamburger, but I can finish it!
big.sentenceTrans: 这个汉堡包很大，但是我能吃完！

bill.definition: 账单；纸币，钞票；议案，法案；  v.给……开账单
bill.definitionEn: a document that says how much money you owe for something you have bought or used
bill.sentence: The waiter said, “Here is your bill, sir.”
bill.sentenceTrans: 服务员说：”这是您的账单，先生。“

billion.sentence: The baby counted 9 zeros in the number 1 billion.
billion.sentenceTrans: 这个小孩从10亿这个数字里数出了9个零。

bind.definition: 捆绑；装订；约束；结合；  n.窘境，困境
bind.definitionEn: to tie somebody or something with rope, string, etc. so that they/it cannot move or are held together firmly; to fasten the pages of a book together and put them inside a cover; to force somebody to do something by making them promise to do it or by making it their duty to do it;  to stick together or to make things stick together in a solid mass
bind.sentence: The mummies help to bind each other with the bandage.
bind.sentenceTrans: 木乃伊互相帮着绑绷带。

biological.definition: 生物学的；生物的，生物学的
biological.definitionEn: of or relating to biology or to life and living things
biological.sentence: Biological science is concerned with research of animals, plants and micro-organisms.
biological.sentenceTrans: 生物科学涉及对动物、植物和微生物的研究。
biological.mnemonic: bio生物 ＋ logical...学的 → biological生物学（上）的

biology.definitionEn: the scientific study of the life and structure of plants and animals
biology.sentence: Biology is the study of life and living things.
biology.sentenceTrans: 生物学是研究生命和生物的学科。
biology.mnemonic: bio生物 + logy……学 → biology生物学

bird.definitionEn: a creature that is covered with feathers and has two wings and two legs
bird.sentence: These birds all have bright colors.
bird.sentenceTrans: 这些鸟的颜色都很鲜艳。

birth.definitionEn: the time when a baby comes out from the body of its mother
birth.sentence: With the doctor's help, the mother gave birth to a baby.
birth.sentenceTrans: 在医生的帮助下，这位母亲顺利产下一个婴儿。

birthday.definitionEn: the anniversary of the date on which you were born
birthday.sentence: Are you excited for the birthday party tomorrow?
birthday.sentenceTrans: 你对明天的生日派对感到兴奋吗？
birthday.mnemonic: birth出生 + day日子 → birthday生日

bit.definitionEn: a small amount or piece of something
bit.sentence: A mosquito bit me last night.

bite.definitionEn: to use your teeth to cut into or through something
bite.sentence: The patient complained of jaw pain when he tried to bite into a sandwich.
bite.sentenceTrans: 病人抱怨说，他在试着咬三明治时会下巴疼。

bitter.definition: 味苦的；带来痛苦的；激烈而不愉快的
bitter.definitionEn: having a strong and often unpleasant taste; not sweet

black.definitionEn: having the very darkest colour, like coal or the sky at night
black.sentence: Her shiny black hair is beautiful.

blackboard.definitionEn: a large board with a smooth black or dark green surface that teachers write on with a piece of chalk
blackboard.sentence: She is the student on duty today, so she needs to clean the blackboard.
blackboard.sentenceTrans: 她是今天的值日生，所以她要擦黑板。
blackboard.mnemonic: black黑色的 + board板子 → blackboard黑板

blame.definition: 指责；责备；  v.把……归咎于；责备
blame.definitionEn: responsibility for doing something badly or wrongly; saying that somebody is responsible for something
blame.sentence: I always get all the blame, but I never do anything wrong.
blame.sentenceTrans: 我总是受到所有的责备，但我从没有做错过任何事。

blank.definition: （纸等）空白的；  n.空白，空白处
blank.definitionEn: an empty space on a printed form or document for you to write answers, information, etc. in
blank.sentence: You can write something on a blank page of this notebook.
blank.sentenceTrans: 你可以在这个本子的空白页上写点东西。

blanket.definition: 毯子，毛毯；  adj.总括的；  v.使覆盖
blanket.definitionEn: a large cover, often made of wool, used especially on beds to keep people warm
blanket.sentence: The cute little kitten is sleeping in a soft blanket.
blanket.sentenceTrans: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在一条柔软的毯子里。
blanket.mnemonic: blank=blanc白 ＋ et表名词 → 白色织物 → blanket毛毯，毯子，羊毛毯

blast.definition: 爆炸；一阵（疾风等）；  v.爆破
blast.definitionEn: an explosion or a powerful movement of air caused by an explosion
blast.sentence: The building was destroyed in the blast after he turned around.
blast.sentenceTrans: 他转身后，这栋楼在爆炸中被摧毁了。

bleed.definitionEn: to lose blood, especially from a wound or an injury
bleed.sentence: The paw of the dog is bleeding.

blend.definitionEn: to mix two or more substances together
blend.sentence: Blend the flour and the water with a spoon.
blend.sentenceTrans: 用勺子把面粉和水混到一起。

blind.definition: 失明的；瞎的；  v.使失明；  n.百叶窗
blind.sentence: The blind woman is crossing the street with her guide dog.
blind.sentenceTrans: 这位失明的女士正和她的导盲犬一起过马路。

block.definition: 一块（指木头，石头等硬物）；街区；大楼，大厦；  v.阻塞，阻挡
block.definitionEn: to stop somebody from going somewhere or seeing something by standing in front of them or in their way
block.sentence: This block of stone has stood here for a long time.
block.sentenceTrans: 这块石头立在这里很久了。

blood.definitionEn: the red liquid that flows through the bodies of people and animals
blood.sentence: The doctor took some blood from me during my checkup.
blood.sentenceTrans: 医生在给我检查时抽了点儿血。
blood.mnemonic: blo茁壮成长，绽放 + od → 富有生命力的事物 → blood血液

bloom.sentence: These red flowers bloom in spring.
bloom.sentenceTrans: 这些红色的花在春天开放。

blouse.definitionEn: a piece of clothing like a shirt, worn by women
blouse.sentence: The off-shoulder blouse is on trend nowadays.
blouse.sentenceTrans: 这种露肩短上衣最近很流行。

blow.definition: 吹，吹动，吹气；打击，殴打；  n.打击，殴打
blow.definitionEn: to cause (air or something carried by air) to move
blow.sentence: The kid likes to blow bubbles.

blue.definition: 蓝色的；忧郁的；  n.蓝色
blue.definitionEn: having the colour of a clear sky or the sea/ocean on a clear day
blue.sentence: Look at the blue sky and sea. What a view!
blue.sentenceTrans: 看，蓝天大海一色，真是壮观！

board.definition: 板；栏；董事会；  v.上船（或火车、飞机、公共汽车等）
board.definitionEn: a flat piece of material (such as wood or cardboard) that is used for a special purpose

boat.definition: 小船，小舟，小艇；  v.划船；  v.用船运输
boat.definitionEn: a vehicle (smaller than a ship) that travels on water, moved by oars, sails or a motor
boat.sentence: The little wooden boat floats on the water.
boat.sentenceTrans: 这艘小木船浮在水面上。

body.definitionEn: the whole physical structure of a human or an animal
body.sentence: The human body is beautiful, amazing, yet delicate.
body.sentenceTrans: 人体非常美丽、神奇，却也非常脆弱。

boil.definition: 烧开，煮沸，沸腾；  n.煮沸，沸腾
boil.definitionEn: when a liquid boils or when you boil it, it is heated to the point where it forms bubbles and turns to steam or vapour
boil.sentence: The water is boiling in the cooking pot.

bold.definition: 大胆自信的，勇于冒险的；醒目的；大胆自信的；无耻的，放肆的
bold.definitionEn: (of people or behaviour) brave and confident; not afraid to say what you feel or to take risks
bold.sentence: She is a bold and fearless climber.
bold.sentenceTrans: 她是一个勇敢无畏的攀登者。

bomb.definitionEn: a device that is designed to explode in order to injure or kill people or to damage or destroy property
bomb.sentence: This bomb will explode any minute!
bomb.sentenceTrans: 这个炸弹随时都会爆炸！

bond.definition: 情谊，羁绊；束缚物，联结物；保释金；债券；  v.使牢固结合；团结一致
bond.definitionEn: something that forms a connection between people or groups, such as a feeling of friendship or shared ideas and experiences
bond.sentence: Family members often share a bond so deep that no conflict can truly break it.
bond.sentenceTrans: 家庭成员之间往往有着一种极为深厚的羁绊，没有矛盾能真正将其割断。

bone.definitionEn: any of the hard parts that form the skeleton of the body of a human or an animal
bone.sentence: A fracture is a break or crack in a bone, often caused by trauma or stress.
bone.sentenceTrans: 骨折是指骨头出现断裂或裂缝，通常是由外伤或压力引起的。

bonus.definition: 奖金，红利；红利；奖金，额外津贴
bonus.definitionEn: an extra amount of money that is added to a payment, especially to somebody’s wages or salary as a reward; anything pleasant that is extra and more or better than you were expecting
bonus.sentence: Employees received a year-end bonus for exceeding their sales targets.
bonus.sentenceTrans: 员工因超额完成销售目标而获得年终奖金。
bonus.mnemonic: bon好 + us用 → 用好的东西进行奖励 → 奖金，红利

book.definitionEn: a set of printed pages that are fastened inside a cover so that you can turn them and read them
book.sentence: I found three books in the library to read.
book.sentenceTrans: 我在图书馆里找了三本书来读。

boom.definition: 轰鸣声；繁荣；增长期，繁荣期；  v.迅速发展；  v.轰鸣
boom.sentence: The bomb went off with a loud boom.
boom.sentenceTrans: 炸弹随着轰隆的一声巨响爆炸了。

boost.definition: 使增长，使兴旺；促进，推动；  n.提高，增长
boost.definitionEn: to make something increase, or become better or more successful
boost.sentence: The turtle uses a rocket to boost his speed.
boost.sentenceTrans: 这个乌龟使用火箭来增加自己的速度。

boot.definitionEn: a covering usually of leather or rubber for the entire foot and the lower part of the leg
boot.sentence: When I camp in the mountains, I always wear hiking boots.
boot.sentenceTrans: 当我在山上露营时，我总是穿登山靴。

border.definition: 边界；边沿；  v.近似；毗邻；与……接壤；为……镶边
border.definitionEn: the line that divides two countries or areas; the land near this line
border.sentence: There is a distinct border between the urban and the rural areas.
border.sentenceTrans: 城市与农村之间有一条明显的边界。
border.mnemonic: bord边 + er表名词 → border边境

bore.definition: 使厌烦；挖掘，开凿；钻孔；bear的过去式；  n.孔
bore.definitionEn: to weary by being dull, uninteresting, or monotonous
bore.sentence: The man's endless talking has bored his colleagues to sleep.
bore.sentenceTrans: 这个男人冗长的讲话让同事们都厌烦得想睡觉了。

boring.definitionEn: not interesting; making you feel tired and impatient
boring.sentence: I've done my boring homework — now can I go outside and play?
boring.sentenceTrans: 我已经完成无聊的作业了，现在我可以出去玩了吗？
boring.mnemonic: bor无聊 + ing名词后缀，表状态 → boring令人厌烦的，乏味的

born.definitionEn: brought into life by the process of birth

borrow.definitionEn: to take and use (something that belongs to someone else) for a period of time before returning it
borrow.sentence: When subtracting numbers with different digits, remember to borrow from the left column if needed.
borrow.sentenceTrans: 在对位数不同的数相减时，如果需要，请记得从左边的一列借位。

boss.definitionEn: a person who has a lot of power in an organization
boss.sentence: I was nervous when my boss asked to speak with me.
boss.sentenceTrans: 当我的老板和我说话时我很紧张。

both.definitionEn: used with plural nouns to mean ‘the two’ or ‘the one as well as the other’; not only… but also…
both.sentence: They both are considering their next move.
both.sentenceTrans: 他们都在考虑下一步怎么走。

bother.definitionEn: to annoy, worry or upset somebody; to cause somebody trouble or pain
bother.sentence: He always plays the guitar at night, which really bothers me!
bother.sentenceTrans: 他总在晚上弹吉他，这真的打扰到我了！

bottle.definitionEn: a glass or plastic container, usually round with straight sides and a narrow neck, used especially for storing liquids
bottle.sentence: I hope someone will find my message in this bottle.
bottle.sentenceTrans: 我希望有人能发现瓶子里我的留言。

bottom.definitionEn: the ground below the water in a lake, river, swimming pool, etc.
bottom.sentence: The bottom of this object is red.
bottom.sentenceTrans: 这个物体的底部是红色的。

bound.definition: 必然的；有义务的；与…密切相关的；准备前往（某地）；  v.跳跃着前行；  n.跳跃
bound.definitionEn: certain or likely to happen, or to do or be something
bound.sentence: The prisoner is bound to face his execution.
bound.sentenceTrans: 这个犯人必然会面临死刑。

boundary.definitionEn: a real or imagined line that marks the limits or edges of something and separates it from other things or places; a dividing line
boundary.sentence: Many students will draw a line on the desk as a boundary.
boundary.sentenceTrans: 许多学生会在课桌上画一条线作为分界。
boundary.mnemonic: bound范围 + ary表抽象名词 → boundary分界线，边界

bowl.definition: 碗；一碗的容量；  v.滚动（球）；[体]投球
bowl.definitionEn: a deep round dish with a wide open top, used especially for holding food or liquid
bowl.sentence: The four bowls are in four different colors.
bowl.sentenceTrans: 这四个碗分别有四种不同的颜色。

bowling.definitionEn: a game played by rolling a large, heavy ball down a smooth floor (called a lane) towards a set of pins in order to knock down as many pins as possible
bowling.sentence: I am teaching my son how to play bowling.
bowling.sentenceTrans: 我正在教我儿子怎样打保龄球。
bowling.mnemonic: bowl球 + ing后缀 → bowling保龄球

box.definitionEn: (especially in compounds) a container made of wood, cardboard, metal, etc. with a flat stiff base and sides and often a lid, used especially for holding solid things
box.sentence: The box of books is really heavy.

boy.sentence: The little boy loves to read.
boy.sentenceTrans: 这个小男孩儿喜欢阅读。

brain.definitionEn: the organ inside the head that controls movement, thought, memory and feeling
brain.sentence: Your brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities.
brain.sentenceTrans: 大脑是在你的脑袋里控制身体活动的器官。

branch.definitionEn: a part of a tree that grows out from the main stem and on which leaves, flowers and fruit grow
branch.sentence: The man cut off a branch from the tree.
branch.sentenceTrans: 那个男人从树上剪下了一根树枝。

brand.definition: 品牌；烙印；  v.加污名于；给……打上烙印；加商标于；谴责
brand.definitionEn: a type of product made by a particular company
brand.sentence: The woman knows so many girls' beauty brands.
brand.sentenceTrans: 这个女人知道好多女孩子用的美妆品牌。

brave.definitionEn: (of a person) willing to do things which are difficult, dangerous or painful; not afraid; (of an action) requiring or showing courage
brave.sentence: A brave swimmer jumped into the river to save the drowning boy.
brave.sentenceTrans: 一位勇敢的游泳者跳进河里救了那个溺水的男孩。

bravery.definitionEn: the quality that allows someone to do things that are dangerous or frightening; the quality or state of being brave
bravery.sentence: Jumping between the two rocks requires a lot of bravery.
bravery.sentenceTrans: 在这两块石头间跳跃需要很大的勇气。
bravery.mnemonic: brave勇敢 + ry表名词 → bravery勇气，勇敢

bread.definitionEn: a type of food made from flour, water and usually yeast mixed together and baked
bread.sentence: There is nothing more delicious than freshly baked bread.
bread.sentenceTrans: 没有什么能比刚烤出来的面包更美味的了。

break.definition: 打破，摔碎；  n.中断；休息
break.definitionEn: to be damaged and separated into two or more parts, as a result of force
break.sentence: If you break a glass, be careful when picking up the pieces!
break.sentenceTrans: 如果你打碎了玻璃杯，捡碎片的时候要小心！

breakfast.definitionEn: the first meal of the day
breakfast.sentence: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
breakfast.sentenceTrans: 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。
breakfast.mnemonic: break中断 + fast斋戒 → 中断斋戒进食 → breakfast早饭

breast.definitionEn: either one of the two soft parts on a woman's chest that produce milk when she has a baby
breast.sentence: Women should pay attention to breast health.
breast.sentenceTrans: 女性应该注意乳房健康。

breath.definitionEn: an amount of air that you take into your lungs
breath.sentence: Take a deep breath and try to relax.

breathe.definitionEn: to move air into and out of your lungs: to inhale and exhale
breathe.sentence: She breathes deeply to relax herself when doing yoga.
breathe.sentenceTrans: 她做瑜伽时用深呼吸的方式来放松自己。

breed.definition: 饲养，培育；繁殖；  n.品种
breed.definitionEn: a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
breed.sentence: He makes a living by breeding cows.

brick.definitionEn: baked clay used for building walls, houses and other buildings; an individual block of this
brick.sentence: The wall is made up of plenty of bricks.
brick.sentenceTrans: 这面墙壁是用许多块砖头筑成的。

bride.definitionEn: a woman on her wedding day, or just before or just after it
bride.sentence: The bride looks like an angel in her white dress.
bride.sentenceTrans: 这个穿着白色婚纱的新娘看起来像个天使。

bridge.definitionEn: a structure that is built over a road, railway/railroad, river, etc. so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other
bridge.sentence: This is an old bridge across the river.
bridge.sentenceTrans: 河上的这座桥有些年头了。

brief.definition: 简洁的，简短的；  n.摘要；  v.简单汇报；向…通报情况
brief.definitionEn: lasting only a short time; short; using few words
brief.sentence: The brief letter explains why she wants to quit.
brief.sentenceTrans: 这封简短的信解释了她为何想辞职。

bright.definition: 明亮的，光线充足的；鲜艳的；聪明的
bright.sentence: Bright light makes him close his eyes.
bright.sentenceTrans: 强烈的亮光让他闭上了眼睛。

brilliant.definition: 聪颖的；卓越的；明亮的；极好的
brilliant.definitionEn: extremely clever or impressive; very intelligent or skillful
brilliant.sentence: This girl is so brilliant that she can solve the difficult problem.
brilliant.sentenceTrans: 这个小女孩很聪明，她能解决这道难题。
brilliant.mnemonic: brilli=brill光辉 + ant…的 → brilliant光辉的；卓越的

bring.definitionEn: to come to a place with someone or something
bring.sentence: Every morning he brings a package of things for my baby.
bring.sentenceTrans: 每天早晨他都带一包东西给我的宝宝。

broad.sentence: This road is broad enough for many cars to drive on.
broad.sentenceTrans: 这条道路足够宽，可以容纳很多车行驶。

broadcast.definition: 广播或电视节目；  v.播放，广播
broadcast.definitionEn: to tell a lot of people about something; to send out programmes on television or radio
broadcast.sentence: A broadcast is a program, a performance, or a speech on the radio or on television.
broadcast.sentenceTrans: 广播电视节目是指在收音机里或在电视上播放的节目、表演或演说。
broadcast.mnemonic: broad宽广 + cast投射 → 广播, 播音

broaden.definitionEn: to become wider; to affect or make something affect more people or things; to increase your experience, knowledge, etc.
broaden.sentence: This once narrow track has been broadened into a wider road.
broaden.sentenceTrans: 这条曾经的狭窄小道被拓宽成了一条宽阔的马路。

brochure.definition: 手册，小册子；资料(或广告)手册
brochure.definitionEn: a small magazine or book containing pictures and information about something or advertising something
brochure.sentence: She carefully studied the company's brochure.
brochure.sentenceTrans: 她认真地研究过这家公司的手册。
brochure.mnemonic: broch刺，缝 + ure表名词 → 手册

broom.definitionEn: a brush on the end of a long handle, used for sweeping floors
broom.sentence: Use the broom to clean the floor.

brother.definitionEn: a boy or man who has the same mother and father as another person
brother.sentence: The brother and sister play together.

brow.definitionEn: the arch of hair above each eye
brow.sentence: She is painting her eye brows.

brown.definition: 褐色的，棕色的；  n.褐色，棕色
brown.definitionEn: having the colour of earth or coffee
brown.sentence: Her hair is brown, whereas her friend's is black.
brown.sentenceTrans: 她的头发是棕色的，然而她朋友的头发是黑色的。

brush.definition: 画笔，笔刷；灌木丛；  v.刷
brush.definitionEn: an object made of short stiff hairs (called bristles ) or wires set in a block of wood or plastic, usually attached to a handle. Brushes are used for many different jobs, such as cleaning, painting, writing and tidying your hair.
brush.sentence: Brushes of different sizes may be applied in different situations.
brush.sentenceTrans: 不同尺寸的画笔可以用于不同的情况。

brutal.sentence: Sometimes players perform brutal actions at sport arena.
brutal.sentenceTrans: 有时候运动员在场上表现得十分凶狠。
brutal.mnemonic: brut=brute残暴的人 + al如……的 → brutal野兽般的；冷酷的

budget.definitionEn: the money that is available to a person or an organization and a plan of how it will be spent over a period of time
budget.sentence: The total amount on the shopping list is over my budget.
budget.sentenceTrans: 购物清单的总额超出了我的预算。

bug.definition: 臭虫，小虫子；【计】（程序中的）漏洞、故障；窃听器；  v.窃听
bug.definitionEn: a fault in a machine, especially in a computer system or program
bug.sentence: There are some bugs on the leaf.

build.definitionEn: to make (something) by putting together parts or materials
build.sentence: He has been entering speech contests to help build his confidence.
build.sentenceTrans: 他通过参加演讲比赛来建立自信。

building.definitionEn: a structure such as a house or school that has a roof and walls
building.sentence: These buildings stretch high into the sky.
building.mnemonic: build建造 + ing某种行为的产物 → building建筑物

bulletin.definitionEn: a short news report on the radio or television
bulletin.sentence: The students are reading some notices posted on the bulletin board.
bulletin.sentenceTrans: 学生正在读公告栏上张贴的一些通知。

bunch.definitionEn: a group of things of the same kind that are held or tied together or that grow together
bunch.sentence: A bunch of pomelo leaves is perfect to sweep away bad luck.
bunch.sentenceTrans: 一束柚子叶非常适合用来扫除晦气。

burden.definition: 负担；  v.使负重，装载；烦扰
burden.definitionEn: a duty, responsibility, etc. that causes worry, difficulty or hard work; a heavy load that is difficult to carry
burden.sentence: His working burden is too heavy, which makes him have to surrender.
burden.sentenceTrans: 他的工作负担太沉重了，让他不得不投降。

bureau.definitionEn: an office or organization that provides information on a particular subject; (in the US) a government department or part of a government department
bureau.sentence: The Federal Bureau of Investigation is a government agency in the United States investigating crimes.
bureau.sentenceTrans: 联邦调查局是美国调查犯罪的政府机构。

burn.definitionEn: to destroy, damage, injure or kill somebody/something by fire; to be destroyed, etc. by fire
burn.sentence: The candle will burn slowly until it melts completely.
burn.sentenceTrans: 蜡烛会慢慢燃烧，直到完全融化。

burst.definition: 爆炸；迸发；  n.爆炸；爆裂；迸发
burst.definitionEn: an occasion when something bursts; the hole left where something has burst
burst.sentence: The red balloon burst, and it scared the child.
burst.sentenceTrans: 这个红色的气球爆炸了，吓到了这个孩子。

bury.definitionEn: to place a dead body in a grave
bury.sentence: It's not much fun to be buried in the dirt like this!
bury.sentenceTrans: （HATA王子）像这样被埋在土里一点也不好玩儿。
bury.mnemonic: bur隐藏；保护 + y表发音 → bury隐藏；埋葬

bus.definition: 公共汽车，巴士；大客车；巴士
bus.definitionEn: a large road vehicle that carries passengers, especially one that travels along a fixed route and stops regularly to let people get on and off
bus.sentence: Let's take the bus to the next city.
bus.sentenceTrans: 让我们乘公交车去下一个城市吧。

bush.definitionEn: an area of wild land that has not been cleared, especially in Africa and Australia
bush.sentence: Look, there is a rabbit in the bush!
bush.sentenceTrans: 看，那丛灌木里有一只兔子！

business.definitionEn: the activity of making, buying, selling or supplying goods or services for money
business.sentence: We expanded our business around the globe.
business.sentenceTrans: 我们把生意扩展到了世界各地。
business.mnemonic: busi=busy忙碌的 + ness性质，表名词 → 对某事很关心、焦虑 → business事务；生意

busy.sentence: I have been calling him all day, but his line is always busy.
busy.sentenceTrans: 我已经给他打了一天电话了，但他电话总是占线。

but.definitionEn: used to introduce a word or phrase that contrasts with what was said before
but.sentence: I want to play football, but I have to finish my homework first.
but.sentenceTrans: 我想要踢足球，但我得先完成我的作业。
but.mnemonic: b=by通过 + ut外面 → 例外 → but但是，然而

butter.definition: 黄油，奶油；  v.涂黄油于……上
butter.definitionEn: a solid yellow substance made from milk or cream that is spread on food or used in cooking
butter.sentence: She usually has bread with butter for breakfast.
butter.sentenceTrans: 她早餐经常吃黄油面包。
butter.mnemonic: but牛 + ter奶酪 → 牛奶加工而成的乳酪 → butter黄油

button.definitionEn: a small part of a machine that you press to make it work
button.sentence: Press the button to turn off the computer.

buy.definitionEn: to obtain something by paying money for it
buy.sentence: The couple was excited to buy their first home together.
buy.sentenceTrans: 这对恋人因为一起买了他们的第一栋房子而很兴奋。

by.definition: 通过（表示方式）；乘……；被，由（表被动）
by.definitionEn: near somebody/something; at the side of somebody/something; beside somebody/something
by.sentence: The children go to school by bus.
by.sentenceTrans: 孩子们坐公交车去上学。

bye.sentence: After saying bye, he is going to take the train.
bye.sentenceTrans: 说完再见后，他就要去乘火车了。

bye-bye.sentence: The girl is saying "bye-bye" to the boy.
bye-bye.sentenceTrans: 女孩正在给男孩说拜拜。

cable.definitionEn: a set of wires, covered in plastic or rubber, that carries electricity, telephone signals, etc.; thick strong metal rope used on ships, for supporting bridges, etc.
cable.sentence: Many birds are standing on the cables for a rest.
cable.sentenceTrans: 许多小鸟正停在电缆上休息。

cafe.definitionEn: a place where you can buy drinks and simple meals. Alcohol is not usually served in British or American cafes.; a small shop/store that sells sweets, newspapers, food, etc. and usually stays open later than other shops/stores
cafe.sentence: The man drinks coffee in a cafe.
cafe.sentenceTrans: 这个男人在咖啡馆喝咖啡。

cake.definitionEn: a sweet food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, butter, sugar, etc. that is baked in an oven. Cakes are made in various shapes and sizes and are often decorated, for example with cream or icing.; a food mixture that is cooked in a round flat shape
cake.sentence: Would you like some chocolate cake?
cake.sentenceTrans: 你想来点儿巧克力蛋糕吗？

calculate.definitionEn: to use numbers to find out a total number, amount, distance, etc.
calculate.sentenceTrans: 让我们计算一下最终的金额。
calculate.mnemonic: calc石头 + ul + ate表动词 → 用小石头计数 → 计算

calculation.definitionEn: the act or process of using numbers to find out an amount
calculation.sentence: The little girl is doing calculations on the blackboard.
calculation.sentenceTrans: 小女孩正在黑板上做计算题。
calculation.mnemonic: calcul计算 ＋ ation表示行为、状态、过程 → calculation计算，考虑

calculator.definitionEn: a small electronic device or piece of software for calculating with numbers
calculator.sentence: The man is working with a calculator.
calculator.sentenceTrans: 这个男人正在用计算器工作。
calculator.mnemonic: calcul计算 + ator 表示做……工作的物 → n.计算器，计算者

calendar.definitionEn: a page or series of pages that shows the days, weeks, and months of a year
calendar.sentence: The month is over, so it's time to flip to the next month on the calendar.
calendar.sentenceTrans: 这个月结束了，是时候翻到日历的下一个月了。
calendar.mnemonic: calend每月第一天 + ar表名词 → calendar日历

calf.definitionEn: the muscular back part of the leg below the knee
calf.sentence: His calf muscles are sore after a long run.
calf.sentenceTrans: 长跑之后，他的小腿肌肉酸痛。

call.definition: 通话，打电话；  v.叫，喊；打电话给…
call.definitionEn: the act of speaking to somebody on the telephone
call.sentence: He gave his mother a phone call from work.
call.sentenceTrans: 他上班的时候给母亲打了个电话。

calm.definition: 冷静的，平静的；沉着的，镇静的；  v.（使）平静，（使）镇定；  n.平静，安宁
calm.definitionEn: not excited, nervous or upset; (of the sea) without large waves
calm.sentence: She remains calm while her scared friends hide behind her.
calm.sentenceTrans: 她保持镇定，而她害怕的朋友们则躲在她身后。

camera.definitionEn: a device that is used for taking photographs or for making movies, television programs, etc.
camera.sentence: She is able to take high quality photos with that camera.
camera.sentenceTrans: 她能用那台照相机拍出高质量的照片。

camp.definition: 营地；阵营；  v.露营；宿营
camp.definitionEn: to live temporarily in or as if in a tent
camp.sentence: Our camp is located by the lake.

campaign.definition: （社会性、政治性）活动，运动；  v.从事活动
campaign.definitionEn: a series of planned activities that are intended to achieve a particular social, commercial or political aim
campaign.sentence: Many people launched a campaign to call for environmental protection.
campaign.sentenceTrans: 许多人发起了一场呼吁环保的运动。
campaign.mnemonic: camp营地 + aign名词后缀 → 营地 → 战役

campus.definitionEn: the buildings of a university or college and the land around them
campus.sentence: On our campus, we can just sit on the lawn to do our group work.
campus.sentenceTrans: 在我们的校园里，我们可以坐在草坪上做小组作业。
campus.mnemonic: camp田野 + us用 →用田野建造学校→ campus校园

can.definitionEn: a closed metal container that is usually shaped like a cylinder and that holds food or drink
can.sentence: I've bought you a can of coke. Go ahead and enjoy it!
can.sentenceTrans: 我为你买了一听可乐，喝吧！

canal.definitionEn: a long straight passage dug in the ground and filled with water for boats and ships to travel along; a smaller passage used for carrying water to fields, crops, etc.
canal.sentence: There are many canals running through the city.
canal.sentenceTrans: 这座城市有很多运河穿流其中。

cancel.definitionEn: to decide that something that has been arranged will not now take place
cancel.sentenceTrans: 我取消了我的购物订单。

cancer.definitionEn: a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to one or many parts of the body
cancer.mnemonic: canc=kar艰难，严重 + er名词后缀，人或物 → 严重的疾病 → cancer癌症

candidate.definitionEn: a person who is trying to be elected or is applying for a job
candidate.sentence: We have shortlisted you as a potential candidate for the position.
candidate.sentenceTrans: 我们已经将你列入该职位的潜在候选人名单中。
candidate.mnemonic: cand发光，白 + id + ate表名词  → 白衣人（古罗马时期谋求官职者都着白衣） → candidate候选人

cap.definitionEn: a type of soft flat hat with a peak; a soft hat that fits closely and is worn for a particular purpose
cap.sentence: This is a blue police cap.

capable.definitionEn: having the qualities or abilities that are needed to do something; having the ability to do things well
capable.sentence: Your penguin is a weightlifter? That must be a very capable bird.
capable.sentenceTrans: 你的企鹅是个举重运动员？那它一定是一只有本领的鸟。
capable.mnemonic: cap握住 ＋ able形容词后缀，具有某种性质的 → capable有能力的，有才能的

capacity.definitionEn: the number of things or people that a container or space can hold
capacity.sentence: The capacity of this cup is 2 liters.
capacity.sentenceTrans: 这个杯子的容量是两升。
capacity.mnemonic: cap拿 + acity名词后缀 → 拿住的能力 → capacity容量

capital.definitionEn: the most important town or city of a country, usually where the central government operates from
capital.sentence: Beijing is the capital of China.
capital.mnemonic: capit头 + al…的 → 头的 → capital首都

captain.definitionEn: the person in charge of a ship or commercial aircraft
captain.sentence: The captain is standing at the helm of the ship.
captain.mnemonic: capt头 + ain表名词，...的人 → captain首领

capture.definition: 捕获，抓住；留存；使迷住；（用文字或图片）记录；  n.俘虏；捕获
capture.definitionEn: to catch a person or an animal and keep them as a prisoner or in a confined space
capture.sentence: The rabbit was captured by the hunter.
capture.mnemonic: capt拿，抓，握住 + ure名词后缀 → 抓住毛病 → capture逮捕，捉拿

car.definitionEn: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that can carry a small number of passengers
car.sentence: There is a green car parked at the side of the road.
car.sentenceTrans: 路边停着一辆绿色的车。

carbon.definitionEn: a chemical element that forms diamonds and coal and that is found in petroleum and in all living plants and animals
carbon.sentence: Coal burns so easily because it contains lots of carbon.
carbon.sentenceTrans: 煤很容易燃烧是因为它含有大量的碳。
carbon.mnemonic: carb碳 + on名词后缀 → carbon碳

card.definition: 卡，卡片，贺卡，名片；纸牌，牌
card.definitionEn: a game or games in which playing cards are used; a small piece of stiff paper or plastic with information on it, especially information about somebody’s identity
card.sentence: Here is my card. It has my phone number and email on it.
card.sentenceTrans: 这是我的名片，上面有我的电话号码和邮箱地址。

care.definitionEn: the process of caring for somebody/something and providing what they need for their health or protection
care.sentence: She really cares about her patient.
care.sentenceTrans: 她真的很关心她的病人。

career.definitionEn: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes
career.sentence: The little girl is thinking about her future career.
career.sentenceTrans: 小女孩思考着自己的未来职业。

careful.definitionEn: giving attention or thought to what you are doing so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
careful.sentence: Pay careful attention to each piece so you don't choose the wrong one.
careful.sentenceTrans: 每一块拼图都要仔细观察，这样你就不会选错。
careful.mnemonic: care照料 + ful有…...的 → careful小心的

careless.sentence: If you're careless with your trash, other people may get hurt.
careless.sentenceTrans: 如果你乱扔垃圾，其他人可能会因此受伤。
careless.mnemonic: care关心 ＋ less否定后缀 → 不关心的 → careless粗心的，漫不经心的

cargo.definitionEn: goods that are carried from one place to another by boat, airplane, etc.
cargo.sentence: This machine loads the cargo onto the ship.
cargo.sentenceTrans: 这台机器把货物装载到船上。

carpet.definitionEn: a thick woven material made of wool, etc. for covering floors or stairs; a piece of carpet used as a floor covering, especially when shaped to fit a room; a thick layer of something on the ground
carpet.sentence: I put my books on the carpet.
carpet.sentenceTrans: 我把我的书放在了地毯上。

carry.definition: 携带（疾病、病菌）；传送，运送，输送
carry.definitionEn: to support the weight of somebody/something and take them or it from place to place; to take somebody/something from one place to another
carry.sentence: It is widely believed that bats carry many viruses.
carry.sentenceTrans: 目前，人们广泛认为蝙蝠携带着大量病毒。

cart.definitionEn: a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse and used for carrying loads; a basket or table with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things; a light vehicle with wheels that you pull or push by hand
cart.sentence: Carts are useful for carrying goods in the supermarket.
cart.sentenceTrans: 在超市里用手推车装商品很方便。

cartoon.definitionEn: a film/movie made by photographing a series of gradually changing drawings or models, so that they look as if they are moving
cartoon.sentence: Almost every kid loves to watch cartoons!
cartoon.sentenceTrans: 几乎所有小孩子都喜欢看卡通片！
cartoon.mnemonic: cart一张纸 + oon表名词 → 画在纸上的 → cartoon动画片；漫画

case.definition: 案件；情况；箱，盒；容器；套；状况，场合；事实；事例，实例
case.definitionEn: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type
case.sentence: They are discussing the case in court.
case.sentenceTrans: 他们正在法庭上讨论这个案件。

cash.definitionEn: money in the form of coins or notes/bills
cash.sentence: The woman behind the counter said she takes cash only.
cash.sentenceTrans: 柜台后面的女人说她只接受现金。

cashier.definition: 出纳员，收银员；  v.驱逐，革除，废除
cashier.definitionEn: a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a bank, shop/store, hotel, etc.
cashier.sentence: The cashier at the supermarket is scanning each item.
cashier.sentenceTrans: 超市的收银员正在扫描每一件商品。
cashier.mnemonic: cash现金 + ier表名词，人或物 → 管理现金的人 → cashier出纳

cassette.definitionEn: a small flat plastic case containing tape for playing or recording music or sound
cassette.sentence: I don't even have the machine to play these old cassettes.
cassette.sentenceTrans: 我连播放这些旧磁带的设备都没有。
cassette.mnemonic: cass=case盒子 + ette表名词  → 小盒子  → cassette录像带

cast.definition: 投，掷；投射（光）；  n.演员表；全体演员
cast.definitionEn: to throw somebody or something somewhere, especially using force
cast.sentence: He's going to cast that rock at the seaside.
cast.sentenceTrans: 他准备在海边把石块投掷出去。

casual.definition: 偶然的；随便的；非正式的；临时的
casual.definitionEn: not showing much care or thought; seeming not to be worried; not wanting to show that something is important to you; without paying attention to detail
casual.sentence: Our first meeting was purely casual; we bumped into each other at a coffee shop.
casual.sentenceTrans: 我们的第一次见面完全是偶然的；我们在咖啡店碰巧遇到了。
casual.mnemonic: cas落下 + ual……的 → 突然降临的，不是安排好的 → casual偶然的

cat.definitionEn: a small animal with soft fur that people often keep as a pet. Cats catch and kill birds and mice.
cat.sentence: I prefer dogs, but this cat is so cute!
cat.sentenceTrans: 我更喜欢狗，但是这只猫真可爱！

catalog.definitionEn: a complete list of items, for example of things that people can look at or buy
catalog.sentence: There is a variety of products in the catalog for us to select.
catalog.sentenceTrans: 我们可以在商品目录中选择各式各样的产品。
catalog.mnemonic: cata向下 + log说 → 在下面要说的话 → catalog目录

catalogue.definitionEn: a complete list of things that you can look at, buy, or use, for example in a library or at an art show
catalogue.sentence: The girl got information about the clothes from the product catalogue.
catalogue.sentenceTrans: 女孩能从产品目录中得到关于衣服的信息。

catch.definitionEn: to use your hands to grasp and hold onto (someone or something)
catch.sentence: He is trying to catch this football.
catch.sentenceTrans: 他正试图接住这只足球。

cattle.definitionEn: cows and bulls that are kept as farm animals for their milk or meat
cattle.sentence: The cattle are eating grass on the grassland.

cause.definition: 引起，导致，造成，使发生；  n.原因，理由；事业
cause.definitionEn: to make something happen, especially something bad or unpleasant
cause.sentence: Too much screen time may cause your eyes to feel tired.
cause.sentenceTrans: 长时间看屏幕会使眼睛疲劳。

caution.definition: 警告；谨慎，小心；  v.劝……谨慎小心
caution.definitionEn: a warning or a piece of advice about a possible danger or risk
caution.sentence: The caution sign indicated that there's something dangerous ahead.
caution.sentenceTrans: 警告标志显示前方有危险。
caution.mnemonic: caut=cautious小心 + ion名词后缀 → 小心，谨慎

cautious.definitionEn: being careful about what you say or do, especially to avoid danger or mistakes; not taking any risks
cautious.sentence: The maid is very cautious about serving the empress.
cautious.sentenceTrans: 这个丫鬟在皇后面前非常谨慎。
cautious.mnemonic: caution小心 + ous表形容词  → 小心的，谨慎的

cave.definitionEn: a large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground
cave.sentence: He went into the dark cave by himself.
cave.sentenceTrans: 他独自一人走进了漆黑的山洞。

cease.definition: 停止，结束；  n.停止，停息
cease.sentence: The rain ceased and the rainbow showed up.
cease.sentenceTrans: 雨停了，彩虹出现在天边。

ceiling.definitionEn: the inside surface at the top of a room
ceiling.sentence: Look at my bright pink ceiling! It's so girly!
ceiling.sentenceTrans: 看我亮粉色的天花板！多么少女！
ceiling.mnemonic: ceil装天花板 + ing名词后缀 → ceiling 天花板

celebrate.definitionEn: to show that a day or an event is important by doing something special on it
celebrate.sentence: We gathered with family to celebrate the New Year with a big dinner.
celebrate.sentenceTrans: 我们与家人团聚，共进丰盛的晚餐，以庆祝新年。
celebrate.mnemonic: celebr庆祝 + ate表示做… → celebrate庆祝；歌颂

cell.definition: 细胞；单间牢房；【财】单元格
cell.definitionEn: the smallest unit of living matter that can exist on its own
cell.sentence: White blood cells help protect our body.
cell.sentenceTrans: 白细胞可以保护我们的身体。

census.definitionEn: the process of officially counting something, especially a country’s population, and recording various facts
census.sentence: The government is taking a census. May I ask: how many people live here?
census.sentenceTrans: 政府正在做人口普查。请问一下：这里住了多少人？
census.mnemonic: cens评估 + us表名词 → 查[人口] → 普查 → 人口普查

cent.definitionEn: a coin and unit of money worth 1% of the main unit of money in many countries, for example of the US dollar or of the euro
cent.sentence: This coin is only worth one cent.

center.definitionEn: the middle point or part of something
center.sentence: You'll get lots of points if you hit the center of the target.
center.sentenceTrans: 如果击中目标的中心，你会得很高的分数。

centigrade.definitionEn: relating to, conforming to, or having a thermometric scale on which the interval between the freezing point of water and the boiling point of water is divided into 100 degrees with 0° representing the freezing point and 100° the boiling point
centigrade.sentence: The flower grows well at 25 degrees centigrade.
centigrade.sentenceTrans: 花在25摄氏度的环境下生长得很好。
