knife.sentence: A knife is used to cut things up.

knock.definitionEn: to hit something (such as a door) with the knuckles of your hand or with a hard object (such as a knocker) in order to get people's attention
knock.sentence: Before entering, you should knock on the door.
knock.sentenceTrans: 进去之前，你应该先敲门。

knot.definition: 绳结，结合，树的节；  v.打结
knot.definitionEn: a join made by tying together two pieces or ends of string, rope, etc.; a hard round spot in a piece of wood where there was once a branch; a small group of people standing close together
knot.sentence: In the Stone Age people tied knots in ropes to count.
knot.sentenceTrans: 在石器时代人们曾在绳子上打结来计数。

know.definitionEn: to have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it
know.sentence: You always know the answer—give someone else a chance.
know.sentenceTrans: 你总是知道答案，给其他人一个机会吧。

knowledge.definitionEn: information, understanding, or skill that you get from experience or education
knowledge.sentence: Children are able to learn more quickly and retain more knowledge than adults.
knowledge.sentenceTrans: 相比大人，小孩子学得更快，记的知识更多。
knowledge.mnemonic: know知道 + ledge框架 → knowledge知识

lab.definitionEn: a laboratory; a room or building equipped for scientific experimentation or research
lab.sentence: This lab has lots of equipment for experiments.
lab.sentenceTrans: 这间实验室有许多实验仪器。

label.definitionEn: a piece of paper, etc. that is attached to something and that gives information about it
label.sentence: She is holding the label of the shirt.

labor.definition: 劳动，劳力；劳工；分娩；  v.劳动，苦干；分娩阵痛
labor.definitionEn: work, especially physical work; the people who work or are available for work in a country or company
labor.sentence: This woman's labor in the fields is tireless.
labor.sentenceTrans: 这位妇女在地里不知疲倦地劳动。

labour.sentence: Many people make a living by doing manual labour.
labour.sentenceTrans: 许多人靠从事繁重的劳动谋生。

lack.definitionEn: the state of not having something or not having enough of something
lack.sentence: The area is in an extreme lack of water resources.
lack.sentenceTrans: 这个地区极度缺乏水资源。

ladder.definitionEn: a device used for climbing that has two long pieces of wood, metal, or rope with a series of steps or rungs between them
ladder.sentence: I climbed up the ladder to change the light bulb.
ladder.mnemonic: lad倚靠 + der名词后缀 → 倚靠放置的东西 → ladder梯子

lady.definitionEn: a woman who is polite and well educated, has excellent manners and always behaves well
lady.mnemonic: la面包 + dy女仆 → 部落中做面包的女人 → lady女士

lag.definition: 落后，滞后；  n.（两事件之间的）时间间隔
lag.definitionEn: to move or develop slowly or more slowly than other people, organizations, etc.
lag.sentence: He tends to lag during long races.
lag.sentenceTrans: 他在长距离赛跑时常常落后。

lake.definitionEn: a large area of water that is surrounded by land
lake.sentence: The lake lies in the pretty green valley.
lake.sentenceTrans: 这个湖位于美丽的绿色山谷中。

lamp.sentence: An oil lamp burned in darkness.
lamp.sentenceTrans: 一盏油灯在黑暗中燃烧。

land.definition: 陆地，土地；大地；  v.（使）降落；（使）着陆，降落
land.definitionEn: the surface of the earth that is not sea
land.sentence: This land is covered with green grass.
land.sentenceTrans: 这片土地上长满了青草。

landlady.definitionEn: a woman from whom you rent a room, a house, etc.; a woman who owns or manages a pub or a guest house
landlady.sentence: I paid the rent to the landlady.
landlady.sentenceTrans: 我把租金付给了女房东。
landlady.mnemonic: land土地 ＋ lady女士 → landlady女房东；女地主

landlord.definitionEn: a person or company from whom you rent a room, a house, an office, etc.; a man who owns or manages a pub or a guest house
landlord.sentence: A landlord receives rent from a leased property.
landlord.sentenceTrans: 房东从出租的房产中收取租金。

lane.definitionEn: a narrow road in the country; (especially in place names) a street, often a narrow one with buildings on both sides; a section of a wide road, that is marked by painted white lines, to keep lines of traffic separate
lane.sentence: There is a narrow bicycle lane beside the lake.
lane.sentenceTrans: 湖边有一条窄窄的自行车道。

language.definitionEn: any one of the systems of human language that are used and understood by a particular group of people
language.sentence: People from different countries speak different languages.
language.sentenceTrans: 不同国家的人讲不同的语言。
language.mnemonic: langu语言 + age表示状态、情况及其他 → language语言，语言课程

lap.definition: （坐下时的）大腿部；（跑道的）一圈；  v.轻拍
lap.definitionEn: the top part of your legs that forms a flat surface when you are sitting down
lap.sentence: A little cat is sleeping on the old lady's lap.
lap.sentenceTrans: 一只小猫在老太太的大腿上睡觉。

large.sentence: She has a very large cup.
large.sentenceTrans: 她有一个非常大的杯子。

largely.definition: 大部分地，主要地；大量地
largely.definitionEn: to a great extent; mostly or mainly
largely.sentence: The users of this product are largely female.
largely.sentenceTrans: 这个产品的用户大多数为女性。
largely.mnemonic: large大的 + ly...地 -> largely大部分地

laser.definitionEn: a device that gives out light in which all the waves oscillate (= change direction and strength) together, typically producing a powerful beam of light that can be used for cutting metal, in medical operations, etc.
laser.sentence: His laser-like eyes saw right through me.
laser.sentenceTrans: 他激光般的双眼直接看穿了我。

last.definition: 最后的，仅剩下的；  det.最近的；  adv.最后，终于；最近，上次；  v.持续，坚持
last.definitionEn: happening or coming after all other similar things or people
last.sentence: This is the last piece of the puzzle.
last.sentenceTrans: 这是拼图缺失的最后一块。

late.definition: 迟的，晚的；已故的，去世不久的；  adv.迟，晚
late.definitionEn: near the end of a period of time, a person’s life, etc.
late.sentence: Oh, no! I'm late for work!

lately.sentence: Lately, the temperature keeps going above 40°C.
lately.sentenceTrans: 最近的气温一直超过40摄氏度。
lately.mnemonic: late最近的 + ly……地 → lately最近，不久前

later.definitionEn: at a time in the future; after the time you are talking about
later.sentence: I'll call you later after the meeting.
later.sentenceTrans: 会议结束后我再打给你。

latest.sentence: He is reading the latest news in the newspaper.
latest.sentenceTrans: 他正在阅读报纸上的最新消息。
latest.mnemonic: lat=late最近 + est表示最高级“最……” → latest最近的，最新的

latter.definition: 后者；  adj.后面的，后者的
latter.definitionEn: the second of two things or people mentioned
latter.sentence: When asked which he would prefer, an apple or a pizza, the boy chose the latter.
latter.sentenceTrans: 当被问到更喜欢苹果还是比萨时，男孩选择了后者。
latter.mnemonic: latt=late迟的，晚的 + er表名词 → 较迟的人  → latter后者

laugh.definitionEn: to make the sounds and movements of your face that show you are happy or think something is funny
laugh.sentence: She couldn't stop laughing because she had the love of the king.
laugh.sentenceTrans: 咖妃一想到皇上对她的恩宠就笑得合不拢嘴。（这后宫佳丽三千，皇上就偏偏宠我一人~）

laughter.definitionEn: the act or sound of laughing
laughter.sentence: She burst into laughter while chatting with an old friend.
laughter.sentenceTrans: 和老朋友聊天，她开怀大笑起来。

launch.definition: 发射；创办，开始从事；  n.（游艇、汽艇）下水
launch.definitionEn: to send something such as a spacecraft, weapon, etc. into space, into the sky or through water
launch.sentence: They launch the rocket into the sky.

laundry.definition: 洗衣物，洗衣物的活；要洗的衣服
laundry.definitionEn: the process or the job of washing clothes, sheets, etc.
laundry.sentence: The young man is doing laundry at home.
laundry.sentenceTrans: 这个年轻人正在家洗衣服。
laundry.mnemonic: laund=launder洗衣 + ry场地 → 洗衣房

lavatory.definitionEn: a toilet, or a room with a toilet in it; a public building or part of a building, with toilets in it
lavatory.sentence: The lavatory in the middle is for the disabled.
lavatory.sentenceTrans: 中间的厕所是给残疾人用的。
lavatory.mnemonic: lav洗，冲洗 + atory场所 → 冲洗的地方 → lavatory洗手间

law.definition: 法律，法学；规律，定理，惯例
law.definitionEn: the whole system or set of rules made by the government of a town, state, country, etc.
law.sentenceTrans: 没有人能凌驾于法律之上。

lawn.definitionEn: an area of ground covered in short grass in a garden/yard or park, or used for playing a game on
lawn.sentence: I often take care of my lawn to keep it nice and green.
lawn.sentenceTrans: 我常常精心打理我的草坪，让它看起来美观而又葱郁。

lawyer.definitionEn: a person who is trained and qualified to advise people about the law and to represent them in court, and to write legal documents
lawyer.sentence: The group of lawyers are sitting in the courtroom.
lawyer.sentenceTrans: 这群律师正坐在法庭里。
lawyer.mnemonic: law法律 + yer表示人 → lawyer律师，法律家

lay.definition: 搁放，放置；下蛋；躺（lie的过去式）；  adj.外行的
lay.definitionEn: to place (someone or something) down gently in a flat position
lay.sentence: The mother carefully lays the baby on the bed.
lay.sentenceTrans: 妈妈小心地把婴儿放到床上。

layer.definitionEn: a quantity or thickness of something that lies over a surface or between surfaces
layer.sentence: The cake is made up of many colorful layers.
layer.sentenceTrans: 这块蛋糕有五颜六色的许多层。
layer.mnemonic: lay放置 + er → layer把…分层堆放，层次

layout.definitionEn: the way in which the parts of something such as the page of a book, a garden or a building are arranged
layout.sentence: The picture shows the layout of the flat.
layout.sentenceTrans: 这张图展示了这套公寓的布局。
layout.mnemonic: lay放置 + out在外部 → layout布局，安排

lazy.definitionEn: unwilling to work or be active; doing as little as possible
lazy.sentence: He is too lazy to go to school.

lead.definition: 领导，带领，率领；导致，使得；  n.领先地位；铅（读作/led/）
lead.definitionEn: to connect one object or place to another
lead.sentence: Few people lead; many people follow.
lead.sentenceTrans: 少数人领导；多数人跟随。

leader.definitionEn: a person who leads a group of people, especially the head of a country, an organization, etc.; a person or thing that is the best, or in first place in a race, business, etc.
leader.sentence: The workers are happy to follow and work for their team leader.
leader.sentenceTrans: 员工们乐意跟随他们的小组领导工作。
leader.mnemonic: lead领导 + er人 → leader领袖，领导

leadership.definition: 领导，领导地位；领导能力
leadership.definitionEn: the state or position of being a leader
leadership.sentence: Under his leadership, they made it to the top!
leadership.sentenceTrans: 他们在他的领导下登上了山顶！
leadership.mnemonic: lead 带领 + er 表人 + ship资格 → leadership领导

leading.definition: 首位的，居前的；卓著的，显赫的
leading.definitionEn: ahead of others in a race or contest; most important or most influential
leading.sentence: The leading cyclist was starting to pull away from the rest.
leading.sentenceTrans: 领先的骑手渐渐甩开了其他人。
leading.mnemonic: lead领导 + ing...的 → leading指导的；最主要的

leaf.definitionEn: one of the flat and typically green parts of a plant that grow from a stem or twig
leaf.sentence: The picture shows different kinds of leaves.
leaf.sentenceTrans: 图片里展示了各种各样的树叶。

league.definition: 社团；联盟；  v.使……结盟，与……联合
league.definitionEn: a group of sports teams who all play each other to earn points and find which team is best
league.sentence: You are so good! You should join our soccer league!
league.sentenceTrans: 你很厉害！你应该加入我们的足球社团！

leak.definitionEn: to allow liquid or gas to get in or out through a small hole or crack; (of a liquid or gas) to get in or out through a small hole or crack in something
leak.sentence: The pipe leaks and the water flows everywhere.
leak.sentenceTrans: 水管漏水，水流得到处都是。

lean.definition: 倾斜；依赖；倚靠；  adj.萧条的，不景气的
lean.definitionEn: to bend or move from a vertical position; to rest on or against something for support
lean.sentence: These two men are leaning forward.
lean.sentenceTrans: 这两个男人的身体向前倾斜着。

leap.definitionEn: to jump high or a long way
leap.sentence: He leaped over the really big gap between the buildings.
leap.sentenceTrans: 展博跃过了两栋楼之间的间隙。

learn.definitionEn: to gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something
learn.sentence: I learn more from the books in the library than I do in school.
learn.sentenceTrans: 我从图书馆的书上学到的比在学校学到的多。

learned.definitionEn: having a lot of knowledge because you have studied and read a lot
learned.sentence: This dog is very well learned. He can even read books!
learned.sentenceTrans: 这只狗很有学问，它甚至会看书。
learned.mnemonic: learn学习 + ed形容词后缀 → learned有学问的

learner.definitionEn: someone (especially a child) who learns (as from a teacher) or takes up knowledge or beliefs
learner.sentence: This woman is a language learner—she loves to learn languages!
learner.sentenceTrans: 这个女人是个语言学习者——她喜欢学习语言！

learning.definitionEn: the activity or process of gaining knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something; the activity of someone who learns
learning.sentence: Mom often helps me with my learning.
learning.sentenceTrans: 妈妈经常在学习上给我帮助。
learning.mnemonic: learn学习 + ing行业，状态，行为 → learning学问

lease.definitionEn: to use or let somebody use something, especially property or equipment, in exchange for rent or a regular payment
lease.sentence: He leased a car for his road trip.
lease.sentenceTrans: 他为公路旅行租了一辆车。

least.definition: 【数】最小的，最少的；  adv.最少地，最小地；  n.最小，最少量
least.definitionEn: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
least.sentence: 1 is the least in these three numbers.
least.sentenceTrans: 这三个数中1是最小的数字。

leather.definitionEn: material made by removing the hair or fur from animal skins and preserving the skins using special processes
leather.sentence: The sofa and pillow are covered in real leather.
leather.sentenceTrans: 沙发和枕头都是真皮做的。

leave.definitionEn: to go away from a person or a place
leave.sentence: There was some trash left in the stadium after the match.
leave.sentenceTrans: 比赛结束后，体育场内留下了一些垃圾。

lecture.definition: 演讲；讲课；  v.演讲；讲课；教训
lecture.definitionEn: a talk that is given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course
lecture.sentence: He gave a lecture in front of many people.
lecture.sentenceTrans: 他在很多人面前发表了演讲。
lecture.mnemonic: lect讲，读 + ure名词后缀 → 公开讲说 → lecture讲课；讲座

left.definition: 离开（leave的过去式和过去分词）；  n.左边；  adj.左边的；  adv.在左边
left.sentence: My girlfriend left and went back to her job in another city.
left.sentenceTrans: 我的女朋友离开了，回到另一个城市工作。

leg.definitionEn: one of the long parts that connect the feet to the rest of the body
leg.sentence: This App can make the dog's legs look longer.
leg.sentenceTrans: 这款应用能让狗狗的腿看起来更长。

legal.definitionEn: allowed or required by law; connected with the law
legal.sentence: Now I have my driver's license; it's legal for me to drive on the road.
legal.sentenceTrans: 我现在有驾照了，可以合法上路了。
legal.mnemonic: leg法律 + al形容词后缀 → legal法律的

legend.definition: 传说，神话；传奇故事（或人物）
legend.definitionEn: a story from ancient times about people and events, that may or may not be true; this type of story; a very famous person, especially in a particular field, who is admired by other people
legend.sentence: This film reimagines the legend of Ne Zha with a fresh perspective.
legend.sentenceTrans: 这部影片以全新视角重塑了哪吒的传奇故事。
legend.mnemonic: leg讲，读 + end表名词 → 讲出的东西 → 传奇故事；引申为地图的图例

legitimacy.definitionEn: lawfulness by virtue of being authorized or in accordance with law
legitimacy.sentence: No one doubts the legitimacy of fishing here.
legitimacy.sentenceTrans: 没人怀疑在这儿钓鱼的合法性。

legitimate.definitionEn: allowed and acceptable according to the law
legitimate.sentence: Placement is the initial disposal of the proceeds of criminal activity into apparently legitimate business activity or property.
legitimate.sentenceTrans: 安置是将犯罪活动的收益最初处置为表面上合法的商业活动或财产。
legitimate.mnemonic: legiti=law法律 + mate 表动词 → legitimate使合法

leisure.definitionEn: time that is spent doing what you enjoy when you are not working or studying
leisure.sentence: In their leisure time, they like to play board games to relax themselves.
leisure.sentenceTrans: 闲暇时候，她们喜欢玩棋类游戏来放松自己。

lend.definition: 借给（某人钱或东西）；借出；（银行）贷（款）
lend.definitionEn: to give something to somebody or allow them to use something that belongs to you, which they have to return to you later
lend.sentence: She lends her classmate a pen.
lend.sentenceTrans: 她借给她同学一支钢笔。

length.definitionEn: the size or measurement of something from one end to the other; the amount of time that something lasts; the distance from one end of a swimming pool to the other; the size of a horse or boat from one end to the other, when it is used to measure the distance between two horses or boats taking part in a race
length.sentence: The ruler is 15 cm in length.
length.mnemonic: leng长 + th名词后缀 → length长度

lens.definitionEn: a curved piece of glass or plastic that makes things look larger, smaller or clearer when you look through it
lens.sentence: A magnifying glass uses a convex lens.

less.definition: 更少地；  n.较少数，较少量；  adj.更小的
less.definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
less.sentence: When you get older, it is very likely you are less hairy.
less.sentenceTrans: 当你年纪变大，很可能你的头发会变少。

lesson.definitionEn: a period of time in which somebody is taught something; something that is intended to be learned; an experience, especially an unpleasant one, that somebody can learn from so that it does not happen again in the future
lesson.sentence: We have an English lesson today.
lesson.sentenceTrans: 我们今天有一节英语课。

lest.sentence: She set many alarms the previous night, lest she be late again.
lest.sentenceTrans: 她睡前设了超多闹钟，以免再次迟到。
lest.mnemonic: les=less更少的 + t=the → the less that比...少 → lest唯恐，以免

let.definitionEn: to allow somebody to do something or something to happen without trying to stop it

letter.definitionEn: a message that is written down or printed on paper and usually put in an envelope and sent to somebody
letter.sentence: I love getting letters in the mailbox.
letter.sentenceTrans: 我喜欢在邮箱里收到信。

level.definition: 水平，标准，等级；  v.瞄准；  adj.等高的；平坦的
level.definitionEn: having the same height as something else
level.sentence: Players are separated into three levels in this game.
level.sentenceTrans: 玩家们在这个游戏中被分为三个等级。

liable.definitionEn: legally responsible for paying the cost of something
liable.sentence: You committed the crime, and now you're liable for the consequences!
liable.sentenceTrans: 你犯了罪，所以现在你要对后果负责。
liable.mnemonic: lia捆绑，捆扎 + ble形容词后缀 → 与...绑定的 → liable有责任的，有可能的

liberal.definition: 心胸宽阔的；自由主义的；慷慨的；  n.自由主义者
liberal.definitionEn: a person who understands and respects other people’s opinions and behaviour, especially when they are different from their own; a person who supports political, social and religious change
liberal.sentence: She has a liberal attitude toward different cultures.
liberal.sentenceTrans: 她对不同文化持有心胸宽广的态度。
liberal.mnemonic: liber自由 + al形容词后缀 → liberal自由的

liberate.definitionEn: to free a country or a person from the control of somebody else; to free somebody from something that restricts their control over and enjoyment of their own life
liberate.sentence: She felt her heart liberated together with the birds.
liberate.sentenceTrans: 她感到自己的心随着鸟儿一起解放了。
liberate.mnemonic: liber自由 + ate动词后缀 → 使…自由 → liberate解放，释放

liberation.definitionEn: the act or process of freeing a country or a person from the control of somebody else
liberation.sentence: The liberation of Paris marked a turning point in World War II.
liberation.sentenceTrans: 巴黎的解放标志着二战的一个转折点。
liberation.mnemonic: liber自由 + ation名词后缀 → 使自由 → liberation解放；释放

liberty.definitionEn: freedom to live as you choose without too many restrictions from government or authority; the state of not being a prisoner or a slave; the legal right and freedom to do something
liberty.sentence: The bird flew from the cage and got liberty.
liberty.sentenceTrans: 这只鸟飞出了鸟笼，得到了自由。
liberty.mnemonic: liber自由的 + ty表名词 → liberty自由

librarian.definition: 图书馆馆长，图书管理员
librarian.definitionEn: a person who is in charge of or works in a library
librarian.sentence: The helpful librarian helped me find the books I needed.
librarian.sentenceTrans: 那位热心的图书管理员帮我找到了我需要的书。
librarian.mnemonic: libr书 + arian表示人 → 图书馆馆长；图书管理员

library.definitionEn: a place where books, magazines, and other materials (such as videos and musical recordings) are available for people to use or borrow
library.sentence: We can find many books in the library.
library.sentenceTrans: 我们可以在图书馆找到很多书。
library.mnemonic: libr表示书 + ary构成名词，表示与...有关的地方 → library图书馆

licence.sentence: See! I told you I have a driving licence!
licence.sentenceTrans: 看吧！我都跟你说了我有驾照的！
licence.mnemonic: licen=allow允许 + ce → licence特许，许可证

license.definition: 执照；许可证；  v.发许可证；发执照
license.definitionEn: an official document that shows that permission has been given to do, own or use something
license.sentence: You need a driving license before you can drive on the road.
license.sentenceTrans: 开车上路前，你要先有驾照。
license.mnemonic: licen=allow允许 + se表名词 → license批准，许可

lie.definition: 躺，平卧；撒谎；欺骗；  n.谎话，谎言
lie.definitionEn: (of a person or an animal) to be or put yourself in a flat or horizontal position so that you are not standing or sitting
lie.sentence: She lies down on the sofa, and takes a short break from her work.
lie.sentenceTrans: 她放下工作，躺在沙发上休息一会儿。

life.definition: 生活，生存；生命；一生，人生
life.definitionEn: the ability to breathe, grow, reproduce, etc. which people, animals and plants have before they die and which objects do not have
life.sentence: My life changes a lot after having a baby.
life.sentenceTrans: 有了孩子后，我的生活改变了很多。

lifetime.definitionEn: the length of time that somebody lives or that something lasts
lifetime.sentence: They have been friends for the whole lifetime.
lifetime.sentenceTrans: 她们是一辈子的好朋友。

lift.definition: （使）升起，举起；  n.免费搭车；<英>电梯

like.sentence: These two girls like to sing.

limb.definitionEn: an arm or a leg; a similar part of an animal, such as a wing

limit.definitionEn: a point beyond which someone is not allowed to go

limitation.definitionEn: a limit on what somebody/something can do or how good they or it can be; a rule, fact or condition that limits something

limited.definitionEn: not very great in amount or extent

line.definitionEn: a long narrow mark on a surface; a row of people or things next to each other or behind each other

link.definition: 链接；  v.连接；联系；把……连接起来

lion.definitionEn: a large powerful animal of the cat family, that hunts in groups and lives in parts of Africa and southern Asia. Lions have yellowish-brown fur and the male has a mane

lip.definition: 嘴唇，唇状物；边沿；  v.接吻；说话；拍打
lip.definitionEn: either one of the two soft parts that surround the mouth; having the type of lips mentioned

liquid.definition: 液体，液态物；  adj.液体的，液态的

list.definitionEn: a series of names, items, figures, etc., especially when they are written or printed

list.sentenceTrans: “列表”是一种数据结构，可以存储一组项目，并支持添加和删除项目。

listen.definitionEn: to pay attention to somebody/something that you can hear

listen.mnemonic: list听 + en动词后缀 → listen听，倾听

liter.definitionEn: a unit for measuring volume, equal to 1.76 British pints or 2.11 American pints

literary.sentence: She put many famous literary books on her bookshelf.

literature.mnemonic: litera=letter文字，字母 + ture状态 → 文字状态 → literature文学

litre.definitionEn: a metric unit for measuring the volume of a liquid or gas that is equal to 1.057 quarts
litre.sentence: The bottle contains a litre of milk.

little.definitionEn: not big; small; smaller than others

lively.definition: 富有活力的；活泼的；生机勃勃的；生动的

load.definition: 装载；输入，载入（数据或程序）；  n.负载，负荷

loaf.definition: 一条（面包）；  v.虚度光阴

loan.definitionEn: money that an organization such as a bank lends and somebody borrows

local.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with the particular place or area that you are talking about or with the place where you live

local.sentenceTrans: 当地人有自己的服装和文化。
local.mnemonic: loc地方 + al形容词后缀 → local地方的，局部的

locate.definition: 找出……的位置；使……坐落于，位于，处于；找出……的精确位置

location.definitionEn: a place where something happens or exists; the position of something

lodge.definition: 小屋，小舍；  v.存放，保管；正式提出

log.definition: 原木；航海日志；  v.伐木

look.definitionEn: to turn your eyes in a particular direction; to try to find somebody/something; to pay attention to something

love.definitionEn: (not used in the progressive tenses) to have very strong feelings of affection for somebody

low.definitionEn: at or near the bottom of something

luxury.definition: 奢侈的，豪华的；  n.奢侈品

madam.definitionEn: used when speaking or writing to a woman in a formal or business situation

magic.definition: 有魔力的，魔术的；  n.魔术，戏法

magnificent.definitionEn: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise

maid.definitionEn: (often in compounds) a female servant in a house or hotel

mail.definition: 邮件，信件；  v. 邮寄

main.definitionEn: being the largest or most important of its kind

mainland.definitionEn: belonging to the main area of land of a country, not including any islands near to it

mainly.definition: 主要地，大体上；大部分地

mainly.sentenceTrans: 他把钱花在很多东西上，但主要是饮食方面。

maintain.sentence: It's so hard to maintain this position for a long time!

maintenance.definitionEn: the act of keeping something in good condition by checking or repairing it regularly
maintenance.sentence: The boy is performing maintenance checks on his robot.
maintenance.sentenceTrans: 男孩正在检修他的机器人。

majority.definitionEn: the largest part of a group of people or things;  the number of votes by which one political party wins an election; the number of votes by which one side in a discussion, etc. wins

male.definition: 男性的，雄性的；  n.男性，雄性

manage.definition: 管理；设法做成；完成（困难的事）

manage.sentence: He managed his time well to complete all of his tasks.
