overnight.sentence: The man worked overnight to finish the work on time.
overnight.sentenceTrans: 这个男人为了按时完工，一整晚都在加班。
overnight.mnemonic: over越过 + night夜 → overnight一夜；突然

overseas.definition: 在海外；  adj.外国的；海外的
overseas.definitionEn: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
overseas.sentenceTrans: 我们把货物出口到海外。
overseas.mnemonic: over越过 + sea海洋 + s → overseas海外

overstate.definitionEn: to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
overstate.sentence: He is overstating what really happened to gain people's sympathy.
overstate.sentenceTrans: 他为了博得大家的同情而夸大了事实。

overtake.definitionEn: to go past a moving vehicle or person ahead of you because you are going faster than they are;
overtake.sentence: The flying car could easily overtake the racing car.
overtake.sentenceTrans: 这辆飞车可以轻松超过那辆赛车。
overtake.mnemonic: over越过 + take得到 → 追上,超过

overweight.sentence: The girl with yellow hair is overweight.
overweight.sentenceTrans: 这个黄头发的女孩超重了。
overweight.mnemonic: over过度 + weight重量 → overweight超重的

overwhelming.definitionEn: very great or very strong; so powerful that you cannot resist it or decide how to react
overwhelming.sentence: The red team won an overwhelming victory against the blue team in the election.
overwhelming.sentenceTrans: 红队在选举中战胜了蓝队，取得了压倒性的胜利。
overwhelming.mnemonic: over过度 + whelm压倒 + ing形容词后缀 → overwhelming势不可挡的，压倒的

owe.definitionEn: to exist or be successful because of the help or influence of somebody/something
owe.sentence: I owe my full mark to this phone app!
owe.sentenceTrans: 我把我的满分归功于这个手机应用！

own.definition: 有，拥有；  adj.自己的，本人的
own.definitionEn: one or ones belonging to oneself
own.sentence: She owns this workshop. She's the boss.
own.sentenceTrans: 她拥有这间工作室，她就是老板。

owner.sentence: He is the owner of this famous noodle stand.
owner.sentenceTrans: 手打是有名的一乐拉面馆的拥有者。

ownership.sentence: The couple have the certificate to prove their ownership of this house.
ownership.sentenceTrans: 这对夫妻拥有房产证可以证明他们对这栋房子的所有权。
ownership.mnemonic: owner所有者 + ship表名词 → ownership所有(权)，所有制

ox.definitionEn: a bull (= a male cow) that has been castrated (= had part of its sex organs removed), used, especially in the past, for pulling farm equipment, etc.
ox.sentence: The strong ox is angry now.
ox.sentenceTrans: 这头强壮的公牛现在很生气。

oxygen.definitionEn: a chemical element. Oxygen is a gas that is present in air and water and is necessary for people, animals and plants to live.
oxygen.sentence: Oxygen is essential for cellular respiration in the human body.
oxygen.sentenceTrans: 氧气对人体细胞呼吸至关重要。
oxygen.mnemonic: oxy含氧的 + gen出生，产生 → 氧气

pace.definitionEn: the speed at which somebody/something walks, runs or moves
pace.sentence: They were walking at a fast pace.

pack.definition: 收拾，打包；把......包起来；塞满，挤满；  n.行李；背包；小盒，小包；群
pack.definitionEn: to put clothes, etc. into a bag in preparation for a trip away from home; to put something into a container so that it can be stored, transported or sold
pack.sentence: The boy is packing his clothes for the trip.
pack.sentenceTrans: 这个男孩在打包旅行需要的衣物。

package.definition: 包裹；一揽子，一整套；  v.将……包装好
package.definitionEn: a box, bag, etc. in which things are wrapped or packed; the contents of a box, etc.
package.sentence: I received a package with a card.
package.sentenceTrans: 我收到一个带卡片的包裹。
package.mnemonic: pack包裹 + age表物 → package包裹

packet.sentence: This packet of potato chips has been opened.
packet.sentenceTrans: 这袋薯片已经被打开了。
packet.mnemonic: pack包捆 + et小东西→ packet小包

page.definitionEn: one side of a sheet of paper especially in a book, magazine, etc.
page.sentence: Please turn your book to the next page.

pain.definitionEn: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill/sick
pain.sentence: He is suffering great pain in his neck and back.
pain.sentenceTrans: 他感觉脖颈和后背特别疼。

painful.sentence: Oow! I hit my foot on the table! It's so painful!
painful.sentenceTrans: 噢！我的脚撞到桌子了！疼死了！
painful.mnemonic: pain疼痛 + ful形容词后缀 → painful痛苦的

paint.definition: 给…刷涂料，给……刷油漆；绘画；描绘；  n.油漆；颜料
paint.definitionEn: to cover a surface or object with paint
paint.sentence: I will paint my wall green.

painter.definitionEn: a person whose job is painting buildings, walls, etc.; an artist who paints pictures
painter.sentence: The painter is painting a picture.
painter.mnemonic: paint画画 + er表人 → 漆工，画家，绘画者

painting.definitionEn: a picture that has been painted; the act or art of using paint to produce pictures
painting.sentence: The kid is focused on her painting of a small house.
painting.sentenceTrans: 这个孩子正专注于她那幅画着小房子的绘画作品。
painting.mnemonic: paint画 + ing表名词 → painting画作，绘画

pair.definition: 一对，一双；  v.（使）成对，配对
pair.definitionEn: two things of the same type, especially when they are used or worn together
pair.sentence: A pair of parrots will be happier than a lonely one.
pair.sentenceTrans: 一对鹦鹉会比一只鹦鹉要幸福。

palace.definitionEn: the official home of a king, queen, president, etc.; any large impressive house
palace.sentence: The first snow this winter covered the palace in a blanket of white.
palace.sentenceTrans: 今年冬天的初雪给这座宫殿盖上了一层雪白的毯子。

pale.definition: 苍白的，灰白的；浅色的，淡色的
pale.definitionEn: (of a person, their face, etc.) having skin that is almost white; having skin that is whiter than usual because of illness, a strong emotion, etc.; light in colour; containing a lot of white; (of light) not strong or bright
pale.sentence: Recent stress from work left him pale.
pale.sentenceTrans: 近期的工作压力使他脸色苍白。

palm.definitionEn: the inner surface of the hand between the wrist and the fingers
palm.sentence: She showed me the flower in her palm.
palm.sentenceTrans: 她给我看了她手心里的花。

pamphlet.definitionEn: a very thin book with a paper cover, containing information about a particular subject
pamphlet.sentence: The pamphlet will explain how our product works.
pamphlet.sentenceTrans: 这本小册子介绍了产品的工作原理。
pamphlet.mnemonic: pam所有 + phlet热爱，亲爱的 -> 给喜欢的人的情书 -> 小册子

panel.definitionEn: a group of specialists who give their advice or opinion about something; a group of people who discuss topics of interest on television or radio
panel.sentence: The candidate was selected by the panel.
panel.sentenceTrans: 候选人是由讨论小组选出的。

paper.definitionEn: the material that is used in the form of thin sheets for writing or printing on, wrapping things, etc.
paper.sentence: I like to make notes on a small piece of paper.
paper.sentenceTrans: 我喜欢在小纸片上做笔记。

parade.definition: 游行；  v.游行，（使）列队行进
parade.definitionEn: to walk somewhere in a formal group of people, in order to celebrate or protest about something; to walk around in a way that makes other people notice you; to show somebody/something in public so that people can see them/it; to come together, or to bring soldiers together, in order to march in front of other people
parade.sentence: The New Year parade in Chinatown is always a popular event.
parade.sentenceTrans: 在唐人街举办的新年大游行总是一项受人欢迎的活动。

paragraph.definitionEn: a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph starts on a new line.
paragraph.sentence: Please summarize the main point of this paragraph.
paragraph.mnemonic: para旁、靠近、外 + graph=write，表示写，图 → 靠近图表旁边的文字 → (文章的)段，节

parallel.definitionEn: two or more lines that are parallel to each other are the same distance apart at every point
parallel.sentence: The boy drew parallel lines in his exercise book.
parallel.sentenceTrans: 这个男孩在他的练习本上画平行线。
parallel.mnemonic: para在旁边 + llel互相 → parallel平行的

parameter.definition: 参（变）数；参量；决定因素；界限
parameter.definitionEn: something that decides or limits the way in which something can be done
parameter.sentence: The math is very complicated; there are all kinds of parameters you need to take into account.
parameter.sentenceTrans: 这种数学问题很复杂，有各种参数需要考虑。
parameter.mnemonic: para=beside ＋ meter=measure计量，测量等 → parameter参（变）数；参量

parcel.definitionEn: something that is wrapped in paper or put into a thick envelope so that it can be sent by mail, carried easily, or given as a present
parcel.sentence: "I have some parcels for you," said the mailman.
parcel.sentenceTrans: “有您的一些包裹。”邮递员说道。
parcel.mnemonic: par部分 + cel表名词 → 小包裹 → parcel包裹

pardon.definition: 赦免，原谅，宽恕；  excl.请再说一遍；  n.赦免，原谅；原谅；宽恕
pardon.definitionEn: to officially allow somebody who has been found guilty of a crime to leave prison and/or avoid punishment

parent.sentence: The parents raised their son in a loving environment.
parent.sentenceTrans: 父母在充满爱的环境中养育了他们的孩子。
parent.mnemonic: par生产，生出孩子 + ent表名词 → parent父母

park.definitionEn: an area of public land in a town or a city where people go to walk, play and relax
park.sentence: Let's go for a walk in the park.

parliament.definitionEn: the group of people who are responsible for making the laws in some kinds of their government
parliament.sentence: These are the Houses of Parliament in London.
parliament.mnemonic: parlia=parley会谈 + ment表名词 → 议员们谈论政府的地方 → 议会，国会

part.definition: 部分，组成部分；零件；角色，份儿，作用；  v.分离，分开；分开
part.definitionEn: a separate piece or area of a human or animal body or of a plant
part.sentence: You can have part of the watermelon; I'll eat the rest.
part.sentenceTrans: 你可以吃一部分西瓜，我吃剩下的。

partial.definition: 偏爱的，特别喜欢的；偏袒的，不公平的，有偏见的
partial.definitionEn: showing or feeling too much support for one person, team, idea, etc., in a way that is unfair
partial.sentence: She is more partial to sweet foods than savory foods.
partial.sentenceTrans: 比起咸的食物，她更偏爱吃甜食。
partial.mnemonic: part部分 + ial形容词后缀 → partial部分的，偏心的

participant.definitionEn: a person who is taking part in an activity or event
participant.sentence: Every participant focused on the lecture.
participant.sentenceTrans: 每个参与者都聚精会神地听了演讲。
participant.mnemonic: parti准备 + cip拿，抓，握住 + ant名词后缀，表示人 → participant参与者

participate.definitionEn: to take part in or become involved in an activity
participate.sentence: The teacher is happy when her students participate in class discussions.
participate.sentenceTrans: 当学生们参与课堂讨论时，老师很开心。
participate.mnemonic: parti=part部分，分开 + cip抓住 + ate动词后缀 → 抓住机会成为其中一部分 → 参加

participation.definitionEn: the act of taking part in an activity or event
participation.sentence: Classroom participation will be an important part of students' grades.
participation.sentenceTrans: 课堂参与将是学生成绩考核里很重要的一项。
participation.mnemonic: parti部分 + cip 拿，握住 + ation 表名词 → 抓住部分 → 参与

particular.definition: 特别的，不寻常的；格外的；挑剔的，讲究的；  n.细节；详细资料
particular.definitionEn: used to emphasize that you are referring to one individual person, thing or type of thing and not others
particular.sentenceTrans: 我选出了五个与众不同的人。
particular.mnemonic: partic少量 + ular形容词后缀 → particular特别的

particularly.sentence: This guy particularly likes eating meat.
particularly.mnemonic: particular特别的 + ly...地 → 有自己的部分地 → particularly特别地

partly.sentence: The girl's face is partly hidden by the lute.
partly.sentenceTrans: 女孩儿的脸被琵琶遮住了一部分。
partly.mnemonic: part部分 + ly表副词 → partly部分地

partner.definitionEn: a person that you are doing an activity with, such as dancing or playing a game
partner.sentence: We are all partners here. Let's work together to finish the job.
partner.sentenceTrans: 我们是好搭档，让我们齐心协力完成工作吧。
partner.mnemonic: part部分，分开 + ner人 → 分开合作的人 → partner伙伴，搭档

party.definitionEn: a social event in which entertainment, food, and drinks are provided
party.sentence: Everyone had a great time at my birthday party.
party.sentenceTrans: 在我的生日聚会上每个人都玩得很开心。

pass.definition: （时间）流逝；给，传递；通过；  n.及格
pass.definitionEn: to give something to somebody by putting it into their hands or in a place where they can easily reach it

passage.definition: 通道，走廊；段落；（文章）章节，段落
passage.definitionEn: a long narrow area with walls on either side that connects one room or place with another
passage.sentence: People with suitcases are walking through the passage.
passage.sentenceTrans: 人们提着箱子正从通道里走过。
passage.mnemonic: pass通过 + age名词后缀，可表地点 → 可通过的地方 → 通道，走廊

passenger.definitionEn: a person who is traveling from one place to another in a car, bus, train, ship, airplane, etc., and who is not driving or working on it
passenger.sentence: All the passengers are seated and ready for the trip.
passenger.sentenceTrans: 乘客们已经坐好了，准备开始旅程。
passenger.mnemonic: pass通过 + enger人 → 通过的人 → passenger乘客

passer-by.definitionEn: a person who is going past somebody/something by chance, especially when something unexpected happens
passer-by.sentence: Some passers-by had seen the car accident.
passer-by.sentenceTrans: 一些路人目睹了这场车祸。

passion.definitionEn: a very strong feeling of liking something; a hobby, an activity, etc. that you like very much
passion.sentence: He shouted "Passion!" and conveyed the idea that "passion changes lives."
passion.sentenceTrans: 他高喊 “激情！”，并传达了 “激情改变生活 ”的理念。
passion.mnemonic: pass感情 + ion名词后缀 → passion热情，激情

passionate.definitionEn: having or showing strong feelings of enthusiasm for something or belief in something
passionate.sentence: He always gets so passionate while playing the guitar.
passionate.sentenceTrans: 弹吉他的时候，他总是充满了激情。
passionate.mnemonic: passion激情 + ate形容词后缀 → passionate热烈的

passive.definition: 被动的；消极的；  n.被动语态
passive.definitionEn: tending not to take an active or dominant part
passive.sentence: Passive smoking causes great harm to children and pregnant women.
passive.sentenceTrans: 被动吸烟会对儿童和孕妇造成很大的伤害。
passive.mnemonic: pass忍受，受苦 + ive表形容词 → passive消极的；被动的

passport.definitionEn: an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country, and that you may have to show when you enter or leave a country
passport.sentence: I got many stamps on my passport.
passport.sentenceTrans: 我的护照上盖了很多章。
passport.mnemonic: pass通过 + port港口 → 通过港口的凭证 → passport护照

past.definition: 过去；  prep.过，超过；（时间）晚于；  adv.经过；  adj.过去的，结束的
past.definitionEn: the time that has gone by; things that happened in an earlier time; a person’s past life or career
past.sentence: We usually used public telephones in the past.
past.sentenceTrans: 过去我们通常使用公用电话。

paste.definitionEn: to stick something to something else using glue or paste; to make something by sticking pieces of paper together
paste.sentence: I'm pasting wallpaper to the wall.
paste.sentenceTrans: 我正在把墙纸粘贴到墙上。

pat.definition: 轻拍，抚摸；  n.轻拍，抚摸
pat.definitionEn: to lightly touch (someone or something) with your hand usually several times in order to show affection or approval or to provide comfort
pat.sentenceTrans: 他亲切地拍了拍那只狗。

patch.definitionEn: a piece of material that you wear over an eye, usually because the eye is damaged
patch.sentence: I tore a hole in my pants, so I sewed a patch over it.
patch.sentenceTrans: 我的裤子撕破了一个洞，所以我打了一个补丁在上面。

path.definitionEn: a way or track that is built or is made by the action of people walking
path.sentence: There are many trees on both sides of the path.

patience.definitionEn: the ability to stay calm and accept a delay or something annoying without complaining
patience.sentence: He's losing his patience after waiting so long.
patience.mnemonic: pati忍受 + ence表示性质、状态 → 能忍受 → patience忍耐，容忍，耐心

patient.definition: 病人，患者；  adj.有耐性的，能容忍的
patient.definitionEn: a person who is receiving medical treatment, especially in a hospital
patient.sentence: As a nurse, I love to work closely with my patients.
patient.sentenceTrans: 作为一名护士，我喜欢近距离接触我的病人。
patient.mnemonic: pati忍受 + ent表名词，...的人 → 正在受苦的人 → patient病人

pattern.definition: 图案，花样，式样；模式；典范；版式；样品；  v.形成图案；促成（某种行为模式）
pattern.definitionEn: the regular way in which something happens or is done
pattern.sentence: The pattern consists of many different colored triangles.
pattern.sentenceTrans: 这个图案由许多不同颜色的三角形组成。

pause.definition: 暂停播放；暂停，中止；  n.中止，暂停
pause.definitionEn: to stop talking or doing something for a short time before continuing
pause.sentence: I clicked on the screen and paused the video.
pause.sentenceTrans: 我点击按钮暂停了视频。

pay.definition: 支付，偿还；付出；  n.工资
pay.definitionEn: to give somebody money for work, goods, services, etc.; to give somebody money that you owe them
pay.sentence: He paid for his coffee and bread.
pay.sentenceTrans: 他付了咖啡和面包的钱。

payment.definitionEn: the act of paying somebody/something or of being paid
payment.sentence: The clever dog made the payment for the bone itself.
payment.sentenceTrans: 这只聪明的狗自己购买了骨头。
payment.mnemonic: pay付款 + ment表示行为、行为的过程或结果 → 支付，支付的款项

peace.sentence: This kind of bird always stands for peace.
peace.sentenceTrans: 这种鸟一直代表着和平。
peace.mnemonic: pea固定 + ce名词后缀 → peace和平，无战争

peaceful.definitionEn: not involving a war, violence or argument
peaceful.sentence: The chaos around him couldn't shake his peaceful mind.
peaceful.sentenceTrans: 周遭的喧嚣无法动摇他内心的宁静。
peaceful.mnemonic: peace和平 + ful…的 → peaceful和平的

peak.definition: 山顶；最高峰，顶点；  v.使……达到顶峰；  adj.最高度的；高峰时期的
peak.definitionEn: the pointed top of a mountain; a mountain with a pointed top
peak.sentence: The peak of the mountain is covered by snow.

pear.definitionEn: a yellow or green fruit that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom
pear.sentence: The pears are yellow and ripe.

peasant.definition: 农民；农夫；庄稼人；小耕农
peasant.definitionEn: (especially in the past, or in poorer countries) a farmer who owns or rents a small piece of land
peasant.sentence: This is a peasant living in the old times.
peasant.sentenceTrans: 这是一位生活在旧时代的农民。
peasant.mnemonic: peas乡村 + ant表正在进行 → 住在乡村的 →peasant农民；乡下人

peculiar.definitionEn: strange or unusual, especially in a way that is unpleasant or worrying
peculiar.sentence: These mooncakes' flavors are very peculiar.
peculiar.sentenceTrans: 这些月饼的口味很奇怪。
peculiar.mnemonic: peculi特有 + ar……的 → peculiar特有的

pen.definitionEn: (often in compounds) an instrument made of plastic or metal used for writing with ink
pen.sentence: Sign this with a pen, please.

penalty.definitionEn: a punishment for breaking a law, rule or contract
penalty.sentence: The driver is facing a penalty for not wearing his seatbelt.
penalty.sentenceTrans: 这名司机因未系安全带而面临处罚。
penalty.mnemonic: penal刑事的 + ty名词后缀 → penalty 刑罚，罚金

pencil.definitionEn: a narrow piece of wood, or a metal or plastic case, containing a black or coloured substance, used for drawing or writing
pencil.sentence: I use a pencil to do math.

penetrate.definitionEn: to go into or through something; to succeed in entering or joining an organization, a group, etc. especially when this is difficult to do
penetrate.sentence: The apple was penetrated with an arrow.
penetrate.sentenceTrans: 这个苹果被一支箭射穿了。
penetrate.mnemonic: pen 几乎 + etr穿过 + ate 动词后缀 → penetrate刺穿；渗入

penny.definitionEn: a small British coin and unit of money. There are 100 pence in one pound (£1).
penny.sentence: His parents give the little boy a penny a day.
penny.sentenceTrans: 小男孩的父母每天给他一美分。

pension.definitionEn: an amount of money paid regularly by a government or company to somebody who is considered to be too old or too ill/sick to work
pension.sentence: The old lady gets her pension every month.
pension.sentenceTrans: 那个老年女士每个月都会得到养老金。
pension.mnemonic: pens花费 + ion名词后缀 → 政府给老年人等花费的钱 → pension养老金

people.definition: 人，人们，人类（person的复数）；人民，民众
people.definitionEn: the ordinary men and women of a country rather than those who govern or have a special position in society
people.sentence: There are many different people in the world.
people.sentenceTrans: 世界上有许多不同的人。

per.definitionEn: used to express the cost or amount of something for each person, number used, distance travelled, etc.
per.sentence: You are allowed to drive at 80 kilometers per hour on this road.
per.sentenceTrans: 你可以在这条路上以每小时最快80公里的速度行驶。

perceive.definitionEn: to notice or become aware of (something)
perceive.sentence: Some patients perceive pain differently due to individual sensitivity.
perceive.sentenceTrans: 由于个人敏感性不同，有些病人对疼痛的感知也不同。
perceive.mnemonic: per通过 + ceive抓住 → perceive觉察，发觉

percent.definition: 百分比，比例，部分；百分之……
percent.sentence: The green part takes up 70 percent of the pie chart.
percent.sentenceTrans: 绿色部分占据了饼状图的70%。
percent.mnemonic: per每一 + cent一百 → percent百分比

percentage.definitionEn: the number, amount, rate of something, expressed as if it is part of a total which is 100; a part or share of a whole; a share of the profits of something
percentage.sentence: The percentage of the green part is 60%.
percentage.mnemonic: percent百分之几 + age状态，总称 → 百分比

perfect.definition: 极好的；准确的；  v.使完美（读作/pərˈfekt/）
perfect.sentence: Baicizhan is a perfect English study application.
perfect.sentenceTrans: 百词斩是一款极好的英语学习应用程序。

perform.definitionEn: to entertain an audience by playing a piece of music, acting in a play, etc.
perform.sentence: A band is performing on the stage.
perform.sentenceTrans: 一支乐队正在舞台上表演。
perform.mnemonic: per完全 + form提供 → 提供完全提供、展现自己 → perform表演、表现

performance.definition: 表演，演出；表现；执行；性能
performance.definitionEn: how well or badly you do something; how well or badly something works
performance.sentence: The audience was amazed by her great stage performance.
performance.sentenceTrans: 观众对她精彩的舞台表演赞叹不已。
performance.mnemonic: perform表演 + ance表名词 → performance表演

perhaps.sentence: The girl perhaps had a bad dream.
perhaps.sentenceTrans: 这个女孩可能做了噩梦。
perhaps.mnemonic: per全部 + hap机会，运气 + s表复数 → 全是机会 → perhaps也许，可能

period.definitionEn: a length of time during which a series of events or an action takes place or is completed
period.sentence: He became a math teacher over a period of four years.
period.sentenceTrans: 他花了四年的时间成了一名数学老师。
period.mnemonic: peri周围，靠近 ＋ od道路 → period周期

permanent.definitionEn: lasting for a long time or for all time in the future; existing all the time
permanent.sentence: The love between them was permanent, enduring the test of time.
permanent.sentenceTrans: 他们之间的爱情是永久的，经得起时间的考验。
permanent.mnemonic: per贯穿，自始至终 + man留住 + ent形容词后缀 → 永久留住 → permanent永恒的

permissible.definitionEn: acceptable according to the law or a particular set of rules
permissible.sentence: Smoking is permissible in this area.
permissible.mnemonic: permiss=permit允许 + ible形容词后缀 → permissible可允许的

permission.definitionEn: the act of allowing somebody to do something, especially when this is done by somebody in a position of authority
permission.sentence: My mother gave me her permission to go to the party.
permission.sentenceTrans: 我母亲允许我去参加聚会。
permission.mnemonic: permi=permit允许 + ssion名词后缀 → permission允许，同意

permit.definition: 许可；  n.许可证；执照（读作/ˈpɜrˌmɪt/）
permit.definitionEn: to allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen
permit.sentence: Only the invited are permitted to enter the room.
permit.sentenceTrans: 只有受邀人士才被允许进入这个房间。
permit.mnemonic: per始终 + mit送，放出 → 始终放出来 → 许可

persist.definitionEn: to continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable
persist.sentence: Although the water is cold, we persist in going forward.
persist.sentenceTrans: 尽管水很凉，我们还是坚持前进。
persist.mnemonic: per贯穿，自始至终 + sist站 → 站到最后 → persist坚持

persistent.definitionEn: determined to do something despite difficulties, especially when other people are against you and think that you are being annoying or unreasonable
persistent.sentence: There will be persistent rain this month.
persistent.mnemonic: persist坚持 + ent形容词后缀 → persistent坚持的

person.sentence: This person is drinking coffee with her friend.
person.sentenceTrans: 这个人正在和她的朋友一起喝咖啡。

personal.definitionEn: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else
personal.sentence: He is riding his personal bike.
personal.sentenceTrans: 他正在骑他自己的自行车。

personnel.definition: 全体人员，职员；人事部门
personnel.definitionEn: the people who work for an organization or one of the armed forces; the department in a company that deals with employing and training people
personnel.sentence: We will arrange the training for personnel.
personnel.sentenceTrans: 我们将安排全体人员培训。
personnel.mnemonic: personn=person人 + el表名词 → 全体人员

perspective.definition: 【财】观点；（对事物的）合理判断，正确认识；远景
perspective.definitionEn: a particular attitude towards something; a way of thinking about something
perspective.sentence: From a financial perspective the decision to invest in stocks needs a thorough analysis.
perspective.sentenceTrans: 从财务角度看，决定投资股票需要进行彻底的分析。
perspective.mnemonic: per贯穿，自始至终 + spect看 + ive名词后缀 → 看透了 → perspective透视

persuade.definitionEn: to make somebody do something by giving them good reasons for doing it
persuade.sentence: He is trying to persuade his friend to go on a roller coaster with him.
persuade.sentenceTrans: 他正试图说服他的朋友和他一起坐过山车。
persuade.mnemonic: per贯穿，自始至终 + suade劝 → 一直劝 → persuade劝说

pessimist.definitionEn: a person who usually expects bad things to happen
pessimist.sentence: Unlike his positive friend, the pessimist thought the weather would get worse.
pessimist.sentenceTrans: 和他那个乐观的朋友不同，这个悲观主义者觉得天气会变差。
pessimist.mnemonic: pessim=pessimism悲观 + ist主义 → pessimist悲观主义者

pessimistic.definitionEn: expecting bad things to happen or something not to be successful; showing this
pessimistic.sentence: The pessimistic man always expects the worst.
pessimistic.sentenceTrans: 这个悲观的人总是把什么事情都想得很糟。
pessimistic.mnemonic: pessi=pes底部的 + mistic关于……的 → pessimistic悲观的；厌世的

pet.definition: 宠物；宠儿；  v.宠爱，爱抚；  adj.宠爱的，钟爱的
pet.definitionEn: an animal (such as a dog, cat, bird, or fish) that people keep mainly for pleasure

petrol.definitionEn: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in car engines, etc.
petrol.sentence: "Please fill my car up with petrol!" the driver said.
petrol.sentenceTrans: 司机说：“麻烦给我的车加满油！”

petroleum.definitionEn: mineral oil that is found under the ground or the sea and is used to produce petrol/gas, paraffin, diesel oil, etc.
petroleum.sentence: The marine drilling platform is used for the exploitation of petroleum and gas.
petroleum.sentenceTrans: 海上钻井平台用于油气开发。

phase.definition: 相位；阶段；  v.分阶段进行
phase.definitionEn: the shape of the part of the moon that is visible at different times during a month
phase.sentence: Using a phase inverter pedal for guitar can create interesting tonal variations in your playing.
phase.sentenceTrans: 在吉他上使用相位倒置踏板可以在演奏中创造有趣的音色变化。

phenomenon.definitionEn: a fact or an event in nature or society, especially one that is not fully understood
phenomenon.sentence: The Northern Lights are a wonderful natural phenomenon.
phenomenon.sentenceTrans: 北极光是一种奇妙的自然现象。
phenomenon.mnemonic: phen显示 + omen预兆 + on表示抽象名词 → 显示预兆 → phenomenon现象

philosopher.definitionEn: a person who studies or writes about philosophy
philosopher.sentence: This is a statue of an ancient Greek philosopher.
philosopher.sentenceTrans: 这是一尊古希腊哲学家的雕塑。
philosopher.mnemonic: philo爱 + soph智慧 + er者 → 爱智慧的人 → philosopher哲学家，思想家

philosophy.definitionEn: the study of the nature and meaning of the universe and of human life; a particular set or system of beliefs resulting from the search for knowledge about life and the universe
philosophy.sentence: I often think about the meaning of life and other questions of philosophy.
philosophy.sentenceTrans: 我常常思考生命的意义以及其他哲学问题。
philosophy.mnemonic: philo爱 + sophy智慧 → 爱与智慧 → philosophy哲学

phone.definitionEn: a device that is connected to a telephone system and that you use to listen or speak to someone who is somewhere else
phone.sentence: They are all using their phones.
phone.sentenceTrans: 他们都在玩自己的手机。

photo.definitionEn: a picture of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
photo.sentence: Smile please, I am taking a photo of you.
photo.sentenceTrans: 请笑一笑，我在给你拍照片呢。

photograph.definition: 照片；  v.照相，摄影；  v.为……拍照
photograph.definitionEn: a picture that is made by using a camera that stores images in digital form or that has a film sensitive to light inside it
photograph.sentence: Here are all of my travel photographs.
photograph.sentenceTrans: 这些都是我旅行拍的照片。
photograph.mnemonic: photo光 + graph写，图 → 用光写 → photograph相片

phrase.definitionEn: a group of words which have a particular meaning when used together
phrase.sentence: A phrase is a group of words that forms part of a sentence.
phrase.sentenceTrans: 短语是构成句子一部分的一组词。

physical.definition: 身体上的；物理的，物理学的；物质的；  n.体格检查
physical.definitionEn: connected with a person’s body rather than their mind
physical.sentence: Physical exercise is good for your body and mind.
physical.sentenceTrans: 体育锻炼有益于你的身心健康。
physical.mnemonic: physic自然，自然科学 + cal表形容词 → 大自然中本身就存在的 → physical身体的，物理的

physician.definitionEn: a doctor, especially one who is a specialist in general medicine and not surgery
physician.sentence: My physician told me to eat more fruits and vegetables.
physician.sentenceTrans: 我的内科医生告诉我要多吃水果和蔬菜。
physician.mnemonic: phys生理领域 + ician表专家，从事某职业的人 → physician内科医生

physicist.sentenceTrans: 爱因斯坦是个伟大的物理学家。
physicist.mnemonic: physic物理 + ist做...的人 → physicist物理学家

physics.definitionEn: a science that deals with matter and energy and the way they act on each other in heat, light, electricity, and sound
physics.sentence: He is teaching physics in the classroom.

piano.definitionEn: a large musical instrument with a keyboard that you play by pressing black and white keys and that produces sound when small hammers inside the piano hit steel wires

pick.definitionEn: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things
pick.sentence: He picked out the block from the middle of the row.
pick.sentenceTrans: 他挑出了这排中间的木块。

picnic.definitionEn: an occasion when people pack a meal and take it to eat outdoors, especially in the countryside
picnic.sentence: The family enjoyed a nice picnic outside.
picnic.sentenceTrans: 这一家人在室外享用了一顿很好的野餐。

picture.definition: 照片，图片；画，图画；  v.想象，设想；描述
picture.definitionEn: a painting or drawing, etc. that shows a scene, a person or thing; a photograph
picture.sentence: We took a group picture in front of this famous attraction in Rome.
picture.sentenceTrans: 我们在罗马的这个著名景点前拍了一张合照。
picture.mnemonic: pict描画 + ure名词后缀 → picture图画，照片

pie.definitionEn: a food that consists of a pastry crust that is filled with fruit, meat, etc.
pie.sentence: May I have a slice of the blueberry pie?
pie.sentenceTrans: 可以给我一片蓝莓派吗？

piece.definitionEn: an amount that is cut or separated from a larger section of something
piece.sentence: The yellow cup smashed into pieces.
piece.sentenceTrans: 这个黄杯子碎成了很多块。

pierce.definitionEn: to make a small hole in something, or to go through something, with a sharp object

pig.definitionEn: an animal with pink, black or brown skin, short legs, a broad nose and a short tail which curls round itself. Pigs are kept on farms for their meat (called pork) or live in the wild.

pigeon.definitionEn: a gray bird that is common in cities and that has a fat body and short legs
pigeon.sentence: The pigeon is taking a rest in the tree.
pigeon.sentenceTrans: 这只鸽子正在树上休息。

pile.definitionEn: a number of things that have been placed on top of each other
pile.sentence: I piled up the soldiers I defeated on top of each other.
pile.sentenceTrans: 阿卡丽把她打败的士兵一个接一个堆起来。

pill.definitionEn: a small flat round piece of medicine that you swallow without chewing it
pill.sentence: The woman is taking some pills as she is ill.
pill.sentenceTrans: 这个女人因为生病了，正在服用一些药丸。

pillar.definitionEn: a large round stone, metal or wooden post that is used to support a bridge, the roof of a building, etc., especially when it is also decorative; a strong supporter of something; an important member of something; a person who has a lot of a particular quality
pillar.sentence: These pillars hold the roof up.

pillow.definitionEn: a square or rectangular piece of cloth filled with soft material, used to rest your head on in bed
pillow.sentence: I love sleeping with soft pillows.
pillow.sentenceTrans: 我爱枕着软软的枕头入睡。

pilot.definitionEn: a person who operates the controls of an aircraft, especially as a job
pilot.sentence: He has dreamed of being a pilot since he was a little boy.
pilot.sentenceTrans: 他从小就梦想成为一名飞行员。
pilot.mnemonic: pil=ped脚 + ot名词后缀 → pilot飞行员，领航员

pin.definition: 大头针；别针；  v.别住，钉住，固定住
pin.definitionEn: to hold fast or prevent from moving
pin.sentence: Be careful, there’s a pin on the floor.
pin.sentenceTrans: 小心，地上有一枚大头针。

pinch.definitionEn: to take a piece of somebody’s skin between your thumb and first finger and squeeze hard, especially to hurt the person
pinch.sentence: The nurse will gently pinch the patient's skin to check for dehydration.
pinch.sentenceTrans: 护士会轻轻捏一下病人的皮肤来检查是否脱水。

pine.definition: 松树；  v.（因死亡、离别等）难过
pine.definitionEn: an evergreen forest tree with leaves like needles; the pale soft wood of the pine tree, used in making furniture, etc.
pine.sentence: The pine tree is a symbol of Mount Huangshan.
pine.sentenceTrans: 松树是黄山的标志之一。

pink.definitionEn: a color that is a mixture of red and white
pink.sentence: The princess wears a pink dress.
pink.sentenceTrans: 公主穿着一条粉色的裙子。

pioneer.definition: 先锋，先驱；  v.开辟，首倡
pioneer.definitionEn: a person who is the first to study and develop a particular area of knowledge, culture, etc. that other people then continue to develop; one of the first people to go to a particular area in order to live and work there
pioneer.sentence: He's a pioneer in climbing, that is, the first man to reach the summit.
pioneer.sentenceTrans: 他是登山的先锋，即第一个到达山顶的人。
pioneer.mnemonic: pion=ped脚 + eer表示人  → 用脚走路的人  → pioneer先锋

pipe.definition: 管子，导管；烟斗；  v.用管子输送
pipe.definitionEn: a tube through which liquids and gases can flow
pipe.sentence: These pipes are made of plastic, so they are very light.
pipe.sentenceTrans: 这些管子是塑料做的，所以它们非常轻。

pirate.definitionEn: (especially in the past) a person on a ship who attacks other ships at sea in order to steal from them
pirate.sentence: The pirate found an island to bury the stolen treasure.
pirate.sentenceTrans: 海盗发现了一个小岛来埋藏他偷来的宝藏。
pirate.mnemonic: pir坏的 + ate做 → 做坏事 → pirate抢夺，引申为海盗

pitch.definition: 投掷，扔；扎营；  n.（足球等的）球场；程度，强度，高度；音高；沥青，柏油
pitch.definitionEn: to throw the ball to the person who is batting
pitch.sentence: The player pitched the ball to me.
pitch.sentenceTrans: 球员把球向我掷了过来。

pity.definitionEn: to feel sorry for somebody because of their situation; to feel pity for somebody
pity.sentence: The psychologist showed pity for the girl.
pity.sentenceTrans: 心理学家对女孩深表同情。

place.definitionEn: a specific area or region of the world :a particular city, country, etc.
place.sentence: Berlin is one place that I would like to go to.
place.sentenceTrans: 柏林是一个我想去的地方。

plague.definitionEn: any infectious disease that kills a lot of people; a disease spread by rats that causes fever, swellings on the body and usually death
plague.sentence: The Black Plague took thousands of lives away in the Middle Ages.
plague.sentenceTrans: 在中世纪，黑死病夺走了成千上万条生命。
plague.mnemonic: plag击打 + ue  → 击打（使苦恼） → plague烦扰

plain.definition: 平原；  adj.朴素的，不做修饰的；简单明了的
plain.definitionEn: not decorated or complicated; simple; without marks or a pattern on it
plain.sentence: A plain is a flat landform at low altitude.
plain.sentenceTrans: 平原是一种位于低海拔的平坦地貌。

plan.definition: 计划，打算；  v.计划，打算
plan.definitionEn: a detailed map of a building, town, etc.; a set of things to do in order to achieve something, especially one that has been considered in detail in advance; something that you intend to do or achieve
plan.sentence: They made a plan to renovate the living room.
plan.sentenceTrans: 他们制定了一个计划来装修客厅。

plane.definitionEn: a vehicle that has wings and an engine and can carry people or things in the air
plane.sentence: The plane is taking off at sunset.

planet.definitionEn: a large, round object in space (such as the Earth) that travels around a star (such as the sun)
planet.sentence: There are 8 major planets in our solar system.

plant.definition: 植物；发电厂；设备；工厂；  v.种植；安置；放置
plant.definitionEn: a living thing that grows in the ground, usually has leaves or flowers, and needs sun and water to survive
plant.sentence: There are many different kinds of green plants.
plant.sentenceTrans: 这里有许多不同种类的绿色植物。

plastic.definition: 塑料，塑料制品；  adj.塑料的
plastic.sentence: All of this food packaging is made of plastic.
plastic.sentenceTrans: 这些食品包装都是塑料做的。
plastic.mnemonic: plast塑造 + ic……的 → 可塑的

plate.definitionEn: a flat, usually round, dish that you put food on
plate.sentence: I can put much food on this big plate.
plate.sentenceTrans: 我可以在这个大盘子里放很多食物。

platform.definitionEn: the raised flat area beside the track at a train station where you get on or off the train
platform.mnemonic: plat平坦 + form形状 → 形状平的地方 → 平台，月台

play.definition: 玩；演奏；扮演；（使）播放；  n.戏剧，剧本；比赛
play.definitionEn: to do things for pleasure, as children do; to enjoy yourself, rather than work
play.sentence: The children are playing in the park.
play.sentenceTrans: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

player.definition: 玩家；运动员；参赛选手，队员
player.definitionEn: a person who takes part in a game or sport
player.sentence: The player has just won a game.
player.sentenceTrans: 这个玩家刚刚赢得了一场游戏。
player.mnemonic: play比赛，游戏 + er表人 → player选手，队员

playground.definition: （学校的）操场，运动场；（公园的）游乐场；游乐区
playground.definitionEn: an outdoor area where children can play, especially at a school or in a park
playground.sentence: The students are having fun on the playground after class.
playground.sentenceTrans: 下课后，学生们在操场上玩耍。
playground.mnemonic: play比赛 + ground场地 → playground操场，运动场

pleasant.definition: 令人愉快的，舒适的；宜人的
pleasant.sentence: Her pleasant smile has lit up my day.
pleasant.sentenceTrans: 她明媚的笑容照亮了我的一天。
pleasant.mnemonic: pleas=please快乐 ＋ ant形容词词尾 → pleasant令人愉快的，舒适的

please.definitionEn: used as a polite way of asking for something or telling somebody to do something
please.sentence: Please give me some more food. I'm really hungry.
please.sentenceTrans: 请再给我一些食物吧，我真的很饿。

pleased.sentence: The children were pleased to play role-play.
pleased.sentenceTrans: 孩子们在角色扮演中玩得很开心。
pleased.mnemonic: pleas高兴 + ed形容词后缀 → pleased高兴的

pleasing.definitionEn: that gives you pleasure or satisfaction
pleasing.sentence: She finds the bunch of flowers very pleasing.
pleasing.sentenceTrans: 她觉得这束花让她很满意。
pleasing.mnemonic: pleas=please愉快 + ing形容词后缀 → 令人愉快的

pleasure.definitionEn: a state of feeling or being happy or satisfied
pleasure.sentence: The little girl takes pleasure in eating cakes.
pleasure.sentenceTrans: 这个小女孩从吃蛋糕中获得快乐。
pleasure.mnemonic: pleas=please令人高兴的 + ure名词后缀，表行为、状态 → pleasure愉快

pledge.definition: 保证，誓约；  v.使保证，使发誓；抵押，典当
pledge.definitionEn: to formally promise to give or do something; to make somebody or yourself formally promise to do something; to leave something with somebody as a pledge
pledge.sentence: Holding his sword and kneeing down, he made his pledge.
pledge.sentenceTrans: 雪诺手持宝剑，跪倒在地，宣誓将生命与荣耀献给守夜人。

plentiful.definitionEn: available or existing in large amounts or numbers
plentiful.sentence: The fruits and vegetables are plentiful!
plentiful.mnemonic: plenti=plenty足够 + ful…的 → plentiful丰富的，充足的，大量的

plenty.definitionEn: a large number or amount of something; a number or amount of something that is enough for a particular purpose
plenty.sentence: We have plenty of fruits and vegetables.
plenty.sentenceTrans: 我们有充足的水果和蔬菜。
plenty.mnemonic: plen满 ＋ ty表名词 → plenty大量，丰富

plot.definition: 情节；小块土地；故事情节；  v.密谋；绘图；为小说写情节
plot.definitionEn: the series of events that form the story of a novel, play, film/movie, etc.; a secret plan made by a group of people to do something wrong or illegal; a small piece of land that is used or intended for a special purpose
plot.sentence: She is crafting a romantic plot for her story.
plot.sentenceTrans: 她正在为故事构思一个浪漫的情节。

plug.definition: 插头；塞子；  v.封堵；宣传
plug.definitionEn: push into an electric socket to connect the electricity supply with a plug
plug.sentence: The robot is charging from the plug on his back.
plug.sentenceTrans: 初号机通过背后的插头充电。

plural.definitionEn: connected with or having the plural form; relating to more than one
plural.sentence: The word 'fish' can be singular or plural.
plural.sentenceTrans: fish这个词可以是单数也可以是复数。
plural.mnemonic: plur=plus更多的 + al表形容词 → plural复数的

plus.definition: 加，加上；  n.加号；有利因素；  conj.此外，而且，况且；  adj.正的；（分数后）加，略高；多的
plus.definitionEn: used to indicate that one number or amount is being added to another
plus.sentence: One plus one equals two. Hopefully you knew that.
plus.sentenceTrans: 一加一等于二，希望你知道这个。

pocket.definition: 口袋，兜，衣袋；  adj.袖珍的；  v.把……装入口袋
pocket.definitionEn: a small piece of material like a small bag sewn into or onto a piece of clothing so that you can carry things in it
pocket.sentence: I put my phone into my pocket.
pocket.sentenceTrans: 我把手机放进我的口袋里了。
pocket.mnemonic: pock袋 + et=ellus小  → 小袋子  → pocket口袋

poem.definitionEn: a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their sound and the images they suggest, not just for their obvious meanings. The words are arranged in separate lines, usually with a repeated rhythm, and often the lines rhyme at the end.
poem.sentence: This great poem was written by Li Bai.

poet.sentence: He is one of the most famous poets in Chinese history.
poet.sentenceTrans: 他是中国历史上最著名的诗人之一。

point.definition: 意义；点；（试图表达的）观点，看法；  v.指向，指出；表明
point.definitionEn: the sharp thin end of something
point.sentence: What was the point of playing the piano to a cow?

poison.definition: 毒物，毒药，毒素；  v.毒死，毒害
poison.definitionEn: a substance that causes death or harm if it is swallowed or absorbed into the body; an idea, a feeling, etc. that is extremely harmful
poison.sentence: Don't drink that poison. It will kill you.
poison.sentenceTrans: 不要喝那瓶毒药，它会把你毒死的。

poisonous.definitionEn: causing death or illness if swallowed or absorbed into the body; (of animals and insects) producing a poison that can cause death or illness if the animal or insect bites you
poisonous.sentence: Some varieties of mushrooms are poisonous.
poisonous.sentenceTrans: 有些品种的蘑菇是有毒的。

pole.definition: 杆子，棍，杖；（行星的）极，地极
pole.sentence: The wire pole holds the cables.

police.definition: 警察，警方；  v.维持治安，管辖，监督
police.definitionEn: an official organization whose job is to make people obey the law and to prevent and solve crime; the people who work for this organization
police.sentence: We know he's a police because of his car and uniform.
police.sentenceTrans: 我们根据他的车子和制服得知他是一位警察。

policeman.sentence: The policeman is chasing a thief.

policy.definitionEn: a plan of action agreed or chosen by a political party, a business, etc.
policy.sentence: The policy in this company forbids employees to have relationships with each other.
policy.sentenceTrans: 这家公司的政策禁止员工之间谈恋爱。
policy.mnemonic: polic国家，城市 + y名词后缀 → 用以管理国家的依据 → policy政策

polish.definition: 磨光，擦亮；润饰，使优美；  n.上光剂
polish.definitionEn: to make something smooth and shiny by rubbing it
polish.sentence: The car needs to be polished regularly.
polish.mnemonic: pol光滑 + ish动词词尾 → polish抛光，擦亮

polite.definition: 有礼貌的，客气的；文雅的
polite.definitionEn: having or showing good manners and respect for the feelings of others
polite.sentence: This polite girl gave her seat to an old lady.
polite.sentenceTrans: 这个有礼貌的女孩把自己的座位让给了一位老太太。
polite.mnemonic: pol光滑 + ite…的 → polite有礼貌的

political.definitionEn: of or relating to politics or government
political.sentence: The young man is giving a political speech to the public.
political.sentenceTrans: 这个年轻人在向公众发表一场政治演说。
political.mnemonic: polit国家，城市 + ical...的 → political政治的，政治上的

politics.definitionEn: the activities involved in getting and using power in public life, and being able to influence decisions that affect a country or a society
politics.sentence: He is so keen on politics that he participates in many public events.
politics.sentenceTrans: 他是如此热衷于政治，因此他参加了很多公众活动。
politics.mnemonic: polit城市，公民 + ics与...有关的 → politics政治

poll.definition: 民意测验；投票；  v.获得（票数）
poll.definitionEn: the process of questioning people who are representative of a larger group in order to get information about the general opinion
poll.sentence: The organization is conducting a poll.
poll.sentenceTrans: 该组织正在进行一项民意测验。

pollute.definitionEn: to make (land, water, air, etc.) dirty and not safe or suitable to use
pollute.sentence: Few fish can survive in this polluted river.
pollute.sentenceTrans: 在这条受污染的河里，很少有鱼能存活下来。

pollution.definitionEn: substances that make air, water, soil, etc. dirty
pollution.sentence: Pollution from the factories made the sky turn gray.
pollution.sentenceTrans: 工厂带来的污染使天空变成了灰色。
pollution.mnemonic: pollut污染 + ion表示行为、行为的过程或结果、情况、状态 → pollution污染

pond.definitionEn: a small area of still water, especially one that is artificial
pond.sentence: The duck dived into the pond.

pool.definition: 泳池，水塘；  v.集中资源（或材料）；合伙
pool.definitionEn: [countable] a small area of still water, especially one that has formed naturally freshwater pools; a small amount of liquid or light lying on a surface; a group of people available for work when needed; a supply of things or money that is shared by a group of people and can be used when needed;
pool.sentence: There is a big swimming pool in the park.
pool.sentenceTrans: 公园里有个超大的游泳池。

poor.definition: 贫穷的；可怜的；不足的，缺少的
poor.definitionEn: deserving pity and sympathy; having very little money; not having enough money for basic needs
poor.sentence: The poor homeless man begged for money on the street.
poor.sentenceTrans: 这个可怜的无家可归的男人在街上乞讨。

pop.definition: 砰的一声爆破声；流行音乐，流行歌曲；汽水；  v.发出（砰的响声）；  adj.流行的，大众的
pop.sentence: I hit it with the car door yesterday. And I heard a pop, and then some sloshing(晃动的) sound when I walk.
pop.sentenceTrans: 我昨天用车门撞到它了。然后我听到“砰”的一声，之后我走路的时候就听到一些晃动的声音。

popular.definition: 大众喜爱的，广受欢迎的；大众的，流行的
popular.definitionEn: liked or enjoyed by a large number of people
popular.sentence: This guy is so popular. He received thousands of "likes" on social media.
popular.sentenceTrans: 这个人非常受欢迎，他在社交媒体上收到了数千个“赞”。
popular.mnemonic: popul=people人 + ar形容词后缀 → 被很多人喜欢的 → popular受欢迎的

popularity.definitionEn: the state of being liked, enjoyed or supported by a large number of people
popularity.mnemonic: popul人民 + ar……的 + popular流行的 + ity表名词 → popularity流行

population.definitionEn: all the people who live in a particular area, city or country; the total number of people who live there; a particular group of people or animals living in a particular area
population.sentence: The world population is about eight billion.
population.mnemonic: popul人民 + ation表示行为、状态 → population全体居民，人口

porcelain.definitionEn: a hard white shiny substance made by baking clay and used for making delicate cups, plates and decorative objects; objects that are made of this
porcelain.sentence: I use a porcelain pot to serve my tea.

pork.definitionEn: meat from a pig that has not been cured (= preserved using salt or smoke)
pork.sentence: I bought some pork from the supermarket.

port.definitionEn: a place where ships load and unload goods or shelter from storms
port.sentence: There are hundreds of containers in the port.
port.sentenceTrans: 港口有成百上千的集装箱。

portable.definitionEn: that is easy to carry or to move
portable.sentence: I prefer portable computers—they're more convenient.
portable.sentenceTrans: 我更喜欢手提电脑——它们更方便。
portable.mnemonic: port拿，运 + able能…的 → portable可携带的

portion.definition: 一部分；  v.把……分成若干份
portion.definitionEn: one part of something larger; an amount of food that is large enough for one person; a part of something that is shared with other people
portion.sentence: Every month the couple manage to save a small portion of their salaries.
portion.sentenceTrans: 这对夫妇每个月都设法从他们的工资里省下一小部分钱。
portion.mnemonic: port + ion名词后缀 → portion一部分

portrait.definitionEn: a painting, drawing or photograph of a person, especially of the head and shoulders; a detailed description of somebody/something
portrait.sentence: This is a portrait of a man.

pose.definition: 姿势；  v.造成，形成；  v.引起；  v.摆造型
pose.definitionEn: a particular position in which somebody stands, sits, etc., especially in order to be painted, drawn or photographed
pose.sentence: She makes a cute pose for the camera.
pose.sentenceTrans: 她对着镜头做了一个可爱的姿势。
pose.mnemonic: pos放 + e → 摆放造型 → pose姿势

position.definition: 姿势；职位；位置；地位；  v.安置
position.definitionEn: the place where somebody/something is located
position.sentence: He says he thinks better in that position, but I'm not so sure he does.
position.sentenceTrans: 他说他保持那种姿势时能更好地思考，但是我不是很确定他能做到。
position.mnemonic: posit放(本身是一个单词，意为“认为，肯定”) + ion名词后缀 → 放出的[立场] → position立场

positive.definitionEn: thinking about what is good in a situation: feeling confident and sure that something good will happen; completely sure that something is correct or true; directed at dealing with something or producing a successful result; showing clear evidence that a particular substance or medical condition is present
positive.sentence: He faces every situation with a positive attitude.
positive.sentenceTrans: 不管面对什么情形，他的心态都很积极。
positive.mnemonic: posit肯定 + ive形容词后缀 → positive肯定的；积极的

possess.definitionEn: to have or own something; to have a particular quality or feature
possess.sentence: She finally possesses an apartment of her own.
possess.sentenceTrans: 她终于拥有了属于自己的公寓。
possess.mnemonic: pos有权力的 + sess坐下 → possess拥有

possession.definitionEn: something that you own or have with you at a particular time; the state of having or owning something
possession.sentence: My house is my most expensive possession.
possession.sentenceTrans: 我的房子是我最贵重的财产。
possession.mnemonic: pos能 + sess坐 + ion表名词，构成抽象名词 → 能坐在上面 → possession拥有

possibility.definitionEn: one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation
possibility.sentence: The possibility that I grab the black ball is fifty percent.
possibility.sentenceTrans: 我抓到黑球的可能性是50%。
possibility.mnemonic: poss可能 + ibility表名词 → possibility可能；可能的事

possible.definition: 可能的；可能发生、存在的
possible.definitionEn: that can be done or achieved; that might exist or happen but is not certain to
possible.sentence: The base tries to find out if it's possible there are aliens in the universe.
possible.sentenceTrans: 这个基地试图弄清宇宙中是否有外星人存在。
possible.mnemonic: poss能够的 + ible能...的，表形容词 → possible可能的

possibly.definitionEn: used to say something might happen, exist, or be true but is not certain
possibly.sentence: Possibly, I can really get a surprise!
possibly.sentenceTrans: 也许我真的可以得到一个惊喜！
possibly.mnemonic: poss可能 + ibly...地 → possibly可能地；也许

post.definition: 邮寄；公布；  n.邮政；职位
post.definitionEn: to send a letter, etc. to somebody by post/mail
post.mnemonic: po向前 + st使稳固，站立 → 直立的事物 → post柱，岗位

postage.definitionEn: the cost of sending a letter, etc. by post
postage.sentence: The postage depends on the weight of your goods.
postage.sentenceTrans: 邮费由你的物品重量决定。
postage.mnemonic: post邮件，邮政 + age表状态 → 邮寄需要费用 → postage邮资

postcard.definitionEn: a card used for sending messages by post without an envelope, especially one that has a picture on one side
postcard.sentence: My sister always sends me a postcard from whatever new country she visits.
postcard.sentenceTrans: 我姐姐每新到一个国家都会给我寄明信片。
postcard.mnemonic: post邮件，邮政 + card卡片 → 邮寄的卡片 → postcard明信片

poster.definitionEn: a large notice, often with a picture on it, that is put in a public place to advertise something; a large picture that is printed on paper and put on a wall as decoration
poster.sentence: They are hanging up a poster.
poster.mnemonic: post招贴，海报 + er名词后缀 → poster招贴画，海报

postman.definitionEn: a man whose job is to collect and deliver letters, etc.
postman.sentence: It's the postman with some love letters—or are they bills?
postman.sentenceTrans: 邮递员手里拿的是情书还是账单呢？
postman.mnemonic: post邮件，邮政 + man人 → postman邮递员

postpone.definitionEn: to arrange for an event, etc. to take place at a later time or date
postpone.sentence: I need to postpone my to-do lists.
postpone.sentenceTrans: 我需要推迟我的待办事项。
postpone.mnemonic: post在后面 + pon放 + e → 放到后面 → postpone推迟

posture.definition: 姿势；看法；态度；  v.装模作样
posture.definitionEn: the position in which you hold your body when standing or sitting
posture.sentence: My mom always told me to keep a straight posture.
posture.sentenceTrans: 我妈妈总提醒我保持挺直的姿势。
posture.mnemonic: pos放置，摆放 + ture名词后缀 → 摆出的姿势 → posture姿势，姿态

pot.definition: 锅；（陶）罐，（陶）壶，瓶；容器；  v.把...栽入盆中
pot.definitionEn: a deep round container used for cooking things in; a container made of glass, clay or plastic, used for storing food in; (especially in compounds) a container of various kinds, made for a particular purpose; a bowl, etc. that is made by a potter
pot.sentence: He could hear the pot bubbling on the stove.
pot.sentenceTrans: 他能听到炉子上的锅冒泡的声音。

potato.definitionEn: a round root of a plant that has brown, yellow, or red skin and white or yellow flesh and that is eaten as a vegetable
potato.sentence: There are several fresh potatoes in the field.
potato.sentenceTrans: 田里有几个新鲜的土豆。

potential.definition: 潜力，潜能；  adj.潜在的，可能的
potential.definitionEn: that can develop into something or be developed in the future
potential.sentence: Just like the pony, we all have the potential to improve.
potential.sentenceTrans: 正如这匹小马一样，我们都有进步的潜力。
potential.mnemonic: potent能力，动力 + ial……的 → 由“能力”引申为“潜力” → potential潜力

pound.definition: 英镑；  v.（连续）猛击，捣碎
pound.definitionEn: the unit of money in the UK, worth 100 pence; a unit for measuring weight, equal to 0.454 of a kilogram
pound.sentence: Pound sterling is the national currency of the United Kingdom.
pound.sentenceTrans: 英镑是英国的国家货币。

pour.definitionEn: to make a liquid or other substance flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle; (of liquid, smoke, light, etc.) to flow quickly in a continuous stream; to serve a drink by letting it flow from a container into a cup or glass
pour.sentence: The milk is being poured into the glass.
pour.sentenceTrans: 牛奶正被倒进玻璃杯里。

poverty.sentence: Many people live in poverty nowadays.
poverty.sentenceTrans: 现今有很多人生活在贫困之中。

powder.definition: 粉末；细面；  v.抹粉；洒粉于，使变成粉
powder.definitionEn: a dry mass of very small fine pieces or grains
powder.sentence: The white powder is flour which can be used to make bread.
powder.sentenceTrans: 这种白色的粉末是面粉，可以用来做面包。

power.definition: 力量；权力；幂；  v.提供动力
power.definitionEn: physical strength used in action; physical strength that somebody possesses and might use
power.sentence: He has great power to lift such a heavy barbell.
power.sentenceTrans: 他力气很大，能举起如此重的杠铃。

powerful.definition: 强有力的，强大的；有权势的，有影响力的；很有效的
powerful.definitionEn: being able to produce great physical force; having the ability to control or influence people or things
powerful.sentence: He lifts us up easily with his powerful arms.
powerful.sentenceTrans: 他用强健的手臂轻松地把我们举起来了。
powerful.mnemonic: power力量 + ful表形容词，“有…的” → powerful有力的

practical.definition: 实用的，可行的；实际的，实践的
practical.definitionEn: (of a person) good at making or repairing things
practical.sentence: Sneakers are more practical than boots for runners.
practical.sentenceTrans: 对于跑步者来说，运动鞋比靴子更实用。
practical.mnemonic: pract实践 + ical…的 → 实践的 → practical实践的

practice.definitionEn: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill
practice.sentence: The little girl practices yoga with her mom every day.
practice.sentenceTrans: 小女孩每天都和妈妈一起练习瑜伽。
practice.mnemonic: pract实践 + ice表名词，行为，状态 → practice实践

practise.definitionEn: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill
practise.sentence: You had better practise for your big fight tomorrow!
practise.sentenceTrans: 你最好为明天的大决战练习。

praise.definition: 赞扬；赞扬，歌颂；  n.称赞，表扬
praise.definitionEn: to express your approval or admiration for somebody/something
praise.sentence: She was happy because her boss praised her.
praise.sentenceTrans: 她很开心，因为她的老板表扬了她。

pray.definition: 祈祷，祈求，企盼；请求，恳求
pray.definitionEn: to speak to God, especially to give thanks or ask for help
pray.sentence: She prays for lifelong health and well-being for herself and her family.
pray.sentenceTrans: 她祈祷自己和家人一生平安顺遂。

precaution.definitionEn: something that is done in advance in order to prevent problems or to avoid danger
precaution.sentence: We wear masks as a precaution against catching a cold.
precaution.sentenceTrans: 我们戴口罩来预防感冒。
precaution.mnemonic: pre…前的，预先 + caution小心 → 预先小心 → precaution预防措施

precede.definition: 发生在……之前，先于；在前面，领先
precede.definitionEn: to happen or exist before something or someone, or to come before something else in a series
precede.sentence: Dinner was preceded by a short prayer.
precede.sentenceTrans: 吃饭前先进行一个简短的祈祷。
precede.mnemonic: pre在...之前 + cede去，走 → precede先于

preceding.definitionEn: to happen before something or come before something/somebody in order; to go in front of somebody
preceding.sentence: Click this button to browse the preceding text.
preceding.sentenceTrans: 点击这个按钮以浏览前文。
preceding.mnemonic: pre预先 + ced走 + ing形容词后缀，…的 → preceding在前的，在先的

precious.definitionEn: rare and worth a lot of money; valuable or important and not to be wasted
precious.sentence: Precious gems like diamonds are very valuable.
precious.sentenceTrans: 钻石之类的珍贵宝石是很贵重的。
precious.mnemonic: prec价值 + ious形容词后缀 → 有价值的 → precious珍贵的

precise.sentenceTrans: 这台仪器显示出精确的测量结果。
precise.mnemonic: pre…前的，预先 + cise切 → 预先切好的 → precise精确的

precisely.definitionEn: exactly: used to confirm a statement by someone else
precisely.sentence: This device can precisely measure the diameter of the bolt.
precisely.sentenceTrans: 这个仪器能精确地测量出这个螺栓的直径。
precisely.mnemonic: precise精确 ＋ ly...地 → precise提前切开=精确的 ＋ ly...地 → precisely精确地

precision.definitionEn: the quality of being exact, accurate and careful
precision.sentence: This is a precision tool for measurements.
precision.sentenceTrans: 这个仪器用于精密测量。
precision.mnemonic: pre预先 + cis切 + ion表名词 → 预先切好 → 精密，正确

predict.definitionEn: to say that something will happen in the future
predict.sentence: He predicted this stock would experience an increase in a few days.
predict.sentenceTrans: 他预测该股票过几天会涨。
predict.mnemonic: pre…前的，预先 + dict说 → 预先说 → 预言

prediction.definitionEn: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement
prediction.sentence: The manager showed his prediction for the year to his team.
prediction.sentenceTrans: 经理向他的团队展示了他对今年情况的预测。
prediction.mnemonic: pre预先 + dict说预言 + ion名词 → prediction预告

preface.definitionEn: an introduction to a book, especially one that explains the author’s aims
preface.sentence: The book's preface was a good introduction to the main text.
preface.sentenceTrans: 书的前言是对主要内容的一个很好的介绍。
preface.mnemonic: pre前面 + face脸，面 → 前脸 → preface前言，序言

prefer.definitionEn: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better
prefer.sentence: The girl prefers vegetables to cake.
prefer.sentenceTrans: 比起蛋糕，小女孩更喜欢蔬菜。
prefer.mnemonic: pre预先 + fer拿，携带 → 预先带好 → prefer更喜欢

preferable.definitionEn: more attractive or more suitable; to be preferred to something
preferable.sentence: Rice is acceptable, but fish is preferable!
preferable.sentenceTrans: 吃米饭是可以接受的，但是吃鱼当然更好！
preferable.mnemonic: prefer更喜欢 ＋ able…的 → preferable更好的

preference.definitionEn: a greater interest in or desire for somebody/something than somebody/something else
preference.sentence: I have a preference for fruits over sweets.
preference.sentenceTrans: 比起糖果，我更喜欢水果。
preference.mnemonic: pre预先 + fer带来，拿来 + ence名词后缀 → 预先带来的行为 → 偏爱，优先权

prejudice.definition: 偏见，成见；  v.使抱有偏见
prejudice.definitionEn: an unfair feeling of dislike for a person or group because of race, sex, religion, etc.
prejudice.sentence: The other elephants held a prejudice against him because of his giant ears.
prejudice.sentenceTrans: 其他大象因他的大耳朵而对其抱有偏见。
prejudice.mnemonic: pre预先 + judice判断 → 预先判断 → 偏见

preliminary.definitionEn: happening before a more important action or event
preliminary.sentence: The preliminary drawings of the building are already finished.
preliminary.sentenceTrans: 建筑的初步图稿已经完成。
preliminary.mnemonic: pre预先 + limin门槛，限制 + ary形容词后缀 → 入门以前 → preliminary初步的

preparation.definitionEn: the act or process of getting ready for something or making something ready
preparation.sentence: She made a lot of preparation for the unborn baby.
preparation.sentenceTrans: 她为还没出生的宝宝做了很多准备。
preparation.mnemonic: prepar = prepare准备 ＋ ation名词后缀 → preparation准备

prepare.definition: 准备（食物、物品）；使做好准备；把......预备好
prepare.definitionEn: to make something or somebody ready to be used or to do something
prepare.sentence: Dad helps me prepare my school bag every morning.
prepare.sentenceTrans: 爸爸每天早上帮我准备书包。
prepare.mnemonic: pre预先 + pare准备 → 预先准备预先准备好 → prepare准备

prescribe.definitionEn: (of a doctor) to tell somebody to take a particular medicine or have a particular treatment; to write a prescription for a particular medicine, etc.
prescribe.sentence: The doctor prescribed me some medicine for my cold.
prescribe.sentenceTrans: 医生针对我的感冒给我开了一些药。
prescribe.mnemonic: pre预先 + scribe写 → 预先写好药量 → prescribe开药方；命令

prescription.definitionEn: an official piece of paper on which a doctor writes the type of medicine you should have, and which enables you to get it from a chemist’s shop/drugstore
prescription.sentence: You can pick up your prescription at the pharmacy after your consultation.
prescription.sentenceTrans: 看完医生后，你可以去药房拿处方药。
prescription.mnemonic: pre预先 + script写 + ion名词后缀 → prescription处方

presence.definitionEn: the fact of being in a particular place; the state of being present
presence.sentence: Every morning the teacher checks the presence of students in class.
presence.sentenceTrans: 老师每天早上都在课堂上检查学生的出勤情况。
presence.mnemonic: pres前 + ence名词后缀 → presence出席，到场

present.definition: 礼物，赠品（读作/ˈprezənt/）；  v.颁发，授予（/prɪˈzent/）；  adj.出席的/ˈprezənt/
present.definitionEn: something that you give to someone especially as a way of showing affection or thanks
present.sentence: The girl gave me a carefully wrapped present.
present.sentenceTrans: 女孩给了我一份精心包装好的礼物。
present.mnemonic: pres前 + ent名词后缀 → present礼物，赠送物

preserve.definition: 贮存，保鲜；保存；保护；  n.保护区
preserve.definitionEn: to keep a particular quality, feature, etc.; to make sure that something is kept
preserve.sentence: You can preserve food by putting it into the refrigerator.
preserve.sentenceTrans: 你可以把食物放进冰箱保鲜。
preserve.mnemonic: pre预先 + serve保持 → 预先保留 → preserve保存

president.definition: 总统；院长；会长，校长；总裁
president.definitionEn: the head of the government in some countries
president.sentence: All of them are American presidents.
president.mnemonic: presid=preside主持，担任主席 + ent人 → president总统

press.definition: （尤指用手）按，压；  n.新闻界；出版社
press.definitionEn: to push something closely and firmly against something; to be pushed in this way; to push or squeeze part of a device, etc. in order to make it work
press.sentence: Press the button on the phone to make a call.
press.sentenceTrans: 按电话上的按键来打电话。

pressure.definition: 压力；压迫，[物] 压强；  v.对……施加压力
pressure.definitionEn: difficulties and feelings of anxiety that are caused by the need to achieve or to behave in a particular way
pressure.sentence: The pressure of the giant pear is unbearable.
pressure.sentenceTrans: 这个大梨的压力实在是难以承受。
pressure.mnemonic: press挤压 + ure名词后缀，表行为、状态 → pressure压力

pretend.definitionEn: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe something that is not true; (especially of children) to imagine that something is true as part of a game;  (usually used in negative sentences and questions) to claim to be, do or have something, especially when this is not true
pretend.sentence: I pretended to study hard, but actually I chatted on my phone.
pretend.sentenceTrans: 我假装很努力地学习，但是实际上我在手机上聊天。
pretend.mnemonic: pre提前 + tend延伸 → 提前伸出想好借口 → pretend假装，借口

pretty.definition: 漂亮的，俊俏的；  adv.很，颇，相当
pretty.definitionEn: (especially of a woman, or a girl) attractive without being very beautiful
pretty.sentence: I'm the most loyal fan of these pretty boys.
pretty.sentenceTrans: 我是这几个俊俏的男孩最忠实的粉丝。

prevail.definitionEn: to exist or be very common at a particular time or in a particular place; (of ideas, opinions, etc.) to be accepted, especially after a struggle or an argument
prevail.sentence: "Hah! I've finally prevailed!" shouted the girl in red.
prevail.sentenceTrans: “哈！我终于赢了！”红衣女大叫道。
prevail.mnemonic: pre预先 + vail强壮 → 能够领先强壮者的获胜 → prevail胜，优胜

prevent.definitionEn: to stop somebody from doing something; to stop something from happening
prevent.sentence: The mother prevented her child from eating sweets.
prevent.sentenceTrans: 妈妈不让她的小孩吃糖。
prevent.mnemonic: pre预先 + vent来 → 抢先一步，防止别人 → prevent防止，阻止

previous.definitionEn: happening or existing before the event or object that you are talking about
previous.sentence: People no longer use the old fashioned devices used in previous times.
previous.sentenceTrans: 人们不再使用以前的老式设备。
previous.mnemonic: pre以前 + vi路[引申为走] + ous……的 → 以前走过的 → previous先的，前的

previously.definitionEn: at an earlier time or formerly
previously.sentence: This place was previously a wasteland.
previously.sentenceTrans: 这个地方以前是一片荒地。

price.definitionEn: the amount of money that you pay for something or that something costs
price.sentence: I like to go shopping during sales when the prices are low.
price.sentenceTrans: 我喜欢在打折的时候去买东西，那个时候价格很便宜。

pride.definition: 自豪；骄傲；  v.使得意；为……自豪
pride.definitionEn: a feeling of pleasure or satisfaction that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done something well or own something that other people admire
pride.sentence: The parents took pride in their son's graduation.
pride.sentenceTrans: 父母为儿子的毕业感到很自豪。

primarily.sentence: The air is primarily made up of Nitrogen.
primarily.sentenceTrans: 空气主要是由氮气构成的。

primary.definition: 初等教育的；最初的；首要的；  n.首选；<美>初选
primary.definitionEn: connected with the education of children between the ages of about five and eleven
primary.sentence: Children usually go to primary school at the age of 6.
primary.sentenceTrans: 通常小孩子6岁就上小学了。
primary.mnemonic: prim第一，主要的 + ary形容词后缀 → 第一的，最开始的 → primary最初的；根本的

prime.definition: 最好的，一流的；首要的，主要的
prime.sentence: Our number one priority is to offer our guests prime service.
prime.sentenceTrans: 我们的首要任务是给客人提供最好的服务。
prime.mnemonic: prim第一，主要的 + e → prime首要的

primitive.definitionEn: belonging to an early stage in the development of humans or animals
primitive.sentence: Primitive men made fire by themselves since they had no electricity.
primitive.sentenceTrans: 原始人没有电，只能自己生火。
primitive.mnemonic: prim=prime最初的，原始的 + itive形容词后缀 → primitive原始的

prince.definitionEn: a male member of a royal family who is not king, especially the son or grandson of the king or queen
prince.sentence: Prince George is the second in line to the British throne.
prince.sentenceTrans: 乔治王子是英国王位的第二顺位继承人。

princess.definitionEn: a female member of a royal family who is not a queen, especially the daughter or granddaughter of the king or queen
princess.sentence: The princess had a pet pony.
princess.mnemonic: princ王子 + ess表示女性（人）或雌性（动物） → princess公主，王妃

principal.definition: 校长；【法】本金；  adj.主要的，首要的
principal.definitionEn: the person who is in charge of a college or a university; a teacher who is in charge of a school
principal.sentence: Our principal gives a speech at our graduation ceremony.
principal.sentenceTrans: 校长在我们的毕业典礼上致辞。
principal.mnemonic: prin主要的 + cip拿，抓，握住 + al形容词后缀 → principal主要的；首要的

principle.definitionEn: a moral rule or a strong belief that influences your actions; a general or scientific law that explains how something works or why something happens
principle.sentence: Our business success is based on four fundamental principles.
principle.sentenceTrans: 我们生意的成功基于四项基本原则。
principle.mnemonic: prin第一，首要 + ciple拿，抓紧 → principle原则

print.definition: 打印；印刷；  n.印刷行业
print.definitionEn: to produce letters, pictures, etc. on paper using a machine that puts ink on the surface
print.sentence: This machine can print any pattern.
print.sentenceTrans: 这台机器可以印刷出任何图案。

prior.definitionEn: more important than other claims or duties and needs to be dealt with first.
prior.sentence: At the crossroads, school buses have a prior right to pass.
prior.sentenceTrans: 在十字路口，校车有优先通行权。
prior.mnemonic: pr=pri先，前 + ior表形容词  → 较先的  → prior优先的；事先的

priority.definitionEn: something that you think is more important than other things and should be dealt with first
priority.sentence: These priority seats are reserved for the elderly, the disabled and pregnant women.
priority.sentenceTrans: 这些优先座位是留给老年人、残疾人和孕妇的。
priority.mnemonic: prior优先 + ity名词后缀 → priority优先（权），重点

prison.definitionEn: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime they have committed, or while they are waiting for trial
prison.sentence: This prison has been abandoned for many years.
prison.sentenceTrans: 这座监狱已被废弃多年了。
prison.mnemonic: pris拿住，抓住 + on表名词 → 抓人之地 → prison监狱

prisoner.definitionEn: a person who is kept in prison as a punishment, or while they are waiting for trial
prisoner.sentence: The people with the striped uniforms were kept as prisoners.
prisoner.sentenceTrans: 这些穿着条纹衣服的人是被关押的囚犯。
prisoner.mnemonic: prison监狱 ＋ er表示人，行为的主动者，做某事的人 → prisoner囚犯

privacy.definitionEn: the state of being alone and not watched or disturbed by other people
privacy.sentence: We can protect our personal privacy by enabling pin codes on our phones.
privacy.sentenceTrans: 我们可以通过给手机加密来保护我们的个人隐私。
privacy.mnemonic: priv单个 + acy名词后缀 → 个人的 → privacy隐私

private.definitionEn: belonging to or for the use of a particular person or group; not for public use
private.sentence: Do not enter! This is Mr. Dog's private property.
private.sentenceTrans: 禁止进入！这是狗先生的私人住宅。
private.mnemonic: priv个人的 + ate使成为 → 私人的

privilege.definitionEn: the rights and advantages that rich and powerful people in a society have; a special right or advantage that a particular person or group of people has
privilege.sentence: He enjoys the privilege of fast check-in at the airport he owns.
privilege.sentenceTrans: 他享有在他的机场里快速登机的特权。
privilege.mnemonic: privi单个 + lege法律 → 有个人法律 → privilege特权

prize.definition: 奖品，奖励；  adj.得奖的；  v.珍视
prize.definitionEn: an award that is given to a person who wins a competition, race, etc. or who does very good work
prize.sentence: Finally, he won the first prize.

probable.definitionEn: likely to happen, to exist or to be true
probable.sentence: The smaller dog is the probable one that damaged my shoes.
probable.sentenceTrans: 很有可能是这只体型较小的狗弄坏了我的鞋。
probable.mnemonic: prob测试，证明 + able能…的 → 能证明的 → probable可能的

probably.definition: 或许，大概；很可能，几乎肯定
probably.sentence: It will probably rain later, so I brought my umbrella.
probably.sentenceTrans: 一会儿很有可能要下雨，所以我带了雨伞。
probably.mnemonic: probab=probable可能的 + ly表副词 → probably或许，大概

problem.definitionEn: a thing that is difficult to deal with or to understand
problem.sentence: I need to ponder this problem carefully.
problem.sentenceTrans: 我需要仔细思考这个难题。
problem.mnemonic: pro向前 + blem扔，投掷 → 扔在前面，提出难题 → problem问题

procedure.definitionEn: a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way
procedure.sentence: There're three steps in the procedure of hot-dog production.
procedure.sentenceTrans: 热狗的生产过程包括三个步骤。
procedure.mnemonic: pro在前 + ced行走 + ure名词后缀 → 在前面走完的 → procedure程序；手续

proceed.definitionEn: to continue doing something that has already been started; to continue being done
proceed.sentence: The girl proceeded only after the traffic light turned green.
proceed.sentenceTrans: 绿灯亮起之后，这个女孩才开始往前走。
proceed.mnemonic: pro向前 + ceed行走，前进 → 向前走 → proceed前进

process.definition: 步骤，过程；进程；做事方法；工序；  v.加工；处理
process.definitionEn: a series of things that are done in order to achieve a particular result
process.sentence: Follow the process to create a cute paw-shaped ice cream.
process.sentenceTrans: 按照这个步骤来做可爱的爪爪冰激凌吧。

procession.definitionEn: an organized group or line of people or vehicles that move together slowly as part of a ceremony
procession.sentence: The procession of these yellow chickens seems endless.
procession.sentenceTrans: 这支由小黄鸡组成的队伍看起来没有尽头。
procession.mnemonic: pro 向前，在前 + cess 行走，前进 + ion 表示行为、过程或结果 → n.队伍，行列

proclaim.definitionEn: to publicly and officially tell people about something important
proclaim.sentence: He proclaimed the outcome of the negotiations on behalf of his company.
proclaim.sentenceTrans: 他代表公司宣告了谈判的结果。
proclaim.mnemonic: pro在前 + claim呼喊，叫喊 → 在前面喊 → proclaim公布

produce.definition: 产生（读作/prəˈdu:s/）；生产，制造；导致；  n.农产品（读作/ˈprɑːduːs/）
produce.definitionEn: to make things to be sold, especially in large quantities
produce.sentence: The picking of tomatoes grown by oneself produces a feeling of well-being.
produce.sentenceTrans: 采摘自己种的西红柿会产生一种幸福感。
produce.mnemonic: pro向前 + duce引导，带来 → 引向前 → produce生产

product.definition: 产品，制品；产物；产品，成果
product.definitionEn: a thing that is grown or produced, usually for sale
product.sentence: These products are made of milk.
product.sentenceTrans: 这些产品都是由牛奶制成的。
product.mnemonic: pro向前 + duct引导，带来 → 引出的东西 → product产物，产品

production.definitionEn: the process of growing or making food, goods or materials, especially large quantities
production.sentence: Thousands of cars are under production in this factory.
production.sentenceTrans: 数以千计的汽车在这家工厂进行生产。
production.mnemonic: product生产 + ion名词后缀 → production生产

productivity.definitionEn: the rate at which a worker, a company or a country produces goods, and the amount produced, compared with how much time, work and money is needed to produce them
productivity.sentence: The productivity of the machine is ten bottles a day.
productivity.sentenceTrans: 这台机器每天能生产十个瓶子。
productivity.mnemonic: product产品 ＋ ivity表名词 → productivity生产力，生产活动

profession.definitionEn: a type of job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education
profession.sentence: The four people have different professions.
profession.sentenceTrans: 这四个人有着不同的职业。
profession.mnemonic: pro在前面 + fess说 + ion表名词 → 在前面说话 → profession职业

professional.definition: 职业的；  n.专业人员；专业人士
professional.definitionEn: connected with a job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education; (of people) having a job which needs special training and a high level of education
professional.sentence: My parents want me to have a professional career, but which profession should I choose?
professional.sentenceTrans: 父母希望我步入职业生涯，但是我应该选哪个职业呢？
professional.mnemonic: profession职业 + al……的 → professional职业的

professor.definition: （学院或大学的）教员；（尤指高职称的）教授
professor.definitionEn: a teacher especially of the highest rank at a college or university
professor.sentence: The man standing in front of the whiteboard is a professor.
professor.sentenceTrans: 站在白板前的男人是一位教授。
professor.mnemonic: pro在前面 ＋ fess说 ＋ or人 → 在前面说话的人 → professor教授

proficient.definitionEn: able to do something well because of training and practice
proficient.sentence: Despite his young age, the boy is already proficient in seven languages.
proficient.sentenceTrans: 这个男孩小小年纪就精通七国语言。
proficient.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + fici做 + ent形容词后缀 → 做在别人前面 → proficient精通的

profit.definition: 利润，盈利；益处；  v.得益，有益于
profit.definitionEn: the money that you make in business or by selling things, especially after paying the costs involved
profit.sentence: His business is finally turning a profit.
profit.sentenceTrans: 他的生意终于开始盈利了。
profit.mnemonic: pro很多… + fit做 → 做很多 → profit利润，收益

profitable.sentence: Planting trees can be a profitable investment into your future.
profitable.sentenceTrans: 种植树木是一项对你的未来有利的投资。
profitable.mnemonic: pro前 + fit做，制作 + able能...的 → 能提前做好的 → profitable有利润的

profound.definition: 深刻的，深远的；渊博的；深奥的
profound.definitionEn: very great; felt or experienced very strongly
profound.sentence: Reading can bring a profound impact on one's development.
profound.sentenceTrans: 阅读对一个人的成长有着深刻的影响。
profound.mnemonic: pro前面 + found基础 → 有基础在前面 → profound有根基的，深刻的

program.definition: 程序；节目；  v.编写程序
program.definitionEn: a set of instructions in code that control the operations or functions of a computer; something that people watch on television or listen to on the radio; a plan of things that will be done or included in the development of something
program.sentence: Leave me alone! I'm trying to write a program on the computer.
program.sentenceTrans: 让我一个人待会儿！我正尝试在电脑上写代码。
program.mnemonic: pro在前 + gram写，图 → 在前面写好 → program计划；提纲

programme.definition: 节目，电视节目；计划；程序；  v.计划
programme.definitionEn: an organized order of performances or events
programme.sentence: The whole family is watching its favourite TV programme.
programme.sentenceTrans: 所有的家庭成员一起看着他们最爱的电视节目。
programme.mnemonic: pro很多 + gram写 + me → programme程序，编程

progress.definition: 进步；前进（读作/ˈprɑːɡres/）；  v.进展（读作/prəˈɡres/）；发展
progress.definitionEn: the process of improving or developing, or of getting nearer to achieving or completing something
progress.sentence: The chart showed that we were making progress, selling more every year.
progress.sentenceTrans: 这张图表说明我们在取得进步，销量一年高于一年。
progress.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + gress走 → 向前走 → progress进步

progressive.definition: 先进的；进步的；  n.进步人士
progressive.sentence: This hospital introduced progressive medical methods.
progressive.sentenceTrans: 这家医院引进了先进的医疗方法。
progressive.mnemonic: pro向前 + gress走 + ive表形容词 → progressive进步的

prohibit.definitionEn: to stop something from being done or used especially by law
prohibit.sentence: The law prohibits spitting in public.
prohibit.sentenceTrans: 该法令禁止在公共场合随地吐痰。
prohibit.mnemonic: pro向前，提前 + hibit拿住，握住 → 在前面拿住 → prohibit阻止，禁止

project.definition: 项目，工程，习作项目；  v.投射；计划，规划；突出，伸出
project.definitionEn: a planned piece of work that is designed to find information about something, to produce something new, or to improve something
project.sentence: The housing project is going on well as planned.
project.sentenceTrans: 这个住宅工程正在如期进展。
project.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + ject扔 → 扔向前面 → project投射

prominent.definitionEn: important and well-known; easily seen; sticking out from something
prominent.sentence: The statue in the plaza depicted a prominent figure from our school's history.
prominent.sentenceTrans: 广场上的雕像刻画的是我们学校历史上一位杰出人物。
prominent.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + min伸 + ent形容词后缀 → 向前伸出 → prominent杰出的

promise.definition: 诺言；成功的迹象；吉兆；  v.预示
promise.definitionEn: a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future
promise.sentence: We make a promise by pulling each other's little finger.
promise.mnemonic: pro前面 + mise送，放出 → 在做事前送出的话 → promise承诺，允诺

promote.definitionEn: to move somebody to a higher rank or more senior job
promote.sentence: He was very good at his job, so his boss promoted him to a higher position.
promote.sentenceTrans: 他工作表现很棒，所以他的老板让他升职了。
promote.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + mot动 + e → 向前动 → promote促进

promotion.definition: 提拔，晋升；提升；促销；促进
promotion.definitionEn: a move to a more important job or rank in a company or an organization
promotion.sentence: He got a promotion and is now the CEO of the company.
promotion.sentenceTrans: 他在工作中得到了晋升，现在是这家公司的首席执行官。
promotion.mnemonic: pro向前 + mot移动 + ion名词后缀 → 促进；升级

prompt.definition: 敦促，促使，激励；  adj.迅速的，及时的；  n.提示
prompt.definitionEn: to encourage somebody to speak by asking them questions or suggesting words that they could say; to make somebody decide to do something; to cause something to happen;
prompt.sentence: My phone prompts me to get out of bed and finish my paper!
prompt.sentenceTrans: 我的手机敦促我起床写论文！
prompt.mnemonic: pro先，前 + mpt=empt拿 → 最先拿到的 → prompt迅速的，及时的

pronoun.definitionEn: a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, for example he, it, hers, me, them, etc.
pronoun.sentence: If you don't want to say a name, you can just use a pronoun like "he" or "him".
pronoun.sentenceTrans: 如果你不想说名字，你可以只用“他”这种代词。
pronoun.mnemonic: pro代替 + noun名字，名词 → pronoun代词

pronounce.definitionEn: to make the sound of a word or letter in a particular way
pronounce.sentence: Open your mouth wide when you pronounce this sound.
pronounce.sentenceTrans: 发这个音时，嘴巴要张大。
pronounce.mnemonic: pro在前 + nounce讲话，说出 → 在嘴前讲话 → pronounce发音

pronunciation.definitionEn: the way in which a language or a particular word or sound is pronounced
pronunciation.sentence: These different mouth shapes can help us practice our pronunciation.
pronunciation.sentenceTrans: 这些不同的嘴型能够帮助我们练习发音。
pronunciation.mnemonic: pro在前 + nunci讲话，说出 + ation名词后缀 → pronunciation发音

proof.definitionEn: information, documents, etc. that show that something is true; the process of testing whether something is true or a fact; a way of proving that a statement is true or that what you have calculated is correct; a copy of printed material which is produced so that mistakes can be corrected
proof.sentence: The surveillance cameras provided clear proof of many cases.
proof.sentenceTrans: 监控摄像头为许多案件提供了明确的证据。
