proper.definitionEn: right, appropriate or correct; according to the rules
proper.sentence: You should wear a proper outfit at a cocktail party.
proper.sentenceTrans: 你要选一套合适的服装去参加鸡尾酒会。

properly.definitionEn: in a way that is acceptable or suitable
properly.sentence: It's important to adjust your sitting posture properly.
properly.sentenceTrans: 适当地调整坐姿很重要。
properly.mnemonic: proper恰当的 + ly...地 → properly正确地；恰当地

property.definitionEn: land and buildings; a building or buildings and the surrounding land
property.sentence: He had finally saved enough money to buy a property.
property.sentenceTrans: 他终于攒了足够的钱来置办一处房产。
property.mnemonic: proper拥有 + ty名词后缀 → 个人拥有的 → property房产

proportion.definition: 比例；部分；相称；  v.使成比例；分配
proportion.definitionEn: a part or share of a whole
proportion.sentence: The proportion shows we should eat more vegetables and fruits to keep healthy.
proportion.sentenceTrans: 该比例显示，我们应该多吃蔬菜和水果来保持健康。
proportion.mnemonic: pro前面 + port 部分，分开 + ion名词后缀 → 成分其中一部分 → proportion比例

proposal.definitionEn: an act of formally asking somebody to marry you
proposal.sentence: That guy made a proposal to his girlfriend with a diamond ring.
proposal.sentenceTrans: 那位男士手拿钻戒，向他的女朋友求婚。
proposal.mnemonic: pro向前 + pos放 + al名词后缀 → 向前放 → proposal提建议

propose.definitionEn: to ask someone to marry you
propose.sentence: He sincerely proposed a date, hoping to ring in the New Year with the girl.
propose.sentenceTrans: 他真诚地提议约会，希望能与女孩一起迎接新年。
propose.mnemonic: pro向前 + pose放置 → 向前呈，呈出 → propose提出，提议

prospect.definition: 前景，展望；希望；  v.勘探
prospect.sentence: She has excellent career prospects with her diverse skills and experience.
prospect.sentenceTrans: 凭借多样的技能和经验，她拥有广阔的职业前景。
prospect.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + spect看 → 向前看 → prospect前景

prosper.definitionEn: to develop in a successful way; to be successful, especially in making money
prosper.sentence: With more and more wealth and development, the city continues to prosper.
prosper.sentenceTrans: 随着越来越多的财富和发展机会，城市持续繁荣。
prosper.mnemonic: pro前面 + sper希望 → 希望在前面 → prosper繁荣

prosperity.definitionEn: the state of being successful, especially in making money
prosperity.sentence: Economic policies focused on innovation can lead to national prosperity.
prosperity.sentenceTrans: 专注于创新的经济政策能带来国家繁荣。
prosperity.mnemonic: prosper繁荣 + ity表名词 → prosperity繁荣昌盛

prosperous.sentence: We are fortunate to live in a prosperous country where opportunities abound and peace is taken for granted.
prosperous.sentenceTrans: 我们很幸运，生活在一个充满机遇、繁荣富强的国家，安宁和谐已是寻常。
prosperous.mnemonic: pro向前 ＋ sper希望 ＋ ous形容词后缀 → 带着希望向前 → prosperous兴旺的

protect.definitionEn: to make sure that somebody/something is not harmed, injured, damaged, etc.
protect.sentence: Builders should wear professional equipment to protect themselves.
protect.sentenceTrans: 建筑工人需要穿着专业装备来保护自己。
protect.mnemonic: pro在前面 + tect盖上，保护 → 在前面盖上 → protect保护；防止

protection.definitionEn: the act of protecting somebody/something; the state of being protected
protection.sentence: Everyone should get involved in environmental protection.
protection.sentenceTrans: 每个人都应该投身到环境保护工作中来。
protection.mnemonic: protect保护，防止 + ion表名词 → protection保护

protective.definitionEn: providing or intended to provide protection; having or showing a wish to protect somebody/something; intended to give an advantage to your own country’s industry
protective.sentence: Construction workers must wear protective equipment.
protective.sentenceTrans: 建筑工人必须穿戴防护装备。
protective.mnemonic: protect保护 + ive形容词后缀 → protective保护的，防护的

protein.definitionEn: a substance, found within all living things, that forms the structure of muscles, organs, etc. There are many different proteins and they are an essential part of what humans and animals eat to help them grow and stay healthy.
protein.sentence: You can get protein from eggs, beans, and meat.
protein.sentenceTrans: 你可以从鸡蛋、豆类以及肉类中获取蛋白质。
protein.mnemonic: prote第一的，原本的 + in化学中的构词成分 → 化学物质中基础的成分 → protein蛋白质

protest.definition: 抗议；反对（读作/proʊˈtɛst/）；  n.抗议（读作/ˈproʊˌtɛst/）
protest.definitionEn: to say or do something to show that you disagree with or disapprove of something, especially publicly
protest.sentence: Raising fists and flags is a symbol of protesting something.
protest.sentenceTrans: 举起拳头和旗帜是抗议的一种标志。
protest.mnemonic: pro在前面 + test证据 → 向前作证 → protest抗议，坚决声明

proud.definitionEn: feeling pleased and satisfied about something that you own or have done, or are connected with
proud.sentence: He's proud of himself because everyone thinks he did a great job!
proud.sentenceTrans: 他为自己骄傲，因为大家都觉得他做得很棒！

prove.definitionEn: to use facts, evidence, etc. to show that something is true
prove.sentence: It takes one second to say "I do," but a lifetime to prove it.
prove.sentenceTrans: 说一句“我愿意”只用一秒，可证明它却需要一辈子。
prove.mnemonic: pro在前面 + ve成为 → 成为先决条件，以证实某事存在 → prove证明，证实

proverb.definitionEn: a well-known phrase or sentence that gives advice or says something that is generally true, for example ‘Waste not, want not.’
proverb.sentence: The dog chasing the mouse reminded the old man of a Chinese proverb.
proverb.sentenceTrans: 狗追老鼠的场景使这位老人想起了一句中国谚语。
proverb.mnemonic: pro前面 + verb词语 → 古人的言语 → proverb谚语

provide.definitionEn: to give something to somebody or make it available for them to use; (of a law or rule) to state that something will or must happen
provide.sentenceTrans: 这家餐厅提供免费果汁。
provide.mnemonic: pro提前 + vid看 + e → 提前看好 → provide预备；提供

provided.definition: 如果，以……为条件；  v.提供（provide的过去式）
provided.definitionEn: used to say what must happen or be done to make it possible for something else to happen
provided.sentence: You may watch TV, provided your homework is finished first.
provided.sentenceTrans: 如果你先把家庭作业做完，你就可以看电视了。

province.definition: 省；领域，部门；知识(或职责)范围
province.definitionEn: any of the main divisions of some countries, and forms a separate whole for purposes of government control
province.sentence: This is a famous tourist spot in Sichuan Province.
province.sentenceTrans: 这是四川省的一处著名旅游景点。
province.mnemonic: pro向前，在前 + vinc征服 + e → province被向前征服了的（土地）→ 省；领域

provision.definition: 必需品；（法律等的）条款；预备，存粮；规定
provision.definitionEn: the act of supplying somebody with something that they need or want; something that is supplied
provision.sentence: We set out with enough provisions to last the trip.
provision.sentenceTrans: 我们带上足够维持整场旅行的必需品后就出发了。
provision.mnemonic: pro提前 + vis看 + ion名词后缀 → provision预备

psychological.definitionEn: connected with a person’s mind and the way in which it works; connected with the study of psychology
psychological.sentence: The professor is explaining a famous psychological experiment to his students.
psychological.sentenceTrans: 教授正在向学生们解释一个著名的心理学实验。
psychological.mnemonic: psycho=psych灵魂 + logical…学的 → psychological心理的，心理学的

psychology.definitionEn: the scientific study of the mind and how it influences behaviour
psychology.sentence: I study psychology to learn about how people think.
psychology.sentenceTrans: 我学心理学是为了了解人们如何思考。
psychology.mnemonic: psych灵魂 + ology……学 → psychology心理学，心理状态

public.definitionEn: not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
public.sentence: The public are gathering on the street.
public.mnemonic: publ人民 + ic...的 → public公开的，公众的

publication.definitionEn: the act of printing a book, a magazine, etc. and making it available to the public; a book, a magazine, etc. that has been published
publication.sentence: Once the publication process is complete, the book will be available to buy.
publication.sentenceTrans: 出版流程一完成，就可以买到这本书了。
publication.mnemonic: public公众的 + ation名词后缀 → 让公众都看到 → publication出版

publicly.definitionEn: in a manner accessible to or observable by the public; openly
publicly.sentence: He delivered his speech publicly to spread the information.
publicly.sentenceTrans: 他公开发表演讲来传播信息。

publish.definitionEn: to produce a book, magazine, CD-ROM, etc. and sell it to the public; to print a letter, an article, etc. in a newspaper or magazine
publish.sentence: She hopes that her book will be published so everyone can buy it.
publish.sentenceTrans: 她希望自己的书能够出版，这样每个人都可以购买。
publish.mnemonic: publ公众 + ish动词后缀 → 使面向公众 → publish出版

pull.definitionEn: to hold something firmly and use force in order to move it or try to move it towards yourself
pull.sentence: She pulls the woman toward her.
pull.sentenceTrans: 她把那名女子拉向自己。

pulse.definition: 脉搏；（电子）脉冲；  v.（使）跳动，搏动，震动
pulse.definitionEn: the regular beat of blood as it is sent around the body, especially on the inside part of the wrist
pulse.sentence: The doctor takes the patient's pulse to determine her illness.
pulse.sentenceTrans: 医生通过把脉来判断病人的病情。

punch.definitionEn: a hard hit made with the fist (= closed hand)
punch.sentence: She punched her opponent fiercely in the face.
punch.sentenceTrans: 她用拳头猛击对手的脸。

punctual.definitionEn: happening or doing something at the arranged or correct time; not late
punctual.sentence: I'm always punctual; I'm never late for work.
punctual.sentenceTrans: 我总是很守时，上班从来不迟到。
punctual.mnemonic: punct点 + ual…的 → 总能踩准点的 → punctual严守时刻的；准时的

punish.definitionEn: to make somebody suffer because they have broken the law or done something wrong
punish.sentence: He punished the player by showing the red card.
punish.sentenceTrans: 他亮出红牌以惩罚一名球员。
punish.mnemonic: pun处罚 + ish动词后缀 → punish惩罚

punishment.definitionEn: the act of punishing someone or a way of punishing someone
punishment.sentence: A harsh punishment can do more harm than good.
punishment.sentenceTrans: 严厉的惩罚会弊大于利。
punishment.mnemonic: punish惩罚 + ment表名词 → punishment处罚

pupil.definitionEn: a person who is being taught, especially a child in a school
pupil.sentence: The pupils are walking to school.

purchase.definition: 购买；  n.购买；购买的东西
purchase.sentence: The shirt is so cheap that I really want to purchase it.
purchase.sentenceTrans: 这件T恤太便宜了，我真的想买。
purchase.mnemonic: pur向前 + chase追逐 → purchase购买

pure.definitionEn: not mixed with anything else, with nothing added; clean and not containing any harmful substances
pure.sentence: The water in the glass looks very pure.
pure.sentenceTrans: 杯中的水看起来非常纯净。

purple.definitionEn: having the colour of blue and red mixed together
purple.sentenceTrans: 紫色是我最喜欢的颜色。

purpose.sentence: His purpose for exercising is to get more muscles.
purpose.sentenceTrans: 他健身的目的是为了练出更多的肌肉。
purpose.mnemonic: pur始终 + pose放 → 始终放的东西 → purpose目的，意图

purse.definition: 钱包（尤指女用的），小钱袋，手袋；资金，财源
purse.definitionEn: a small bag made of leather, plastic, etc. for carrying coins and often also paper money, cards, etc., used especially by women; the amount of money that is available to a person, an organization or a government to spend
purse.sentence: All my money is in my purse.
purse.sentenceTrans: 我所有的钱都在我的小钱包里。

pursue.definitionEn: to follow or chase somebody/something, especially in order to catch them
pursue.sentence: The police were pursuing the two thieves who had stolen a woman's purse.
pursue.sentenceTrans: 警察正在追赶那两个小偷，他们偷了一个女人的钱包。
pursue.mnemonic: pur=pro向前 + sue跟随 → pursue追求

pursuit.definitionEn: the act of looking for or trying to find something
pursuit.sentence: She followed in pursuit of her friend.
pursuit.sentenceTrans: 她在后面追赶着她的朋友。
pursuit.mnemonic: pursu=pursue追求 + it名词后缀，表抽象名词 → pursuit追求

push.definitionEn: to use your hands, arms or body in order to make somebody/something move forward or away from you; to move part of your body into a particular position
push.sentence: I ran out of gas, so my wife made me get out and push the car.
push.sentenceTrans: 我的车没汽油了，所以被妻子赶下来推车。

put.definitionEn: to cause (someone or something) to be in a particular place or position
put.sentence: I put this green vase on the table.
put.sentenceTrans: 我把这个绿色的花瓶放到了桌子上。

puzzle.definition: 难题；谜，智力游戏；  v.使迷惑，迷惑
puzzle.definitionEn: a game, etc. that you have to think about carefully in order to answer it or do it
puzzle.sentence: As a test, he asked the girl to draw a puzzle.
puzzle.sentenceTrans: 柯布让阿德里安设计一个迷宫以作测试。（《盗梦空间》）

qualification.definitionEn: an exam that you have passed or a course of study that you have successfully completed
qualification.sentence: It requires a nursing qualification to become a nurse.
qualification.sentenceTrans: 当护士需要护士资格证。
qualification.mnemonic: qual=quality质量 + ification表名词 → qualification资格证明

qualified.definition: 有资格的；合格的，胜任的；保留的；  v.取得…的资格
qualified.definitionEn: having passed the exams or completed the training that are necessary in order to do a particular job; having the experience to do a particular job
qualified.sentenceTrans: 她是一位有资格的老师。
qualified.mnemonic: qualif=qualify资格 + ied形容词后缀 → qualified有资格的

qualify.definition: 胜任，使具有资格；  v.（使）合格
qualify.definitionEn: to reach the standard of ability or knowledge needed to do a particular job, for example by completing a course of study or passing exams
qualify.sentence: His skills qualify him for his work.
qualify.sentenceTrans: 他的技能让他能够胜任这份工作。
qualify.mnemonic: quali=quality质量 + fy动词后缀 → 使...有高质量 → qualify胜任，使具有资格

quality.definitionEn: the standard of something when it is compared to other things like it; how good or bad something is
quality.sentence: The quality of this spoon is too terrible!
quality.mnemonic: qual资格 + ity表名词 → quality质量；品质，特性

quantity.definitionEn: an amount or a number of something
quantity.sentence: The woman received a large quantity of beautiful roses.
quantity.sentenceTrans: 这位女士收到了许多美丽的玫瑰。
quantity.mnemonic: quant多少，数量 + ity表名词 → quantity量，数量

quarantine.definitionEn: to keep (a person or animal) away from others to prevent a disease from spreading :to put or keep (a person or animal) in quarantine
quarantine.sentence: We've sealed off this area following quarantine protocol.
quarantine.sentenceTrans: 我们按检疫规程封锁了这个区域。
quarantine.mnemonic: quarant检疫 + ine表示抽象名词 → quarantine隔离检查

quarrel.definition: 争吵，口角；  v.争吵，争论
quarrel.definitionEn: to have an angry argument or disagreement
quarrel.sentence: They had a heated quarrel last night.
quarrel.sentenceTrans: 他们昨晚发生了一场激烈的争吵。
quarrel.mnemonic: quarr=quer抱怨 + el人，集体 → 几个人同时抱怨对方的不好 → quarrel争吵

quarter.definition: 四分之一； 一个季度； 一刻钟；地区；  v.把……四等分
quarter.definitionEn: one of four equal parts of something
quarter.sentence: This stopwatch shows that a quarter of a minute has passed.
quarter.sentenceTrans: 这块秒表显示已经过去了十五秒。
quarter.mnemonic: quart四 + er名词后缀 → quarter四分之一；一刻钟

queen.definitionEn: the only fertile female in a colony of social insects such as bees and ants and termites; its function is to lay eggs
queen.sentence: The queen in a long red dress stands beside the king.
queen.sentenceTrans: 王后身着一袭红裙，站在国王身旁。

question.definition: 疑问，问题；  v.正式提问，询问；怀疑
question.definitionEn: to ask somebody questions about something, especially officially
question.sentence: I have so many questions about everything.
question.sentenceTrans: 我对很多东西都有疑问。
question.mnemonic: quest寻求，询问 + ion名词后缀 → question疑问

queue.definitionEn: to wait in a line of people, vehicles, etc. in order to do something, get something or go somewhere
queue.sentence: There is a long queue of hundreds of people.
queue.sentenceTrans: 数以百计的人排起了长队。
queue.mnemonic: que=cue尾巴 + ue → 形成尾巴状的一条 → queue行列，排队

quick.sentence: The pace of life in the city can be very quick.
quick.sentenceTrans: 城市的生活节奏是非常快的。

quiet.definitionEn: (especially North American English) to become calmer or less noisy; to make somebody/something calmer or less noisy

quit.definition: 辞职；戒掉；离开（工作职位、学校等）
quit.definitionEn: to stop doing (an action or activity)
quit.sentence: The office worker was so happy after he quit his job.
quit.sentenceTrans: 这名公司职员辞掉工作后感到很开心。

quite.definitionEn: to a great degree; very; really
quite.sentence: My hair is quite soft and smooth without any special effects.
quite.sentenceTrans: 我的头发很柔很顺，毫无特技呢。

quotation.definition: 引文，引语，语录；行情，行市；报价，牌价
quotation.definitionEn: a group of words or a short piece of writing taken from a book, play, speech, etc. and repeated because it is interesting or useful; the act of repeating something interesting or useful that another person has written or said
quotation.sentence: People often use quotations from Shakespeare.
quotation.sentenceTrans: 人们经常引用莎士比亚的文字。
quotation.mnemonic: quot=quote引用 + ation表行为 → 引文，引语

quote.definition: 引用；报价；【法】报价；  n.引语，引文
quote.definitionEn: to repeat the exact words that another person has said or written
quote.sentence: She often quotes Shakespeare to support her arguments.
quote.sentenceTrans: 她经常引用莎士比亚的语句来支持她的论点。

rabbit.definitionEn: a small animal with soft fur, long ears and a short tail. Rabbits live in holes in the ground or are kept as pets or for food.
rabbit.sentence: Would you like a pet rabbit?

race.definition: 人种，种族；竞赛，赛跑；  v.参加竞赛；全速行进
race.definitionEn: a competition between people, animals, vehicles, etc. to see which one is the fastest
race.sentence: There are many different races in this world.
race.sentenceTrans: 海贼王的世界里有很多不同的人种（鱼人，小人，普通人种，巨人）。

racial.definitionEn: happening or existing between people of different races
racial.sentence: There are many different racial groups in this world.
racial.sentenceTrans: 这个世界有许多不同的种族群体。
racial.mnemonic: rac(e)种族 + ial形容词后缀 → racial种族的

radar.definitionEn: a system that uses radio waves to find the position and movement of objects, for example planes and ships, when they cannot be seen
radar.sentence: We saw the airplane with radar before we could see it with our own eyes.
radar.sentenceTrans: 在肉眼能看到飞机前，我们就能用雷达探测到它了。

radiate.definition: 辐射，发出（光或热）；辐射，发出光或热
radiate.definitionEn: if something radiates heat, light or energy or heat, etc. radiates from it, the heat is sent out in all directions
radiate.sentence: The sun radiates light and heat towards the earth.
radiate.sentenceTrans: 太阳向地球发出光和热。
radiate.mnemonic: radi光线 + ate造成、使之成…… → radiate辐射，（使）从中心发散

radiation.definitionEn: a type of dangerous and powerful energy that is produced by radioactive substances and nuclear reactions
radiation.sentence: Don't get close to radiation if you are not in a protective suit.
radiation.sentenceTrans: 没有穿防辐射服就不要靠近辐射物。
radiation.mnemonic: radi辐射 + ation表示行为、状态、过程、结果 → radiation辐射能

radical.definition: 彻底的，根本的；激进的；  n.激进分子
radical.definitionEn: a person who holds extreme or revolutionary views
radical.sentence: Over the centuries, we have seen some radical changes in fashion.
radical.sentenceTrans: 几个世纪以来，我们目睹了时尚领域的根本变化。
radical.mnemonic: radic根 + al……的 → radical根本的，基本的

radio.definition: 收音机；无线电；（无线电）广播节目
radio.definitionEn: the system or process that is used for sending and receiving signals through the air without using wires
radio.sentence: The woman is listening to the radio with a cup of coffee in her hand.
radio.sentenceTrans: 这位女士手端着咖啡，正在听收音机。

rag.definitionEn: a piece of old, often torn, cloth used especially for cleaning things
rag.sentence: She used a rag to clean the window.

rage.definitionEn: a feeling of violent anger that is difficult to control
rage.sentence: He was totally in a rage when he saw the message.
rage.sentenceTrans: 看到那条信息时，他完全暴怒了。

railroad.definition: 铁路；  v.迫使某人做某事
railroad.definitionEn: a system of tracks, together with the trains that run on them, and the organization and people; a track with rails on which trains run
railroad.sentence: I'm afraid of flying, so I usually use the railroad to travel.
railroad.sentenceTrans: 我怕坐飞机，所以我长途旅行都选择坐火车（铁路运输）。

railway.definitionEn: a system of tracks, together with the trains that run on them, and the organization and people needed to operate them; a track with rails on which trains run
railway.sentence: I like to travel by taking the high-speed railway, because it's very fast.
railway.sentenceTrans: 我喜欢坐高铁出去旅游，因为特别快。

rain.definitionEn: to fall or to make something fall on somebody/something in large quantities
rain.sentence: This guy is singing in the rain.
rain.sentenceTrans: 这个男人在大雨中唱着歌。

rainbow.definitionEn: a curved band of different colours that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain
rainbow.sentence: A rainbow arched across the sky.

raise.definition: 举起，抬高；提升；筹集，筹（钱）；增加；提高；加薪
raise.definitionEn: to lift or move (something or someone) to a higher position
raise.sentence: The kitten raises his friend up to steal the fish.
raise.sentenceTrans: 这只小猫咪把朋友举起来偷鱼。

random.definition: 随机的；任意的；  n.随意，胡乱
random.definitionEn: done, chosen, etc. without somebody deciding in advance what is going to happen, or without any regular pattern
random.sentence: It's just a random series of numbers.
random.sentenceTrans: 这就是一系列随机的数字。

randomly.sentence: This is a prize wheel that spins randomly.

range.definition: 一系列；【计】范围；山脉；  v.（在一定范围内）变化
range.definitionEn: the limits within which something varies
range.sentence: People use different facial expressions to show a range of emotions.
range.sentenceTrans: 人们用不同的面部表情来展示一系列的情绪。

rank.definition: 等级，级别；军队中的官阶；地位；行列；  v.排列；把……分等级，属于某个等级；  adj.繁茂的；难闻的，讨厌的
rank.definitionEn: to give somebody/something a particular position on a scale according to quality, importance, success, etc.; to have a position of this kind
rank.sentence: They got different ranks after performing.
rank.sentenceTrans: 他们在表演后得到了不同的等级。

rapid.definitionEn: happening in a short period of time rapid change/expansion/grow
rapid.sentence: The train is traveling at a rapid pace.

rapidly.definitionEn: very quickly; at a great rate
rapidly.mnemonic: rapid迅速 ＋ ly副词后缀表示状态、程度、方式 → rapidly迅速地；很快地

rare.definitionEn: existing only in small numbers and therefore valuable or interesting
rare.sentence: He likes eating rare steak, which is bloody and red in the middle.
rare.sentenceTrans: 他喜欢吃那种中间呈血红色的一分熟牛排。

rarely.mnemonic: rare稀少的 + ly……的 → rarely很少，难得

rat.definitionEn: a small animal with a long tail, that looks like a large mouse, usually considered a pest (= an animal which is disliked because it destroys food or spreads disease)
rat.sentence: Look! The three rats are waving to us.
rat.sentenceTrans: 看，这三只老鼠在跟我们挥手。

rate.definition: 评估；定等级，评级；认为；评估，估量；  n.率，比率；速度，速率；价格，价钱
rate.definitionEn: a measurement of the speed at which something happens
rate.sentence: The air quality of this city is rated as poor.
rate.sentenceTrans: 该市的空气质量被评为差。

rather.definitionEn: used with a verb to make a statement sound less strong

ratio.definitionEn: the relationship between two groups of people or things that is represented by two numbers showing how much larger one group is than the other
ratio.sentence: The ratio of boys to girls is about 2 to 1 in the club.
ratio.sentenceTrans: 这个社团的男女比率大概是2比1。
ratio.mnemonic: rati=rate比率 + o表名词，状态 → ratio比率，比

rational.definitionEn: (of behaviour, ideas, etc.) based on reason rather than emotions
rational.sentence: She remained rational in the face of a heavy workload.
rational.sentenceTrans: 她在面对繁重的工作时依然保持理智。
rational.mnemonic: ration定量，计算 + al……的 → 通过计算的 → rational合理的

raw.definition: 生的，未煮过的；未加工的
raw.definitionEn: in its natural state; not yet changed, used or made into something else
raw.sentence: The beef on the wooden board is raw.

ray.definitionEn: one of the lines of light that you can see coming from an object
ray.sentence: Part of the sun's rays are blocked by clouds.
ray.sentenceTrans: 一部分太阳光线被云层挡住了。

reach.definitionEn: to be able to touch, pick up, or grab (something) by moving or stretching
reach.sentence: Using the red ladder, I can reach the top.
reach.sentenceTrans: 我能用这架红色的梯子到达顶部。

react.definitionEn: to change or behave in a particular way as a result of or in response to something
react.sentence: Different people react differently when watching a movie.
react.sentenceTrans: 看电影时，不同的人有不同的反应。
react.mnemonic: re相反、反对 + act行动，做 → react起反应；有影响

reaction.definitionEn: what you do, say or think as a result of something that has happened
reaction.sentence: The audience have different reactions to the same movie.
reaction.sentenceTrans: 对于同一部电影，观众们有着不同的反应。
reaction.mnemonic: re相反，“反” + act行动，“应” + ion名词后缀 → reaction反应

read.definitionEn: (not used in the progressive tenses) to look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols
read.sentence: The young lady is reading a book in the library.
read.sentenceTrans: 这位年轻的女士正在图书馆读书。

readily.sentence: The girl readily accepted his invitation to go to the live music show.
readily.sentenceTrans: 女孩欣然接受了他提出的去看现场音乐表演的邀请。
readily.mnemonic: readi=ready准备好的，情愿的 + ly……地 → readily乐意地，欣然地；容易地

ready.definition: 准备好的；现成的；  v.预备，准备
ready.definitionEn: fully prepared for what you are going to do

real.definition: 真实的，实际存在的；真的；真正的，名副其实的
real.definitionEn: actually existing or happening; not imaginary
real.sentence: The mirror did not show his real reflection.
real.sentenceTrans: 这个镜子没有反映出他真实的样子。

realisation.definitionEn: the process of becoming aware of something; the process of achieving a particular aim, etc.; the act of selling something that you own, such as property, in order to get the money that you need for something; the act of producing a sound, play, design, etc.; or the thing that is produced
realisation.sentence: The building is the realisation of his creative design.
realisation.sentenceTrans: 这座建筑实现了他创造性的设计。
realisation.mnemonic: realize看到真的=意识到 + ation表名词 → realisation认识，领会

realise.definitionEn: to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation
realise.sentence: She worked hard to realise her dream of becoming a doctor.
realise.sentenceTrans: 她努力工作，实现了成为医生的梦想。

realistic.definitionEn: representing things as they are in real life
realistic.sentence: The realistic chance of winning the prize draw is very low.
realistic.sentenceTrans: 赢得抽奖的现实可能性极低。
realistic.mnemonic: real真的 + istic...的 → 逼真的

reality.definitionEn: the true situation and the problems that actually exist in life, in contrast to how you would like life to be
reality.sentence: The photo without filter makes me realize the reality.
reality.sentenceTrans: 没有滤镜的照片使我认清了现实。
reality.mnemonic: real真实的 + ity名词后缀 → reality现实，真实

realization.definitionEn: the process of becoming aware of something; the process of achieving a particular aim, etc.; the act of selling something that you own, such as property, in order to get the money that you need for something; the act of producing a sound, play, design, etc.; or the thing that is produced
realization.sentence: I suddenly had a realization that I forgot to lock the door.
realization.sentenceTrans: 我突然意识到我忘记锁门啦。
realization.mnemonic: realiz（e）看到真实=意识到 + ation表名词 → realization意识到

realize.definition: 认识到，意识到（=realise）；实现；意识到
realize.definitionEn: (not used in the progressive tenses) to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation
realize.sentence: "So that's how the word is spelled!" the little boy finally realized.
realize.sentenceTrans: “原来这个单词是这样拼写的！”小男孩终于意识到了这一点。
realize.mnemonic: real真实的 + ize表动词 → realize实现

really.definitionEn: used to say what is actually the fact or the truth about something
really.sentence: I don't see the point in it really.
really.sentenceTrans: 我真的不理解这到底有什么意义。
really.mnemonic: real真实的 + ly表副词 → really真正地

rear.definition: 背面的；后面的；  v.抚养
rear.definitionEn: [only before noun] at or near the back of something
rear.sentence: I could only see a tree in my rear-view mirror.
rear.sentenceTrans: 从后视镜里我只能看到一棵树。

reason.definition: 原因，理由；理性；  v.论证，推理，劝说
reason.definitionEn: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done
reason.sentence: The reason why he's late for school is that he stayed up late doing homework last night.
reason.sentenceTrans: 他迟到的原因是昨晚熬夜写作业了。

reasonable.definitionEn: fair and sensible; (of prices) not too expensive; acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
reasonable.sentence: He bought the apples at a reasonable price.
reasonable.sentenceTrans: 他用合理的价格买了苹果。
reasonable.mnemonic: reason合理 + able形容词后缀，具有某种性质的 → 合理的，通情达理的

rebel.definition: 造反，反抗，反叛；  n.叛逆者；造反者
rebel.definitionEn: to fight against or refuse to obey an authority, for example a government, a system, your parents, etc.
rebel.sentence: The little boy often rebels against his mother.
rebel.sentenceTrans: 这个小男孩经常反抗他的母亲。
rebel.mnemonic: re相反 + bel斗争 → 反打 → 反叛 → rebel反抗，造反

recall.definitionEn: to make somebody think of something; to remember something
recall.sentence: Looking at the photo, she recalled the old time with her husband.
recall.sentenceTrans: 看着这张照片，她回忆起和丈夫的旧时光。
recall.mnemonic: re回，向后 + call呼唤 → recall召回，回忆

receipt.definitionEn: a piece of paper that shows that goods or services have been paid for
receipt.sentence: Check all your receipts when you pay your taxes.
receipt.sentenceTrans: 当你交税时，一定要检查所有收据。
receipt.mnemonic: re一再，重新 + ceipt收 → receipt收据

receive.definitionEn: to get or accept something that is sent or given to you
receive.sentence: I received a thank-you note from my good friend.
receive.sentenceTrans: 我从好朋友那里收到了一张感谢卡。
receive.mnemonic: re再 + ceiv抓，拿 + e后缀 → 再次拿到 → receive得到，收到

receiver.definitionEn: the part of a telephone that you pick up and hold near your face when you are making or receiving a phone call
receiver.sentence: The man is holding the receiver of the phone.
receiver.sentenceTrans: 这个男人正手拿着电话听筒。
receiver.mnemonic: re回，向后 + ceiv拿，抓，握住 + er名词后缀 → receiver接收器

recent.definitionEn: that happened or began only a short time ago
recent.sentenceTrans: 这些是我最近拍的照片。
recent.mnemonic: re再 + cent新鲜的，年轻的 → recent最近的

recently.sentence: He recently spent some time on the beach and got a tan.
recently.sentenceTrans: 他最近在海滩上待了一段时间，晒黑了。
recently.mnemonic: recent最近 + ly表副词 → recently最近

reception.definitionEn: the area inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go first when they arrive
reception.sentence: The young couple got their room key at the reception of the hotel.
reception.sentenceTrans: 这对年轻的夫妇在酒店前台拿到了他们房间的钥匙。
reception.mnemonic: re回，向后 + cept拿，握住 + ion名词后缀 → 接收

receptionist.definitionEn: a person whose job is to deal with the people who call or enter an office, hotel, etc.
receptionist.sentence: As soon as I walked in, the hotel receptionist greeted me with a big smile.
receptionist.sentenceTrans: 我一走进去，宾馆接待员就满脸笑容地表示欢迎。
receptionist.mnemonic: re重复、重新 ＋ cept拿，抓，握住 ＋ ion表名词 ＋ ist从事某种职业的人 → receptionist接待员；传达员

rent.sentence: I have to pay rent on my house every month.
rent.sentenceTrans: 我得每月支付我的房租。

repair.definition: 修理；修补，修缮；  n.修理，修补，修缮
repair.definitionEn: to restore something that is broken, damaged or torn to good condition
repair.sentence: Two workers are trying to repair that car.
repair.sentenceTrans: 那两个工人正试着修好那辆车。
repair.mnemonic: re再 + pair回到最初状态 → 重新恢复正常 → repair修理

reparable.sentence: Fortunately, the damage to his car was reparable.
reparable.sentenceTrans: 幸运的是，他的车受到的损伤是可以修缮的。
reparable.mnemonic: repar=repair修缮 ＋ able形容词后缀，可...的 → reparable可修缮的；可补偿的

repay.definitionEn: to pay back the money that you have borrowed from somebody
repay.sentence: I repay the loan which I borrowed for my new house in monthly installments.
repay.sentenceTrans: 我每个月都要还买新房的分期贷款。
repay.mnemonic: re回 + pay支付，偿还 → repay偿还

repeat.definitionEn: to do or produce something again or more than once
repeat.sentence: The song repeats the same line over and over.
repeat.sentenceTrans: 这首歌反反复复重复着同一句。
repeat.mnemonic: re再，重新 + peat追寻，努力 → 重新努力一次 → repeat重复，重做

repeatedly.sentence: He repeatedly said no to the other two.
repeatedly.sentenceTrans: 他重复地对另外两人说“不”。
repeatedly.mnemonic: repeat重复 + ed + ly副词后缀 → repeatedly屡次地

repetition.definitionEn: the act of saying or doing something again
repetition.sentence: The repetition of turning the screws made him very bored.
repetition.sentenceTrans: 反复拧螺丝使他感到非常厌倦。
repetition.mnemonic: re再 + pet追求 + tion表名词 → repetition重复

repetitive.definitionEn: saying or doing the same thing many times, so that it becomes boring.
repetitive.sentence: Could you please stop asking repetitive questions?
repetitive.sentenceTrans: 你能不能别老问我一样的问题？
repetitive.mnemonic: re再次，反复 + pet寻求，力争 + itive形容词后缀→repetitive反复的，重复的

replace.definitionEn: to be used instead of something/somebody else; to do something instead of somebody/something else; to remove somebody/something and put another person or thing in their place
replace.sentence: Robots are gradually replacing factory workers.
replace.sentenceTrans: 机器人正在逐渐代替工厂的工人。
replace.mnemonic: re重新 + place放，地方 → 重新放 → replace代替

replacement.definitionEn: a thing that replaces something, especially because the first thing is old, broken, etc.
replacement.sentence: The new bulb is the replacement for the old one.
replacement.sentenceTrans: 这个新灯泡是旧灯泡的替代品。
replacement.mnemonic: replace复职；代替 + ment表名词 → replacement替代

reply.definitionEn: an act of replying to something/somebody in speech, writing or by some action
reply.sentence: He is replying to messages on the phone.
reply.sentenceTrans: 他正在回复手机上的信息。
reply.mnemonic: re反 + ply重叠，折叠 → 叠回去 → reply回答

report.definition: 报告，汇报；报道；  n.【航】报告；报道
report.definitionEn: a written or spoken description of a situation, event, etc.
report.sentence: The woman is reporting the progress of the project to her team.
report.sentenceTrans: 这个女人正在向团队汇报项目进展。
report.mnemonic: re回 + port拿，带 → 把消息、情况等带回来 → report报告，汇报

reporter.definitionEn: a person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio or television
reporter.sentence: The reporter brought us the latest news.
reporter.sentenceTrans: 这位记者为我们带来了最新的消息。
reporter.mnemonic: re回 + port拿 + er表人 → reporter记者，通讯员

represent.definition: 象征；代表；表示；描述，展现；阐明；说明
represent.definitionEn: to be a symbol of something
represent.mnemonic: re加强语气 + pre前面 + sent存在 → represent象征，代表，展现

representation.definitionEn: the fact of having representatives who will speak or vote for you or on your behalf
representation.sentence: All the animal representations have attended this international conference.
representation.sentenceTrans: 动物代表们都出席了此次国际会议。
representation.mnemonic: re反对 ＋ pre提前 ＋ sent感觉 ＋ ation名词后缀 → 反对预先提出的东西 → representation抗议；代表（权）

representative.definition: 代表；  adj.典型的，有代表性的
representative.definitionEn: a person who has been chosen to speak or vote for somebody else or on behalf of a group
representative.sentence: They chose her as their representative to speak for them.
representative.sentenceTrans: 他们选她作为代表发声。
representative.mnemonic: represent代表 + ative形容词后缀 → representative代表性的

reproduce.definitionEn: if people, plants, animals, etc. reproduce or reproduce themselves, they produce young
reproduce.sentence: Crocodiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.
reproduce.sentenceTrans: 鳄鱼通过在陆地上产卵来繁殖后代。
reproduce.mnemonic: re一再，重新 + produce生产 → reproduce再生产，再造

reproduction.definitionEn: the act or process of producing babies, young animals or plants
reproduction.sentence: Reproduction is essential for the continuation of all living species.
reproduction.sentenceTrans: 生殖对于所有生物物种的延续至关重要。
reproduction.mnemonic: re一再，重新 ＋ product产品 ＋ ion名词后缀 → reproduction再生产

republic.definitionEn: a country that is governed by a president and politicians elected by the people and where there is no king or queen
republic.mnemonic: re事情，事务 + public公众  → 与公众相关的事务  → republic共和国

reputation.definitionEn: the opinion that people have about what somebody/something is like, based on what has happened in the past
reputation.sentence: He has a good reputation among sportsmen since he always wins.
reputation.sentenceTrans: 因为经常赢得比赛，所以他在运动员当中有很高的声誉。
reputation.mnemonic: re再 + put想起 + ation名词后缀 → 让人再想起 → reputation声誉

request.definition: （正式或礼貌的）请求；要求；  v.请求，要求；要求，请求
request.definitionEn: an act of politely or formally asking for something
request.sentence: His father agreed to his request for a Superman costume.
request.sentenceTrans: 他父亲同意了他想要一套超人服装的请求。
request.mnemonic: re再 + quest寻求，询问 → 再寻求 → request要求

require.definitionEn: to need something; to depend on somebody/something
require.sentence: The worker is required by law to wear a helmet to work.
require.sentenceTrans: 法律规定工人佩戴安全头盔进行工作。
require.mnemonic: re再 + quire寻求，询问 → 再寻求 → require请求

requirement.definitionEn: something that is you need or want
requirement.sentence: The job has strict requirements for experience.
requirement.sentenceTrans: 这份工作对经验有严格的要求。
requirement.mnemonic: re再，重复 + quir寻求，询问 + e + ment表示行为、行为的过程或结果 → 需要；要求

rescue.definition: 营救，解救；  n.营救，解救
rescue.definitionEn: to save somebody/something from a dangerous or harmful situation
rescue.sentence: The brave puppy successfully rescued the kitten trapped in the gap.
rescue.sentenceTrans: 勇敢的小狗成功救出了被埋在缝隙中的小猫。

research.definition: 研究，调查；探索；  v.研究，调查
research.definitionEn: careful study that is done to find and report new knowledge about something
research.sentence: She's conducting some research in order to write her new book.
research.sentenceTrans: 为了撰写她的新书，她正在进行一些研究。
research.mnemonic: re表强调 + search寻找 → research研究

resemblance.definitionEn: the fact of being or looking similar to somebody/something
resemblance.sentence: There is a remarkable resemblance between him and his brother, Pete.
resemblance.sentenceTrans: 他和他的弟弟皮特之间有着惊人的相似之处。
resemblance.mnemonic: re一再，重新 + sembl相像 + ance名词后缀，表性质 → resemblance相像

resemble.definitionEn: to look like or be similar to another person or thing
resemble.sentence: These two men resemble each other, so it's hard to tell them apart.
resemble.sentenceTrans: 这两个男人长得很相似，难以区分谁是谁。
resemble.mnemonic: re表强调 + semble相类似，一样 → resemble类似

resent.definitionEn: to feel bitter or angry about something, especially because you feel it is unfair
resent.sentence: After quarreling over and over, the couple resented each other.
resent.sentenceTrans: 在一次又一次的争吵之后，这对夫妻互相怨恨起来。
resent.mnemonic: re向后，相反 + sent感觉 → 反感 → resent不满，忿恨

reservation.definitionEn: an arrangement for a seat on a plane or train, a room in a hotel, etc. to be kept for you
reservation.sentence: The couple had a reservation, so the table was saved for them.
reservation.sentenceTrans: 这对夫妇已经预订过了，所以餐厅为他们保留了桌子。
reservation.mnemonic: reserv保存 + ation名词后缀 → reservation保存；预定

reserve.definition: 储备；储备金；保护区；  v.保留；预订；储备
reserve.definitionEn: to ask for a seat, table, room, etc. to be available for you or somebody else at a future time
reserve.sentence: He has an emergency reserve of food stored at home.
reserve.sentenceTrans: 他在家里有一个存放食物的紧急储备库。
reserve.mnemonic: re再 + serve服务，保持 → 再留住 → reserve预定

reside.definitionEn: to live in a particular place
reside.sentence: This type of crab resides inside shells.
reside.sentenceTrans: 这种螃蟹住在贝壳里面。
reside.mnemonic: re再 + side坐 → 再坐之地 → reside居住

residence.definitionEn: a house, especially a large or impressive one; the state of living in a particular place; permission to live in a country that is not your own
residence.sentence: Their residence is equipped with a large swimming pool.
residence.sentenceTrans: 他们的住宅配有一个很大的游泳池。
residence.mnemonic: re再 + sid坐 + ence名词后缀 → residence居住；住宅

resident.definition: 居民；  adj.居住的；常驻的
resident.definitionEn: a person who lives in a particular place or who has their home there
resident.sentence: The residents here like to interact with each other.
resident.sentenceTrans: 这儿的居民喜欢相互交流。

resign.definitionEn: to officially tell somebody that you are leaving your job, an organization, etc.
resign.sentence: She was not happy working for this company and finally decided to resign.
resign.sentenceTrans: 她在这家公司工作得不开心，最终决定辞职。
resign.mnemonic: re再 + sign签名 → 再次签名 → resign辞职

resist.definitionEn: to refuse to accept something and try to stop it from happening
resist.sentence: The girl on a diet managed to resist the temptation of hamburgers.
resist.sentenceTrans: 这个正在节食的女孩抵制住了汉堡包的诱惑。
resist.mnemonic: re向后，相反 + sist站 → 反着站 → resist反抗，抵抗

resistance.definitionEn: dislike of or opposition to a plan, an idea, etc.; refusal to obey
resistance.sentence: The enemy gave up without resistance.
resistance.sentenceTrans: 敌军没有抵抗就投降了。
resistance.mnemonic: re反 + sist站立 + ance名词后缀 → resistance反抗；抵抗力

resistant.definitionEn: not affected by something; able to resist something
resistant.sentence: This watch is resistant to water.
resistant.sentenceTrans: 这块手表具有防水性能。
resistant.mnemonic: re向后，相反 + sist站 + ant…的 → 站在反方向上 → resistant抵抗的

resolution.definition: 决心，决定，坚定；分辨率；决议；解决
resolution.definitionEn: a formal statement of an opinion agreed on by a committee or a council, especially by means of a vote; the act of solving or settling a problem, disagreement, etc.; the quality of being resolute or determined; a firm decision to do or not to do something; the power of a computer screen, printer, etc. to give a clear image, depending on the size of the dots that make up the image
resolution.sentence: She made a resolution to read all of these English novels in just one week.
resolution.sentenceTrans: 她下定决心要在一周内读完所有这些英文小说。
resolution.mnemonic: re不 + solut松开 + ion名词后缀，构成抽象名词 → 不解决就不松开 → resolution决心；溶解

resolve.definitionEn: to find an acceptable solution to a problem or difficulty; to make a firm decision to do something; (of a committee, meeting, etc.) to reach a decision by means of a formal vote
resolve.sentence: Nothing shakes his resolve of passing the test!
resolve.sentenceTrans: 没有什么能动摇他想通过考试的决心！

resort.definition: 度假胜地；诉诸，凭借，求助；应急措施；可首先（或最后）采取的手段；  v.诉诸，采用
resort.definitionEn: (resort to) to make use of something, especially something bad, as a means of achieving something, often because there is no other possible solution; to seek aid, relief, or advantage
resort.sentence: We will stay on a beach resort for our next holiday.
resort.sentenceTrans: 下个假期我们将去一个海滨度假胜地。
resort.mnemonic: re再一次 + sort出去 → resort度假胜地

resource.definitionEn: a supply of something that a country, an organization or a person has and can use, especially to increase their wealth; something that can be used to help achieve an aim, especially a book, equipment, etc. that provides information for teachers and students; personal qualities such as courage and imagination that help you deal with difficult situations
resource.sentence: We depend on the Earth's resources to survive.
resource.sentenceTrans: 我们依靠地球提供的资源生存。

respect.definitionEn: a feeling of admiration for somebody/something because of their good qualities or achievement
respect.sentence: They bow to their customers as a sign of respect.
respect.sentenceTrans: 他们会对客人鞠躬，以示尊重。
respect.mnemonic: re再 + spect看 → 再看一眼 → respect尊敬

respectable.definition: 值得尊敬的；体面的，雅观的
respectable.definitionEn: considered by society to be acceptable, good or correct.
respectable.sentence: Being a teacher is regarded as a respectable profession.
respectable.sentenceTrans: 教师是值得尊敬的职业。
respectable.mnemonic: respect 尊敬 + able 可...的 形容词后缀→ respectable 值得尊敬的

respectful.sentence: He behaves in a respectful way.
respectful.mnemonic: respect尊敬 + ful……的 → respectful充满敬意的

respective.definitionEn: belonging or relating separately to each of the people or things already mentioned
respective.sentence: After the party, we went back into our respective rooms.
respective.sentenceTrans: 派对结束后，我们回到了各自的房间。
respective.mnemonic: re回 + spect看 + ive形容词后缀 → 回头看自己 → respective各自的

respectively.definitionEn: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned
respectively.sentence: The twins, Kate and Kimberley, received a toy car and a doll respectively.
respectively.sentenceTrans: 凯特和金伯莉这对双胞胎姐妹分别收到了玩具车和洋娃娃作为礼物。
respectively.mnemonic: respective回头看（自己）=各自的 + ly……地 → respectively各自地

respond.definitionEn: to do something as a reaction to something that somebody has said or done
respond.sentence: When the boy gives orders to the man, he always responds with "Yes, my lord."
respond.sentenceTrans: 当男孩向男人下命令时，男人总是回答：“遵命，我的主人。”
respond.mnemonic: re回 + spond承诺 → 承诺回去 → 回答 → respond回答；反应

response.sentence: The students raised their hands in response to the teacher's question.
response.sentenceTrans: 同学们举起手来回答老师的提问。
response.mnemonic: re回，向后 + sponse承诺 → response回答；答应

responsibility.definitionEn: a duty to deal with or take care of somebody/something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong; blame for something bad that has happened
responsibility.sentence: We have a responsibility to take care of our parents.
responsibility.mnemonic: re再、重复 ＋ spons承诺 ＋ ibility抽象名词词尾 → responsibility责任，责任心；职责，义务

responsible.definition: 负责的，可靠的，有责任的
responsible.definitionEn: having the job or duty of doing something or taking care of somebody/something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong
responsible.sentence: The dog was responsible for this mess.
responsible.sentenceTrans: 这只狗要对这片混乱负责。
responsible.mnemonic: respons回应 + ible能...的 → 能回应的 → responsible有责任的

rest.definition: 休息，放松；依赖，倚靠；  n.休息，休息时间；剩余部分；静止，休止
rest.definitionEn: a period of time in which you relax, sleep, or do nothing after you have been active or doing work
rest.sentence: He is resting his head on the girl's legs.
rest.sentenceTrans: 他把头枕在女孩腿上休息。

restaurant.definitionEn: a place where you can buy and eat a meal
restaurant.sentence: It is expensive to eat at this fancy restaurant.
restaurant.sentenceTrans: 在这家高档餐厅吃饭很贵。

restoration.definitionEn: the work of repairing and cleaning an old building, a painting, etc. so that its condition is as good as it originally was
restoration.sentence: The restoration of the temple to its former glory will take a long while.
restoration.sentenceTrans: 要使这座寺庙恢复往日的辉煌还需要很长时间。
restoration.mnemonic: restor恢复 + ation表示行为、情况、状态、过程、结果 → restoration恢复

restore.definitionEn: to repair a building, work of art, piece of furniture, etc. so that it looks as good as it did originally
restore.sentence: We hope to restore the garden to its former beauty.
restore.sentenceTrans: 我们希望把花园恢复到它原来的美丽模样。
restore.mnemonic: re重新 + sto站稳，使坚定 + re → 重新回到状态 → restore恢复

restrain.definitionEn: to stop somebody/something from doing something, especially by using physical force; to stop yourself from feeling an emotion or doing something that you would like to do
restrain.sentence: She tried hard to restrain her anger.
restrain.sentenceTrans: 她努力克制住自己的怒火。
restrain.mnemonic: re回 + strain拉紧，压 → restrain抑制，限制

restrict.definitionEn: to stop somebody/something from moving or acting freely; to control something with rules or laws
restrict.sentence: A combination lock can restrict others from prying into their privacy.
restrict.sentenceTrans: 密码锁可以限制别人偷窥自己的隐私。
restrict.mnemonic: re回 + strict拉紧，压 → 拉回来 → 限制

restriction.definitionEn: a rule or law that limits what you can do or what can happen; the act of limiting or controlling somebody/something; a thing that limits the amount of freedom you have
restriction.sentence: There is a restriction on fishing here.
restriction.mnemonic: re回 + strict拉紧，压 + ion表名词 → restriction限制

result.definitionEn: a thing that is caused or produced because of something else; the mark/grade you get in an exam or in a number of exams
result.sentence: An A+ is the best possible result. Good work!
result.sentenceTrans: A+是能得到的最好成绩。真棒！
result.mnemonic: re反问 + sult跳 → 反馈回来 → result结果

resultant.definitionEn: caused by the thing that has just been mentioned
resultant.sentence: His muscular body is the resultant effect from his tough workout regime.
resultant.sentenceTrans: 他的好身材是严格锻炼的结果。
resultant.mnemonic: result结果 + ant属于……的，具有……的 → resultant作为结果的，因而发生的

resume.definition: 简历（读作/ˈrezjumeɪ/）；  v.继续说；继续进行
resume.definitionEn: a written record of your education and the jobs you have done, that you send when you are applying for a job
resume.sentence: The HR team are examining the resumes of the interviewees.
resume.sentenceTrans: 人力资源团队正在审核应聘者的简历。
resume.mnemonic: re再次 + sume拿走，取走 → resume继续进行

retail.definitionEn: by or to the public, usually through shops/stores
retail.sentence: The retail trade is booming because of the application of online payment.
retail.sentenceTrans: 由于线上支付的应用，零售业正在蓬勃发展。
retail.mnemonic: re在后面 + tail切割，修剪 → 分割出单个 → retail零售

retailer.definitionEn: a person or business that sells goods to the public
retailer.sentence: This retailer sells many kinds of products.
retailer.sentenceTrans: 这个零售商销售各种各样的商品。
retailer.mnemonic: re再 + tail剪，割 + er表示人 → retailer零售商

retain.definitionEn: to keep something; to continue to have something; to continue to hold or contain something;
retain.sentence: Hot water can retain its heat for hours in the vacuum cup.
retain.sentenceTrans: 热水能在保温杯里保持温度好几个小时。
retain.mnemonic: re回 + tain握住 → 拿回来 → retain保留

retire.definitionEn: older people leave their job and usually stop working completely.
retire.sentence: My grandfather retired at 60 and raised a bird.
retire.sentenceTrans: 我爷爷60岁退休，并养了一只鸟。
retire.mnemonic: re回，向后 + tire拉 → 拉回去撤离 → retire退休

retirement.definitionEn: the fact of stopping work because you have reached a particular age; the time when you do this; the period of your life after you have stopped work at a particular age
retirement.sentence: He took up gardening as a hobby in his retirement.
retirement.sentenceTrans: 他退休后喜欢上了园艺。
retirement.mnemonic: re回、向后 + tire 疲劳 + ment表示行为、行为的过程或结果 → 退休，引退，退却，撤退

retreat.definition: 撤退，撤离；退却，后退；  n.撤退，退却；退隐处，静居处
retreat.definitionEn: to move away from a place or an enemy because you are in danger or because you have been defeated; to move away or back; to change your mind about something because of criticism or because a situation has become too difficult; to escape to a place that is quieter or safer
retreat.sentence: He retreated from the battle with a little girl.
retreat.sentenceTrans: 男枪带着小女孩(安妮)从战斗中撤退。

return.definitionEn: to come or go back from one place to another
return.sentence: Return to where you came from.
return.mnemonic: re回，向后 + turn转 → return回来，返回

reveal.definitionEn: to make something known to somebody
reveal.sentence: He opened the curtain to reveal a landscape painting.
reveal.sentenceTrans: 他掀开帘布，露出一幅风景画。
reveal.mnemonic: re相反 + veal=veil盖上 → 与掩盖相反 → reveal揭露

revenue.definition: 税收，（公司或组织的）收益
revenue.definitionEn: the money that a government receives from taxes or that an organization, etc. receives from its business
revenue.sentence: The report shows a significant rise in revenue this year.
revenue.sentenceTrans: 报告显示，今年的税收大幅上升。
revenue.mnemonic: re回 + venue来 → 回来的东西 → revenue收入

reverse.definition: 颠倒，反转（顺序）；倒（车）；撤销，废除；  n.逆向，逆转；  adj.相反的；反面的
reverse.definitionEn: to change something completely so that it is the opposite of what it was before; when a vehicle or its driver reverses or the driver reverses a vehicle, the vehicle goes backwards
reverse.sentence: Now that you have a job and I don't, our situations are reversed.
reverse.sentenceTrans: 你找到了工作，我倒没有工作了，我们的情况正好颠倒过来。
reverse.mnemonic: re向后，相反 + verse转 → reverse反转，颠倒

reversely.definitionEn: in an opposite way; so as to be reversed
reversely.sentence: The temperature rose during the day, but reversely, it dropped sharply after sunset.
reversely.sentenceTrans: 白天气温上升，但相反地，日落后气温急剧下降。

review.definition: 复习；回顾；评论；检查；  n.评论；复习；检讨；检查
review.definitionEn: to look again at something you have studied, especially in order to prepare for an exam
review.sentence: The girl is reviewing her homework for tomorrow's important test.
review.sentenceTrans: 那个女孩在为明天的重要考试复习。
review.mnemonic: re再、重复 + view看 → review再检查，复习

revise.definitionEn: read things again and make notes in order to be prepared for the examination
revise.sentence: She is revising her paper according to the advice given by her teacher.
revise.sentenceTrans: 她正在根据老师给的意见修改论文。
revise.mnemonic: re一再，重新 + vise看 → 再看一遍 → revise修正

revision.definitionEn: a change or set of changes to something
revision.sentence: He made a lot of revisions in her novel.
revision.sentenceTrans: 他对她的小说做了很多的修改。
revision.mnemonic: re再 + vis看 + ion表名词 → 校订本

revival.definitionEn: an improvement in the condition or strength of something
revival.sentence: The tourist hotspot enjoyed a dramatic revival once the epidemic had faded away.
revival.sentenceTrans: 传染病消失后，这个旅游胜地又恢复了兴旺景象。
revival.mnemonic: re一再，重新 + viv生命 + al名词后缀，…的 → 复活

revive.definitionEn: to become, or to make somebody/something become, conscious or healthy and strong again
revive.sentence: A single green sapling revived itself in the rotten tree stump.
revive.sentenceTrans: 一棵绿色小树苗在腐烂的树桩里重新长了出来。
revive.mnemonic: re再，重新 + vive生命 → revive恢复；（使）复苏

revolt.definition: 反抗，叛乱；（使）厌恶；  n.厌恶
revolt.definitionEn: to take violent action against the people in power
revolt.sentence: Will robots revolt against humans in the future?
revolt.sentenceTrans: 机器人会在未来反抗人类吗？
revolt.mnemonic: re向后，相反 + volt转 → 态度反转 → revolt反抗，造反

revolution.definitionEn: an attempt, by a large number of people, to change the government of a country, especially by violent action; a great change in conditions, ways of working, beliefs, etc. that affects large numbers of people
revolution.sentence: A revolution in science and technology has changed the way that we communicate.
revolution.sentenceTrans: 科技革命已经改变了我们的通信方式。
revolution.mnemonic: re重新 + volut旋转，卷 + ion名词后缀 → 重新旋转 → 革命，变革

revolutionary.definitionEn: a person who starts or supports a revolution, especially a political one
revolutionary.sentence: In the past 100 years China's transport has undergone a revolutionary change.
revolutionary.sentenceTrans: 近百年来，中国的交通方式经历了革命性的变化。
revolutionary.mnemonic: revolution革命 + ary表形容词 → revolutionary革命性的

revolve.definitionEn: to go in a circle around a central point
revolve.sentence: This merry-go-round is revolving at a high speed.
revolve.sentenceTrans: 旋转木马正在以很快的速度转动着。
revolve.mnemonic: re再 + volv旋转，卷 + e → 再转一次 → 旋转；循环

reward.definition: 奖品，奖励；回报，报答；  v.报答，回报
reward.definitionEn: a thing that you are given because you have done something good, worked hard, etc.
reward.sentence: I got a reward for my hard work.
reward.sentenceTrans: 我因努力工作获得了报酬。

rhythm.definitionEn: a strong regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements
rhythm.sentence: Only with a good sense of rhythm can he play this game well.
rhythm.sentenceTrans: 想玩好这个游戏，他必须要有很强的节奏感。

ribbon.definitionEn: a narrow piece of cloth (such as silk) that is used to tie things or for decoration
ribbon.sentence: This is a red roll of ribbon.

rice.definitionEn: short, narrow white or brown grain grown on wet land in hot countries as food; the plant that produces this grain

rich.definitionEn: having a lot of money or property
rich.sentence: The rich couple decided to sail around the world after they retired.
rich.sentenceTrans: 这一对富裕的夫妻决定在退休后去环游世界。

rid.definition: 使去掉；使摆脱；  adj.得到解脱的
rid.definitionEn: to be free of somebody/something that has been annoying you or that you do not want
rid.sentence: The stain can be easily rid of.

ride.definition: 骑（车），乘；  n.骑，驾驶；乘坐（游乐设施）
ride.definitionEn: to sit on a horse, etc. and control it as it moves
ride.sentence: When I ride my bike, I always wear a helmet for safety.
ride.sentenceTrans: 当我骑自行车时，为了安全我总会戴安全帽。

ridiculous.sentence: He looked ridiculous in that oversized suit.
ridiculous.sentenceTrans: 他穿着那套大得不合身的西装，看起来很滑稽。
ridiculous.mnemonic: ridi取笑 + cul + ous表形容词 → ridiculous可笑的

right.definition: 右边的；正确的；  n.权利；右边；  adv.正确地；直接地，径直地
right.definitionEn: true or correct as a fact; correct in your opinion or judgement
right.sentence: This green traffic light tells us it is OK to turn right.
right.sentenceTrans: 绿灯意味着我们可以右转了。

rigid.definitionEn: (of an object or substance) stiff and difficult to move or bend
rigid.sentence: My hard hat is so rigid that even a Nokia phone can't crack it!
rigid.sentenceTrans: 我的安全帽很坚硬，即使诺基亚手机也砸不碎！

rigorous.definitionEn: done carefully and with a lot of attention to detail; demanding that particular rules, processes, etc. are strictly followed
rigorous.sentence: The rigorous training prepared students well for the challenges ahead.
rigorous.sentenceTrans: 严格的训练让学生们为未来的挑战做好了充分准备。
rigorous.mnemonic: rigor严格 + ous……的 → rigorous严厉的

ring.definition: 环（状物），小圈；戒指；  v.打电话
ring.definitionEn: a piece of jewellery that you wear on your finger, consisting of a round band of gold, silver, etc.
ring.sentence: He is about to throw the ring.
ring.sentenceTrans: 他准备把这个环给丢出去了。

ripe.definitionEn: (of fruit or crops) fully grown and ready to be eaten
ripe.sentence: When bananas become ripe, they turn yellow.
ripe.sentenceTrans: 香蕉成熟的时候，颜色就会变黄。

rise.definition: 升起，上升，上涨；  n.增长
rise.definitionEn: to come or go upwards; to reach a higher level or position
rise.sentence: The bright sun rises on the horizon.
rise.sentenceTrans: 明亮的太阳从地平线上升起。

risk.definitionEn: to put something valuable or important in a dangerous situation, in which it could be lost or damaged; to do something that may mean that you get into a situation which is unpleasant or harmful for you
risk.sentence: The fireman risks his life by rushing into the fire.
risk.sentenceTrans: 消防员冒着生命危险冲进火场。

rival.definitionEn: a person, company or thing that competes with another in sport, business, etc.
rival.sentence: The two lions are rivals and will fight each other to become the new leader.
rival.sentenceTrans: 这两只狮子是竞争对手，它们为了成为新的头领即将展开战斗。
rival.mnemonic: riv河 + al表名词 → 由“河”引申为“流动，跑 → 一起跑 → rival竞争者

river.definitionEn: a natural flow of water that continues in a long line across land to the sea/ocean
river.sentence: This river brings fresh water from the mountains.
river.sentenceTrans: 河流从山里带来了淡水。

road.definitionEn: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel on
road.sentence: We will be driving on this road for a while.
road.sentenceTrans: 我们要在这条路上开一会儿。

roar.definition: 吼叫声，轰鸣声；  v.咆哮；吼叫
roar.definitionEn: the loud sound of a wild animal (such as a lion)
roar.sentence: The tiger let out a mighty roar on the cliff.
roar.sentenceTrans: 这只老虎在山崖上发出威猛的怒吼。

roast.definition: 烤（通常指烤肉、大块蔬菜）；  n.烤肉；  adj.烤的，烘的
roast.definitionEn: to cook food, especially meat, without liquid in an oven or over a fire; to be cooked in this way
roast.sentence: Roast the chicken with herbs for a flavorful dinner.
roast.sentenceTrans: 用香草烤鸡，晚餐更美味。

rob.definitionEn: to steal money or property from a person or place
rob.sentence: The man has robbed the bank.

robber.definitionEn: a person who steals from a person or place, especially using violence or threats
robber.sentence: The robber tried to take the man's bag.
robber.sentenceTrans: 强盗想要抢这个人的包。

robbery.definitionEn: the crime of stealing money or goods from a bank, shop/store, person, etc., especially using violence or threats
robbery.sentenceTrans: 我目击了一场银行抢劫案。
robbery.mnemonic: robb=rob抢 + ery行为，情况 → robbery抢劫

robot.definitionEn: a machine that is made to look like a human and that can do some things that a human can do
robot.sentence: In the future, we all will have robot assistants.
robot.sentenceTrans: 未来，我们都会有机器人助手。

rock.definitionEn: a precious stone, especially a diamond
rock.sentence: There were many large rocks on the seashore.
rock.sentenceTrans: 海边有许多大块的岩石。

rocket.definitionEn: a spacecraft in the shape of a tube that is driven by a stream of gases let out behind it when fuel is burned inside
rocket.sentence: The red rocket is flying over the clouds.
rocket.sentenceTrans: 红色的火箭在云层上飞行。

rod.definitionEn: a straight, thin stick or bar
rod.sentence: I hope this fishing rod is strong enough to catch a big fish.
rod.sentenceTrans: 但愿这鱼竿足够结实，可以钓起来大鱼。

role.definitionEn: an actor’s part in a play, film/movie, etc.
role.sentence: The actress played challenging roles in many different TV series.
role.sentenceTrans: 这名女演员在不同的电视剧里尝试了具有挑战性的角色。

roll.definitionEn: to turn over and over and move in a particular direction; to make a round object do this
roll.sentence: The kid is rolling the snowball to make it bigger.
roll.sentenceTrans: 小孩正在滚雪球，使它变得更大。

roller.definitionEn: a cylinder that turns around in a machine or device
roller.sentence: A roller can be used to paint a wall faster than a paintbrush.
roller.sentenceTrans: 用滚筒刷墙比用漆刷刷墙快。
roller.mnemonic: roll滚 + er表示物 → roller滚柱，滚筒，滚轴

romantic.definitionEn: connected or concerned with love or a sexual relationship;
romantic.sentence: On Valentine's Day, couples often go for a romantic dinner.
romantic.sentenceTrans: 情人节这天，情侣们通常会出去吃一顿浪漫的晚餐。
romantic.mnemonic: roman浪漫 + tic……的 → romantic浪漫的

roof.definition: 屋顶；顶部；  v.覆盖，给……盖屋顶
roof.definitionEn: the structure that covers or forms the top of a building or vehicle
roof.sentence: There's a window and a chimney on this roof.
roof.sentenceTrans: 屋顶上有一扇窗户和一个烟囱。

room.definitionEn: a part of a building that has its own walls, floor and ceiling and is usually used for a particular purpose
room.sentence: There are four rooms inside this apartment.
room.sentenceTrans: 这座公寓里有四个房间。

root.definition: 生根；  n.根，根茎，根部；根源
root.definitionEn: to grow roots; to cause or encourage a plant to grow roots
root.sentence: The tree deeply roots in the soil.
root.sentenceTrans: 这棵树深深地扎根于土壤之中。

rope.definitionEn: very strong thick string made by twisting thinner strings, wires, etc. together
rope.sentence: How thick a rope do we need?

rose.definition: 玫瑰，蔷薇；  v.rise的过去式
rose.definitionEn: a flower with a sweet smell that is usually white, yellow, red, or pink and that grows on a bush which has thorns on the stems

rotate.definition: 以……轴转动，使旋转；轮流，轮换
rotate.definitionEn: to move or turn around a central fixed point; to make something do this
rotate.sentence: She can rotate the stick very well.
rotate.sentenceTrans: 小樱可以很熟练地转动魔法棒。
rotate.mnemonic: rot轮子，转 + ate使 → 旋转

rotation.definitionEn: the act or process of moving or turning around a central point; the act of regularly changing the thing that is being used in a particular situation, or of changing the person who does a particular job
rotation.sentence: When the spinner finishes a rotation, it stops in a color zone.
rotation.sentenceTrans: 当转盘完成一次旋转后，它会停在一个颜色区域。
rotation.mnemonic: rot轮，转 + ation名词后缀 → 旋转；轮流，循环

rough.definitionEn: not exact; not including all details
rough.sentence: The hands of the farmer are rough.

round.definition: 圆的，球形的；  prep.在…周围，包围；  n.圆，圆形物；  v.（使）成圆形
round.definitionEn: shaped like a circle or ball
round.sentence: The shape of the earth is round.

rouse.sentence: My husband likes to rouse me with a gentle touch in the morning.
rouse.sentenceTrans: 每天早上，我丈夫喜欢轻轻地推醒我。

route.definitionEn: a way that you follow to get from one place to another; a fixed way along which a bus, train, etc. regularly travels or goods are regularly sent
route.sentence: This blue line is the quickest route to get there.
route.sentenceTrans: 这条蓝色的线是到那儿最快的路线。

routine.definition: 常规；  adj.例行的，惯例的
routine.definitionEn: the normal order and way in which you regularly do things; a situation in which life is boring because things are always done in the same way
routine.sentence: Going to school and reading books are parts of her daily routine.
routine.sentenceTrans: 上学和看书是她日常生活的一部分。
routine.mnemonic: rout(e)路线 + ine形容词后缀 → 路线设置好的 → routine常规的，例行的

row.definitionEn: a line of seats in a theater, stadium, etc.
row.sentence: Please follow me, our bus is parked in the third row.
row.sentenceTrans: 请跟我来，我们的巴士停在第三排。

royal.definition: 王室的，皇家的；盛大的，高贵的
royal.definitionEn: connected with or belonging to the king or queen of a country
royal.sentence: The king wears his royal clothes.
royal.sentenceTrans: 国王穿着他的御用衣服。

rub.definitionEn: to move your hand, or something such as a cloth, backwards and forwards over a surface while pressing firmly
rub.sentence: I like it when she rubs my forehead, since I have bad headaches.
rub.sentenceTrans: 我喜欢她揉我的前额，因为我有严重的头痛。

rubber.definition: 橡皮；橡胶制品，胶鞋；橡皮擦
rubber.definitionEn: a strong substance that stretches and that is made out of chemicals or from the juice of a tropical tree
rubber.sentence: Wear rubber gloves to do dirty work.
rubber.sentenceTrans: 戴上橡胶手套来做脏活。
rubber.mnemonic: rub擦 + b + er名词后缀：物 → rubber橡皮

rubbish.definitionEn: things that are no longer useful or wanted and that have been thrown out
rubbish.sentence: Please put your rubbish in the bag.
rubbish.sentenceTrans: 请把你的垃圾放在这个袋子里。

rude.definitionEn: having or showing a lack of respect for other people and their feelings
rude.sentence: It's very rude to jump the queue.

ruin.definitionEn: to damage (something) so badly that it is no longer useful, valuable, enjoyable, etc.; to spoil or destroy (something)
ruin.sentence: Our village was totally ruined by the UFO lasers.
ruin.sentenceTrans: 不明飞行物用射线完全摧毁了我们的村庄。

rule.definition: 【数】规则；统治，管辖；  v.统治，控制；支配；裁决
rule.definitionEn: to control and have authority over a country, a group of people, etc.
rule.sentence: In mathematics, the rule of addition is important to learn.
rule.sentenceTrans: 在数学里，学习加法规则是非常重要的。

ruler.definitionEn: a straight strip of wood, plastic or metal, marked in centimetres or inches, used for measuring or for drawing straight lines
ruler.sentence: This is a ruler that can measure in both inches and centimeters.
ruler.sentenceTrans: 这把尺子既有英寸刻度，又有厘米刻度。
ruler.mnemonic: rule统治、管理 + er表人 → ruler统治者、直尺

rumor.definitionEn: information or a story that is passed from person to person but has not been proven to be true

rumour.definitionEn: a piece of information, or a story, that people talk about, but that may not be true
rumour.sentence: The grapevine is notoriously inaccurate and can carry morale-damaging rumours.
rumour.sentenceTrans: 小道消息是出了名的不准确，可能会传播损害士气的谣言。

run.definition: 跑步，奔跑；  v.经营，管理
run.definitionEn: to move using your legs, going faster than when you walk
run.sentence: She ran across the street as fast as she could.
run.sentenceTrans: 吴妍珠拼尽全力向马路对面的（姜哲）跑去。

rural.definitionEn: connected with or like the countryside
rural.sentence: The rural area is beautiful and peaceful.
rural.sentenceTrans: 乡村的环境是美好而宁静的。
rural.mnemonic: rur农村 + al表形容词 → rural乡村的

rush.definition: 冲，奔；匆忙做；  n.冲，急速行进
rush.definitionEn: to move or do something very quickly or in a way that shows you are in a hurry
rush.sentence: I'll have to rush to the canteen; otherwise there'll be nothing left.
rush.sentenceTrans: 我得冲向食堂，不然什么吃的都没有了。

rust.definitionEn: if metal rusts or something rusts it, it becomes covered with rust; cause to deteriorate due to the action of water, air, or an acid
rust.sentence: This old car has already rusted.

sack.definition: 一袋；开除，解雇；  v.解雇；掠夺
sack.definitionEn: a large bag with no handles, made of strong rough material or strong paper or plastic, used for storing and carrying, for example flour, coal, etc.
sack.sentence: The old woman is carrying a sack of rubbish.
sack.sentenceTrans: 老妇人正拿着一袋垃圾。

sacrifice.definition: 牺牲；奉献；献祭；  n.牺牲；祭品
sacrifice.definitionEn: to give up something valued for the sake of other considerations
sacrifice.sentence: The kiwi sacrificed his life to protect his family and friends.
sacrifice.sentenceTrans: 为了保护家人和朋友，这只猕猴桃牺牲了自己的生命。
sacrifice.mnemonic: sacri神圣 + fice做，制作 → 为神做的东西 → sacrifice祭品；牺牲

sad.sentence: The boy is sad because he feels misunderstood.
sad.sentenceTrans: 男孩很难过，觉得自己不被理解。

sadness.definitionEn: the feeling of being sad; something which makes you sad
sadness.sentence: The boy looked at the ice cream on the ground with great sadness.
sadness.sentenceTrans: 这个男孩看着地上的冰激凌，非常伤心。
sadness.mnemonic: sad悲伤 + ness名词后缀 →  sadness悲哀

safe.definitionEn: a strong metal box or cupboard with a complicated lock, used for storing valuable things in, for example, money or jewelry
safe.sentence: The gold will be very safe here.
safe.sentenceTrans: 把金条放这里会很安全的。

safeguard.definitionEn: to protect something/somebody from loss, harm or damage; to keep something/somebody safe
safeguard.sentence: The job of the guards is to safeguard the money.
safeguard.sentenceTrans: 这些警卫的职责是保护财产安全。
safeguard.mnemonic: safe安全的 + guard保护 → 保护，维护

safety.definitionEn: freedom from harm or danger :the state of being safe
safety.sentence: Safety is important when cycling. Remember to wear a helmet!
safety.sentenceTrans: 骑车的时候安全很重要，记得戴上头盔！
safety.mnemonic: safe安全 + ty表名词 → 安全

sail.definitionEn: to control a ship or boat (especially one that has sails) while traveling on water
sail.sentence: The big boat sails off into the sunset.
sail.sentenceTrans: 这艘大船朝着落日航行。

sailor.definitionEn: a person who works on a ship as a member of the crew; a person who sails a boat
sailor.sentence: The sailor has been out to sea for several months.
sailor.sentenceTrans: 水手已经出海几个月了。
sailor.mnemonic: sail航行 + or名词后缀，表示人 → sailor水手，海员

sake.sentence: He wears the helmet for safety's sake.
sake.sentenceTrans: 出于安全考虑，他戴着头盔。

salad.definitionEn: a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, tomato and cucumber, usually served with other food as part of a meal
salad.sentence: I'm on a diet, so I'll just have a salad. Thanks!
salad.sentenceTrans: 我正在减肥，所以我只吃沙拉，谢谢！
salad.mnemonic: sal盐 + ad名词后缀 → 用盐腌渍的食品 → salad色拉，沙拉

salary.definitionEn: money that employees receive for doing their job, especially professional employees or people working in an office, usually paid every month
salary.sentence: They are receiving their monthly salary from Lord Bao.
salary.sentenceTrans: 他们正在包大人那儿领每月工资。
salary.mnemonic: sal盐 + ary名词后缀 → salary工资（古代工钱以盐多少计算）

sale.definitionEn: the act of selling something :the exchange of goods, services, or property for money
sale.sentence: The house sale is made when the key is handed over to the buyer.
sale.sentenceTrans: 当钥匙交到买家手中时，房屋买卖就完成了。

salesman.definitionEn: a person (especially a man) whose job is to sell things
salesman.sentence: The salesman told us the details about the house for sale.
salesman.sentenceTrans: 那个销售员告诉我们关于在售房屋的细节。
salesman.mnemonic: sales销售 + man人 → salesman售货员，推销员

salt.definition: 盐，食盐；  v.加盐于，用盐腌
salt.definitionEn: a white substance that is added to food to give it a better flavour or to preserve it
salt.sentence: Adding salt gives the dish more flavor.
salt.sentenceTrans: 加盐可以让菜肴更有滋味。

salutation.sentence: Salutations come in many forms, such as shaking hands, waving, or a simple Hello.
salutation.sentenceTrans: 打招呼的方式多种多样：握手、挥手，或者是简单的一句“你好”。
salutation.mnemonic: salut=salute问候 ＋ ation名词后缀 → salutation称呼；问候

same.definitionEn: not different；exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned.
same.sentence: These two squares are the same size.
same.sentenceTrans: 这两个正方形的大小是相同的。
same.mnemonic: sam同一的 + e → same相同的

sample.definition: (用于检验、分析的) 试样，样品；  adj.样品的，作为例子的；  v.抽样检查；抽取……的试样
sample.definitionEn: a small amount of a substance taken from a larger amount and tested in order to obtain information about the substance
sample.sentence: I'll need a sample of your blood to see if you're sick.
sample.sentenceTrans: 我需要你的血样来确定你是不是生病了。
sample.mnemonic: s分开 + ample拿 → 分开拿出 → sample标本

sand.definitionEn: a substance that consists of very small fine grains of rock; a large area of sand on a beach
sand.sentence: The children are playing in the sand.

sandwich.definitionEn: two pieces of bread with something (such as meat, peanut butter, etc.) between them
sandwich.sentence: The kids were really happy when I made them each a sandwich for lunch.
sandwich.sentenceTrans: 当我给孩子们每人做了一个三明治当午餐时，他们好开心。

satellite.definitionEn: an electronic device that is sent into space and moves around the earth or another planet. It is used for communicating by radio, television, etc. and for providing information.
satellite.sentence: This space satellite transmits TV signals to Earth.
satellite.sentenceTrans: 这颗人造卫星把电视信号传输到地球。
satellite.mnemonic:
sate足够，全部 + llite去 → 全速前进 → 跟随者，随从
follow → 人造卫星

satisfaction.definitionEn: the good feeling that you have when you have achieved something or when something that you wanted to happen does happen; something that gives you this feeling
satisfaction.sentence: I gave their service a good rating to show my satisfaction.
satisfaction.sentenceTrans: 我给了好评来表示我对他们的服务很满意。
satisfaction.mnemonic: satis足够，饱足 + faction名词后缀 → satisfaction满足

satisfactory.definitionEn: good enough for a particular purpose
satisfactory.sentence: The little boy had a satisfactory service at the barber shop.
satisfactory.sentenceTrans: 小男孩在理发店得到了令他满意的服务。
satisfactory.mnemonic: satis足够 + fact做 + ory表形容词 → satisfactory令人满意的

satisfied.definitionEn: pleased or content because you have got what you wanted
satisfied.sentence: The girl is very satisfied with the pizza.
satisfied.sentenceTrans: 这个女孩对披萨很满意。

satisfy.definitionEn: to make somebody pleased by doing or giving them what they want
satisfy.sentence: The boy went to a fast food restaurant to satisfy his desire for a hamburger.
satisfy.sentenceTrans: 男孩去快餐店满足了自己想吃汉堡包的欲望。
satisfy.mnemonic: satis足够，饱足 + fy化 → satisfy使…满足

saturday.definitionEn: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday
saturday.sentence: Saturday is the first day of the weekend.
saturday.sentenceTrans: 星期六是周末的第一天。
saturday.mnemonic: Satur=Saturn土星日，土曜日 + day天，日 → Saturday星期六

save.definition: 将（计算机上的信息）存盘，保存；节省，节约；拯救，挽救；  prep.除...外
save.definitionEn: to keep money instead of spending it; to put money away especially in a bank so that you will have it in the future
save.sentence: Don't forget to save your work regularly.

saving.definitionEn: an amount of something that is not spent or used
saving.sentence: You can get a 70% savings over the regular price for clothes on sale.
saving.sentenceTrans: 在打折时购买衣服，可以比平时节省70%的钱。
saving.mnemonic: sav(e)节省 + ing名词后缀 → saving节省

say.definitionEn: to speak or tell somebody something, using words
say.sentence: Why did you have to say it so loudly?

saying.definitionEn: an old and well-known phrase that expresses an idea that most people believe is true
saying.sentence: I hope the saying "No pain, no gain" isn't true.
saying.sentenceTrans: 我希望“没有付出，就没有收获”这句谚语说的不是真的。

scale.definition: 天平，磅秤；刻度，尺度，标度；等级，级别，等级体系；鳞片，鳞状物；规模；比例，比例尺；  v.攀登
scale.definitionEn: the size or extent of something, especially when compared with something else
scale.sentence: Stand on the weighing scale to get your weight.
scale.sentenceTrans: 站在体重秤上来测你的体重吧。

scan.definition: 扫描；浏览；细看；  n.扫描；浏览
scan.definitionEn: to pass light over a picture or document using a scanner in order to copy it and put it in the memory of a computer
scan.sentence: He is scanning the Chinese character for collecting cards.
scan.sentenceTrans: 他正在扫描这个汉字来集卡。

scarce.definition: 缺乏的，不足的；稀少的，罕见的
scarce.definitionEn: if something is scarce, there is not enough of it and it is only available in small quantities
scarce.sentence: Oil is becoming increasingly scarce on Earth.
scarce.sentenceTrans: 地球上的石油已经变得越来越匮乏了。

scarcely.sentence: His grandfather can scarcely hear his grandson speaking.
scarcely.sentenceTrans: 他祖父几乎听不到他孙子说的话。

scare.definition: 使害怕，惊吓；  n.惊恐，恐慌
scare.sentence: The one thing that scares me most is giant mice.
scare.sentenceTrans: 最让我害怕的一样东西就是巨大的老鼠。

scary.sentence: The house seems scary at night.
scary.sentenceTrans: 那栋房子晚上看起来很恐怖。

scatter.definitionEn: to throw or drop things in different directions so that they cover an area of ground; to move or to make people or animals move very quickly in different directions
scatter.sentence: The kid's room has toys scattered all over the ground.
scatter.sentenceTrans: 儿童房里的玩具散落满地。

scene.sentence: The sunset over the road created quite a beautiful scene.
scene.sentenceTrans: 道路尽头的日落创造了一幅唯美的景象。

scenery.definitionEn: the natural features of an area, such as mountains, valleys, rivers and forests, when you are thinking about them being attractive to look at
scenery.sentence: The leaves turn yellow in autumn, which provides some beautiful scenery.
scenery.sentenceTrans: 树叶在秋天变黄，平添了许多美景。
scenery.mnemonic: scen场景 + ery表场所，地点 → scenery风景，舞台布景

scenic.definitionEn: having, providing, or relating to a pleasing or beautiful view of natural scenery (such as mountains, hills, valleys, etc.)
scenic.sentence: These scenic islands are the perfect place to go traveling.
scenic.sentenceTrans: 这些景色优美的岛屿是旅行的绝佳地点。
scenic.mnemonic: scen=scene情景 + ic形容词，...的 → 自然景色的

scent.definitionEn: the pleasant smell that something has
scent.sentence: She loves the scent of the sunflower.

sceptical.definitionEn: marked by or given to doubt
sceptical.sentence: That doesn't sound right; I'm sceptical.
sceptical.sentenceTrans: 那听起来不对，我不相信。
sceptical.mnemonic: scept=skept怀疑 + ic表示人 + al ...的 → sceptic=skeptic怀疑者 + al...的 → sceptical（也作skeptical）表示怀疑的

scepticism.definitionEn: the disbelief in any claims of ultimate knowledge
scepticism.sentence: They have some scepticismabout the new product’s effectiveness
scepticism.sentenceTrans: 他们对这款新产品的效果存有一些怀疑。

schedule.definition: 时间表，计划表；  v.预订，安排
schedule.definitionEn: a plan that lists all the work that you have to do and when you must do each thing
schedule.sentence: According to my schedule, I will go shopping on Monday afternoon.
schedule.sentenceTrans: 根据我的日程表，星期一下午我会去购物。

scheme.definition: 方案，计划；阴谋，诡计；  v.图谋，密谋
scheme.definitionEn: a plan or system for doing or organizing something
scheme.sentence: Our scheme for the next game is a 4-4-2 formation.
scheme.sentenceTrans: 我们队下一场比赛的方案是使用442阵型。

scholar.definitionEn: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject because they have studied it in detail
scholar.sentence: She's so young, but she's quite a little scholar.
scholar.sentenceTrans: 她很年轻，但是已经是一个小小的学者了。
scholar.mnemonic: schol学派 + ar名词后缀，人 → scholar学者

scholarship.definitionEn: an amount of money that is given by a school, an organization, etc., to a student to help pay for the student's education
scholarship.sentence: She is an excellent student so she gets the scholarship every year.
scholarship.sentenceTrans: 她是一位优秀的学生，所以每年她都能得到奖学金。
scholarship.mnemonic: scholar学者 + ship表名词 → scholarship学问，学识

school.definitionEn: a place where children go to be educated
school.sentence: I've met a lot of friends at school.
school.sentenceTrans: 我在学校结识了很多朋友。

science.definitionEn: knowledge about the structure and behaviour of the natural and physical world, based on facts that you can prove, for example by experiments
science.sentence: Physics and Chemistry are two different areas of science.
science.sentenceTrans: 物理和化学是科学的两个不同领域。
science.mnemonic: sci知道 + ence名词后缀 → science科学；学科

scientific.definitionEn: involving science; connected with science; (of a way of doing something or thinking) careful and logical
scientific.sentence: Be very careful when doing scientific experiments.
scientific.sentenceTrans: 做科学实验时一定要小心。
scientific.mnemonic: sci知道 + ent……的 + ific表形容词 → 知道的很多的 → 科学的

scientist.definitionEn: a person who is trained in a science and whose job involves doing scientific research or solving scientific problems
scientist.sentence: They are distinguished scientists in the fields of biology and physics.
scientist.sentenceTrans: 他们是生物和物理领域杰出的科学家。
scientist.mnemonic: scient有知识的 + ist从事某种职业的人 → scientist科学家

scissors.definitionEn: a tool for cutting paper or cloth, that has two sharp blades with handles, joined together in the middle
scissors.sentence: I use scissors to cut her hair.

scold.definitionEn: to speak angrily to somebody, especially a child, because they have done something wrong
scold.sentenceTrans: 那位母亲斥责她的小孩。

scope.definitionEn: an instrument (such as a telescope or microscope) for looking through or watching something with
scope.sentence: A scope helps the shooter aim at great distances.
scope.sentenceTrans: 瞄准镜有助于射手进行远距离瞄准。

score.definition: 得分，分数；二十；乐谱；  v.得分
score.definitionEn: to win points, goals, etc. in a game or competition
score.sentence: Each judge gave him a full score.
score.sentenceTrans: 每个评委都给他打了满分。

scratch.definitionEn: a mark, a cut or an injury made by scratching somebody’s skin or the surface of something
scratch.sentence: I accidentally scratched the screen of my phone when I was exploring the ancient ruins.
scratch.sentenceTrans: 当我在探索古遗址时，不小心刮花了手机的屏幕。

scream.definition: （因愤怒或恐惧）高声喊、尖叫；尖叫着说出
scream.definitionEn: to give a loud, high cry, because you are hurt, frightened, excited, etc.
scream.sentence: This cute animal is screaming in fear.
scream.sentenceTrans: 这只可爱的动物因为害怕而尖叫。

screen.definitionEn: the flat surface at the front of a television, computer, or other electronic device, on which you see pictures or information; the large flat surface that films/movies or pictures are shown on
screen.sentence: The movie theater's screen is so large!
screen.sentenceTrans: 这个电影院的银幕好大！

screw.definition: 螺丝；  v.拧紧；  v.用螺钉固定；把…拧紧
screw.definitionEn: a thin pointed piece of metal like a nail with a raised spiral line (called a thread ) along it and a line or cross cut into its head. Screws are turned and pressed into wood, metal, etc. with a screwdriver in order to fasten two things together.
screw.sentence: At each turn, the screw goes further into this piece of wood.
screw.sentenceTrans: 每转一圈，螺丝就会往这块木头里钻得更深。
screw.mnemonic: shr切割 + w → screw螺丝，螺旋
