treat.sentence: The doctor is carefully treating the wound on the little girl's leg.
treat.sentenceTrans: 医生正在仔细治疗小女孩腿上的伤。

treatment.definitionEn: something that is done to cure an illness or injury, or to make somebody look and feel good
treatment.sentence: She is receiving treatment for a hand injury.
treatment.sentenceTrans: 她的手受伤了，正在接受治疗。
treatment.mnemonic: treat处理 + ment名词后缀 → treatment处理，治疗

treaty.definitionEn: a formal agreement between two or more countries
treaty.sentence: The two nations declared a ceasefire and penned a peace treaty.
treaty.sentenceTrans: 两个国家停战并签订了和平条约。
treaty.mnemonic: treat处理 + y表名词 → 作出处理的文件 → treaty条约；约定

tree.definitionEn: a tall plant that can live a long time. Trees have a thick central wooden trunk from which branches grow, usually with leaves on them
tree.sentence: The `add_child` method allows you to add child nodes to the tree.
tree.sentenceTrans: `add_child`方法允许你向树中添加子节点。

tremble.definition: 颤抖，哆嗦；（因害怕等而）颤抖；  n.颤抖，战栗
tremble.definitionEn: to shake in a way that you cannot control, especially because you are very nervous, excited, frightened, etc.
tremble.sentence: The horror movie made her tremble with fear.
tremble.sentenceTrans: 这个恐怖电影让她害怕得发抖。
tremble.mnemonic: trem颤抖 + ble能...的 → tremble颤抖，哆嗦

tremendous.sentence: I feel the tremendous pressure of car and house loans on my shoulders.
tremendous.sentenceTrans: 我感觉肩上扛着巨大的车贷和房贷压力。
tremendous.mnemonic: trem颤抖 + end尽头 + ous形容词后缀 → 让人颤抖的 → tremendous可怕的，惊人的

trend.definition: 趋势；趋向，动向；  v.倾向；走向
trend.definitionEn: a general direction in which a situation is changing or developing
trend.sentence: The trend of prices is still going up.
trend.sentenceTrans: 物价的趋势是仍在上涨。

trial.definition: 审判，审讯；考验；  v.审讯，审判，试验，试用
trial.definitionEn: the determination of a person's innocence or guilt by due process of law
trial.sentence: The judge in charge of the trial is listening to the lawyers.
trial.sentenceTrans: 负责此次审判的法官正在听取律师发言。
trial.mnemonic: tri=try审理 + al名词后缀，表行为 → trial审判

triangle.definitionEn: a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles; a thing in the shape of a triangle
triangle.sentence: A triangle has three angles and three sides.
triangle.sentenceTrans: 三角形有三个角和三条边。

tribe.definitionEn: (in developing countries) a group of people of the same race, and with the same customs, language, religion, etc., living in a particular area and often led by a chief; a large number of people
tribe.sentence: The primitive tribe people make the fire with wood.
tribe.sentenceTrans: 原始部落的人用木柴生火。

trick.definition: 捉弄，戏弄；哄骗；欺骗；  n.恶作剧，诡计，花招；诀窍
trick.definitionEn: to deceive by cunning or artifice
trick.sentence: He tricked his brother by pretending to be a ghost.
trick.sentenceTrans: 他假装成幽灵来捉弄他的弟弟。

trigger.definition: （枪等的）扳机；诱因；  v.【计】触发；  v.触发，引发，引起
trigger.definitionEn: the part of a gun that you press in order to fire it; something that is the cause of a particular reaction or development, especially a bad one
trigger.sentence: Pulling the gun's trigger causes it to fire.

trip.definition: 旅行，旅游；  v.绊倒，失足；轻快地走或跑
trip.definitionEn: a journey to a place and back again, especially a short one for pleasure or a particular purpose; the experience that somebody has if they take a powerful drug that affects the mind and makes them imagine things
trip.sentence: He is going to make a trip by plane.

triumph.definitionEn: a great success, achievement or victory
triumph.sentenceTrans: “我赢了！” 他在胜利时喊道。

troop.definition: 军队，部队；群；  v.结队而行
troop.definitionEn: soldiers, especially in large groups; one group of soldiers, especially in tanks or on horses
troop.sentence: The statues of the ancient troop are great historic heritage.
troop.sentenceTrans: 这支古老军队的雕像是伟大的历史遗迹。

tropical.definitionEn: coming from, found in or typical of the tropics
tropical.sentence: There is a variety of plants and animals in the tropical rainforest.
tropical.sentenceTrans: 热带雨林中有很多不同种类的动植物。
tropical.mnemonic: tropic回归线 + al形容词后缀 → tropical热带的

trouble.definition: 烦恼，忧虑；问题，麻烦；  v.（使）烦恼，麻烦
trouble.definitionEn: something that is wrong with a machine, vehicle, etc.
trouble.sentence: My car has broken down; I'm in big trouble now!
trouble.sentenceTrans: 我的车坏了，我现在麻烦大啦！

troublesome.definition: 令人烦恼的，讨厌的；困难的，棘手的
troublesome.definitionEn: causing trouble, pain, etc. over a long period of time
troublesome.sentence: Frequently feeling the call of nature can be so troublesome for old people.
troublesome.sentenceTrans: 对老人来说，总想上厕所实在是令人烦恼。
troublesome.mnemonic: trouble烦恼 + some……的 → troublesome令人烦恼的

trousers.definitionEn: a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist down and is divided into two parts to cover each leg separately
trousers.sentence: She wears a pair of yellow trousers.
trousers.sentenceTrans: 她穿了一条黄色的裤子。

truck.definition: 卡车；手推车；  v.用卡车装运
truck.definitionEn: a large vehicle for carrying heavy loads by road
truck.sentence: Big trucks carry goods across the country.
truck.sentenceTrans: 大卡车载着货在乡间穿行。

true.definitionEn: connected with facts rather than things that have been invented or guessed
true.sentence: The true identity of the shadow is a cat.
true.sentenceTrans: 影子的真正身份是一只猫。

truly.definitionEn: used to emphasize that a particular statement, feeling, etc. is sincere or genuine
truly.sentence: I truly love you from the bottom of my heart!
truly.sentenceTrans: 我真心爱你，从心底里爱你！
truly.mnemonic: tru=true真实 + ly表副词 → truly真正地，确实地

trumpet.definition: 喇叭，小号；小号声；  v.宣扬；鼓吹，吹嘘
trumpet.definitionEn: a thing shaped like a trumpet, especially the open flower of a daffodil
trumpet.sentence: We are trying our best to play the trumpet!
trumpet.sentenceTrans: 我们使出了吃奶的劲儿来吹喇叭！

trunk.definition: 树干；（人）躯干；大衣箱；象鼻
trunk.definitionEn: the long, flexible nose of an elephant
trunk.sentence: The bird is feeding on the trunk of the tree.

trust.definition: 信任，相信；盼望，希望；  n.委托
trust.definitionEn: to have confidence in somebody; to believe that somebody is good, sincere, honest, etc.; to believe that something is true or correct or that you can rely on it
trust.sentence: My boss trusts me so much. I can't let him down.
trust.sentenceTrans: 我的老板那么信任我，我不能让他失望。
trust.mnemonic: tru坚固，坚定 + st表名词  → （坚定地）相信  → trust信任

truth.definitionEn: the true facts about something, rather than the things that have been invented or guessed
truth.sentence: The truth is that the "Batman" is actually just the cat's shadow.
truth.sentenceTrans: 真相是这个“蝙蝠侠”只是这只猫的影子。
truth.mnemonic: tru相信，真实 + th抽象名词 → truth事实，真理

try.definition: 试图，努力；  n.努力，尝试
try.definitionEn: to use, do or test something in order to see if it is good, suitable, etc.
try.sentence: The woman is trying on a pair of high heels.
try.sentenceTrans: 这个女人正在试穿一双高跟鞋。

tube.definitionEn: a long, hollow object that is used especially to control the flow of a liquid or gas
tube.sentence: These tubes are made of steel.
tube.sentenceTrans: 这些管子都是由钢制成的。

tuesday.definitionEn: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday
tuesday.sentence: The first lesson on Tuesday is math.
tuesday.sentenceTrans: 周二的第一节课是数学课。

tuition.definitionEn: the money that you pay to be taught, especially in a college or university; the act of teaching something, especially to one person or to people in small groups
tuition.sentence: The students are queueing up to pay their tuition fees.
tuition.sentenceTrans: 这些学生在排队交学费。
tuition.mnemonic: tuit保护 + ion表名词 → 受教育的费用 → tuition学费；教导

tune.definition: 曲调，旋律，曲子；调音；  v.调整，校准；给……调音
tune.definitionEn: a series of musical notes that are sung or played in a particular order to form a piece of music
tune.sentence: Sure, I'll play a little tune for you.
tune.sentenceTrans: 当然，我会为你弹奏一曲。

tunnel.definitionEn: a passage built underground, for example to allow a road or railway/railroad to go through a hill, under a river, etc.
tunnel.sentence: The man dug a tunnel, trying to find the gold mine.
tunnel.sentenceTrans: 这个男人挖了一条地道，企图找到金矿。

turkey.definitionEn: large gallinaceous bird with fan-shaped tail; widely domesticated for food
turkey.sentence: The man is holding a big roast turkey.
turkey.sentenceTrans: 这个男人手里拿着一只大的烤火鸡。

turn.definition: 转动；  n.机会；变化，转变
turn.definitionEn: to move or make something move around a central point
turn.sentence: The man turned the stone to unlock the door.
turn.sentenceTrans: 为了打开（奥古公主的）墓门，凯爷转了转面前（标有彼岸花图案）的石盘。（《鬼吹灯之寻龙诀》）

tutor.definition: 导师；家庭教师，指导教师；  v.个别指导
tutor.definitionEn: a private teacher, especially one who teaches an individual student or a very small group
tutor.sentence: He is a tutor in physics.
tutor.mnemonic: tut保护 + or人 → tutor保护人，导师，教师

tv.sentence: We can watch TV at my house.
tv.sentenceTrans: 我们可以在我家看电视。

twelfth.sentence: It's the boy's twelfth birthday, which means he's arriving at puberty.
twelfth.sentenceTrans: 这是他的第十二个生日，意味着他快到青春期了。
twelfth.mnemonic: twelf=twelve十二 + th第…/…分之一 → twelfth第十二；十二分之一的

twelve.sentence: There are twelve eggs in a box.

twentieth.sentence: Today is our twentieth wedding anniversary!
twentieth.sentenceTrans: 今天是我们结婚20周年纪念日！
twentieth.mnemonic: twenti=twenty二十 + eth第... → twentieth第二十

twenty.definitionEn: numbers, years or temperatures from 20 to 29
twenty.sentence: They give twenty percent discount for online payment. Take out your phone!
twenty.sentenceTrans: 在线支付的话可以打八折，快把你手机拿出来！

twice.sentence: I go swimming twice a week.
twice.mnemonic: twi二，两 + ce副词后缀，…次 → twice二次

twin.definition: 双胞胎之一；  adj.孪生的
twin.definitionEn: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother

twist.definition: 扭；歪曲；拧，捻，搓；  n.搓，扭，拧
twist.definitionEn: to bend or turn something into a particular shape; to bend or turn something into a shape or position that is not normal or natural; to be bent or turned in this way; to turn something around in a circle with your hand; to injure part of your body, especially your ankle, wrist or knee, bending it in an awkward way
twist.sentence: The right way to eat this biscuit is to twist it, lick it, then dip it.
twist.sentenceTrans: 吃这种饼干的正确方式是扭一扭，舔一舔，再泡一泡。

two.sentence: There are two cups of coffee on the table.

type.definition: 类型，种类；  v.打字；成为…的典型
type.definitionEn: a class or group of people or things that share particular qualities or features and are part of a larger group; a kind or sort
type.sentence: There are several types of dogs for sale.
type.sentenceTrans: 这里有几个种类的狗在售卖。

typewriter.definitionEn: a machine that prints letters or figures on a sheet of paper when a person pushes its keys
typewriter.sentence: The author used a typewriter to write the novel.
typewriter.sentenceTrans: 作家用打字机来写小说。
typewriter.mnemonic: type打字 ＋ writer用来打字的东西 → typewriter打字机

typhoon.definitionEn: an extremely large, powerful, and destructive storm that occurs especially in the region of the Philippines or the China Sea
typhoon.sentence: The trees and houses were blown away by the powerful typhoon.
typhoon.sentenceTrans: 树木和房子都被强劲的台风吹走了。

typical.definitionEn: having the usual qualities or features of a particular type of person, thing or group
typical.sentence: It's typical of many Japanese to eat rice this way.
typical.sentenceTrans: 这是许多日本人吃米饭的典型方式。
typical.mnemonic: typ类型 + ical…的 → 成模式的 → typical典型的

typically.definition: 一般地，通常地；代表性地，典型地
typically.sentence: Typically, when you travel to Beijing, you would try the roasted duck.
typically.sentenceTrans: 通常来说，当你去北京旅行时，你会去吃烤鸭。
typically.mnemonic: typ模式，形状 ＋ ic...的 ＋ ally...地 → typically代表性地；作为特色地

typist.definitionEn: a person who works in an office typing letters, etc.; a person who uses a typewriter or computer keyboard
typist.sentence: The typist is finishing her documents.
typist.sentenceTrans: 打字员正在完成她的文件。
typist.mnemonic: typ=type打字 + ist从事某种职业的人 → typist打字员

tyre.definitionEn: a thick piece of rubber which is fitted onto the wheels of vehicles such as cars, buses, and bicycles
tyre.sentence: A car needs four tyres to drive.
tyre.sentenceTrans: 一辆汽车需要四个轮子来行驶。

ugly.sentence: I have never seen such an ugly dog as this.
ugly.sentenceTrans: 我从未见过如此丑的狗。
ugly.mnemonic: ug害怕，恐惧 + ly表形容词，有…特质的 → ugly令人不快的；丑陋的

ultimate.sentence: My ultimate goal is to buy a house.
ultimate.sentenceTrans: 我的终极目标是买套房子。
ultimate.mnemonic: ult(er)那边的 + im最高级后缀 + ate形容词后缀 → 最那边的，最终的

umbrella.definitionEn: an object with a round folding frame of long straight pieces of metal covered with material, that you use to protect yourself from the rain or from hot sun
umbrella.mnemonic: umbr阴影 + ella小东西 → 带来影子的小东西 → umbrella伞

unable.sentence: What to do? Obviously I'm unable to climb these stairs in my wheelchair!
unable.sentenceTrans: 我该怎么办？很明显我坐在轮椅上不能爬楼梯！
unable.mnemonic: un不 + able能够…的 → unable不能的, 不会的

uncertain.definitionEn: feeling doubt about something; not sure
uncertain.sentence: He was uncertain of the correct answer to the multiple choice question.
uncertain.sentenceTrans: 他不确定这道选择题的正确答案是哪个。
uncertain.mnemonic: un不，没有 ＋ certain确实的 → uncertain不确定的，靠不住的

uncle.definition: 伯父，叔父，舅父，姑父，姨父
uncle.definitionEn: the brother of your mother or father; the husband of your aunt
uncle.sentence: My dad and uncle look very much alike.
uncle.sentenceTrans: 我的爸爸和叔叔看起来很像。

uncomfortable.definition: 不舒服的；不自在的，尴尬的
uncomfortable.definitionEn: anxious, embarrassed or afraid and unable to relax; making you feel like this; not feeling physically relaxed, warm, etc.; unpleasant or difficult to deal with
uncomfortable.sentence: She looked uncomfortable at the crowded airport.
uncomfortable.sentenceTrans: 她在机场拥挤的人群中看起来很不自在。
uncomfortable.mnemonic: un不，没有 + com一起 + fort强大、力量 + able形容词后缀，能…的 → 不能一起强大 → uncomfortable不舒服的

unconscious.definitionEn: (of feelings, thoughts, etc.) existing or happening without you realizing or being aware; not deliberate or controlled
unconscious.sentence: We found him unconscious on the floor.
unconscious.sentenceTrans: 我们发现他倒在地上，不省人事。
unconscious.mnemonic: un表否定 + con共同 + sci知道 + ous…的 → 什么都不知道 → unconscious无意识的，不知不觉的

uncover.definition: 揭露；移去……的覆盖物，发现
uncover.definitionEn: to remove something that is covering something
uncover.sentence: He uncovered a classified secret to the public.
uncover.sentenceTrans: 他向公众揭露了一个机密。
uncover.mnemonic: un打开，解开 + cover盖子 → uncover揭开盖子

under.definitionEn: in, to or through a position that is below something; below the surface of something; covered by something
under.sentence: The cat is hiding under the sofa.

underestimate.definitionEn: to not realize how good, strong, determined, etc. somebody really is
underestimate.sentence: The worst thing you can do is underestimate an opponent.
underestimate.sentenceTrans: 最严重的错误就是低估对手。
underestimate.mnemonic: under不足，不够 + estimate估计 → underestimate估计不足

undergo.definition: 经历；遭受，经受（变化、不快等）
undergo.definitionEn: to experience something, especially a change or something unpleasant
undergo.sentence: He underwent strict training before he officially became an armed police.
undergo.sentenceTrans: 他在正式成为武警之前接受了严格的训练。

undergraduate.definitionEn: a university or college student who is studying for their first degree
undergraduate.sentence: The undergraduate has spent four years at university and will hopefully graduate soon.
undergraduate.sentenceTrans: 这名本科学生已经度过了四年的大学时光并将顺利毕业。
undergraduate.mnemonic: under低于，不够 + graduate毕业生 → undergraduate沿未毕业者，大学肄业生

underground.definition: 地下的；秘密的；  n.地铁；  adv.在地下；秘密地
underground.definitionEn: under the surface of the ground; operating secretly and often illegally, especially against a government
underground.mnemonic: under在…下 + ground地 → underground地下的

underline.definitionEn: to draw a line under a word, sentence, etc.; to emphasize or show that something is important or true
underline.sentence: It is a good habit to underline the important parts when you read.
underline.sentenceTrans: 在阅读时，勾画重要的部分是一个好习惯。
underline.mnemonic: under在…下 + line线 → 划线于…下

undermine.definitionEn: to make something, especially somebody’s confidence or authority, gradually weaker or less effective
undermine.sentenceTrans: 网络罪犯破坏互联网的安全。
undermine.mnemonic: under在…下 + mine开采 → 挖墙脚 → undermine破坏，损坏

underneath.definitionEn: under or below something else, especially when it is hidden or covered by the thing on top
underneath.mnemonic: under下 ＋ neath下面 → underneath在下面

understand.definitionEn: to know the meaning of (something, such as the words that someone is saying or a language)
understand.mnemonic: under在下面 + stand站立、立场 → 同一立场的 → understand理解，明白

undertake.definitionEn: to make yourself responsible for something and start doing it
undertake.sentence: Companies should undertake greater responsibility for reducing their carbon emissions.
undertake.sentenceTrans: 企业应承担更大的责任来减少碳排放。

undertaking.definitionEn: a task or project, especially one that is important and/or difficult
undertaking.sentence: Having babies is a huge undertaking.
undertaking.sentenceTrans: 抚养孩子是一项很重大的事业。
undertaking.mnemonic: under下 ＋ tak进行 ＋ ing名词后缀 → undertaking承诺；事业

undo.definition: 松开，解开；取消，撤销；毁掉
undo.definitionEn: to open something that is fastened, tied or wrapped
undo.sentence: At the end of the day, the man undoes his tie.
undo.sentenceTrans: 一天结束后，这个男人松了松领带。
undo.mnemonic: un除去，解开 + do做 → undo取消，解开

undoubtedly.definitionEn: used to emphasize that something is absolutely true or unquestionable
undoubtedly.sentence: Just as the sun rises in the east, it undoubtedly sets in the west.
undoubtedly.sentenceTrans: 正如太阳从东方升起，它肯定会在西方落下。
undoubtedly.mnemonic: un无 ＋ doubt怀疑 ＋ ed形容词后缀 ＋ ly...地 → undoubtedly无容置疑，肯定地

uneasy.definition: 心神不宁；令人不安的；心神不安的，不自在的；忧虑的
uneasy.definitionEn: feeling worried or unhappy about a particular situation, especially because you think that something bad or unpleasant may happen or because you are not sure that what you are doing is right; not certain to last; not safe or settled; that does not enable you to relax or feel comfortable
uneasy.sentence: Insomnia made the man feel uneasy.
uneasy.sentenceTrans: 失眠让这个男人感到不安。
uneasy.mnemonic: un不 + eas放松 + y形容词后缀 → uneasy心神不安的

unexpected.definitionEn: if something is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it
unexpected.sentence: Something unexpected happened when they were posing.
unexpected.sentenceTrans: 当他们在摆造型的时候，让人意想不到的事情发生了。
unexpected.mnemonic: un不 ＋ expect期望 ＋ ed“...的” → unexpected想不到的，意外的，突然的

unfair.definitionEn: not right or fair according to a set of rules or principles; not treating people equally
unfair.sentence: This is unfair! Why is he more important than us!
unfair.sentenceTrans: 这不公平！凭什么他比我们更重要！
unfair.mnemonic: un不 + fair公平的 → unfair不公平的

unfamiliar.sentence: The old man is unfamiliar with computers.

unfold.definitionEn: to spread open or flat something that has previously been folded; to become open and flat
unfold.sentence: He unfolds the map to see which way to go next.
unfold.sentenceTrans: 他展开地图，想看看接下来走哪条路。

unfortunate.definitionEn: having bad luck; caused by bad luck
unfortunate.sentence: I’m so unfortunate—why does it only rain on me?
unfortunate.sentenceTrans: 我真不幸，为什么雨只下在我头上？
unfortunate.mnemonic: un不，没有 + fortun运气 + ate形容词后缀 → unfortunate不幸的

unfortunately.definitionEn: used to say that a particular situation or fact makes you sad or disappointed, or gets you into a difficult position
unfortunately.sentence: Unfortunately, a heavy rain interrupted their romantic dinner.
unfortunately.sentenceTrans: 不幸的是，一场大雨打断了他们浪漫的晚餐。
unfortunately.mnemonic: un不 + fortun=fortune运气 + ate造成…的 + ly有…特征的 → unfortunately遗憾的是，可惜的是

uniform.definition: 制服，军服；  adj.统一的，一致的
uniform.definitionEn: the special set of clothes worn by all members of an organization or a group at work, or by children at school
uniform.sentence: The singer gave out school uniforms as gifts to fans at the concert.
uniform.sentenceTrans: 歌手在演唱会上把校服当作礼物送给粉丝。
uniform.mnemonic: uni一个，单一 + form形状 → uniform制服

unify.definitionEn: to join people, things, parts of a country, etc. together so that they form a single unit
unify.sentence: People are unified when facing natural disasters.
unify.sentenceTrans: 自然灾害让人们团结起来。
unify.mnemonic: uni一个，单一 + fy动词后缀，使成为… → unify统一

union.definitionEn: an organization of workers formed to protect the rights and interests of its members
union.sentence: The union is trying to protect their rights as workers.
union.sentenceTrans: 工会在努力保护他们作为劳动者的权利。
union.mnemonic: un单一 + ion名词后缀 → 联成一体 → 联合，工会，联盟

unique.definition: 独一无二的，独特的，特别的
unique.definitionEn: being the only one of its kind
unique.sentence: This square apple looks unique in a pile of round ones.
unique.sentenceTrans: 这个方苹果在一堆圆苹果中显得独一无二。
unique.mnemonic: uni一个 + que形容词后缀 → unique独立无二的，独特的

unit.definitionEn: a group of people who work or live together, especially for a particular purpose
unit.sentence: We will succeed if we work as a unit.
unit.sentenceTrans: 如果我们万众一心，就能成功。

unite.definitionEn: to join together with other people in order to do something as a group
unite.sentence: Humans across the globe should unite in their efforts to fight the virus.
unite.sentenceTrans: 全人类应该团结起来共同抗击病毒。
unite.mnemonic: uni一个，单一 + te动词后缀，促成 → unite团结，合并

united.definition: 团结的，和谐的；联合的，统一的
united.sentence: The six of us are united and working on a business plan together.
united.sentenceTrans: 我们六人团结一致，一起制定商业计划。
united.mnemonic: unit单元 + ed形容词后缀 → 统一的，联合的

unity.definitionEn: the state of being in agreement and working together; the state of being joined together to form one unit
unity.sentence: Our group's strength lies in our unity.
unity.sentenceTrans: 我们队伍的力量来源于我们的团结！
unity.mnemonic: uni一个 + ty名词后缀 → 成为一个整体 → 联合；统一体；团结

universal.definition: 普遍的，全体的；广泛适用的
universal.definitionEn: existent or operative everywhere or under all conditions; done by or involving all the people in the world or in a particular group; of worldwide scope or applicability
universal.sentence: Electronic devices such as cellphones are universal now.
universal.sentenceTrans: 如今像手机这样的电子设备已经得到了普及。
universal.mnemonic: uni一个 + vers=versus转变 + al具有...性质的 → 变成一个的 → universal普遍的，全体的

universe.definitionEn: the whole of space and everything in it, including the earth, the planets and the stars; a system of stars, planets, etc. in space outside our own; a particular area of experience or activity
universe.sentence: There are a lot of stars in the universe.
universe.mnemonic: uni一个 + vers转向 + e → 统一旋转 → universe宇宙

university.definitionEn: a school that offers courses leading to a degree (such as a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree) and where research is done
university.sentence: Tsinghua University is one of the most famous universities in China.
university.sentenceTrans: 清华大学是国内最知名的大学之一。
university.mnemonic: univers宇宙 + ity名词 → 由宇宙引申为知识，知识之地 → university大学

unjustified.sentence: We believe that Your Highness's faith will not be unjustified.
unjustified.sentenceTrans: 我们相信，陛下的信心不会落空。

unless.definitionEn: used to say that something can only happen or be true in a particular situation
unless.sentence: The river won’t get clean unless we stop polluting it.
unless.sentenceTrans: 除非我们停止污染，否则这条河不会变干净。

unlike.definitionEn: different from a particular person or thing; used to contrast somebody/something with another person or thing; not typical of somebody/something
unlike.sentence: These two men  have muscles that are unlike each other.
unlike.sentenceTrans: 这两个男人的手臂肌肉很不一样。
unlike.mnemonic: un不 + like像 → unlike与……不像、不同

unlikely.definitionEn: not likely to happen; not probable.
unlikely.sentence: "Wow! There are seven twos! It's extremely unlikely to see this many."
unlikely.sentenceTrans: 哇！竟然有七个2！能看到这么多真是极其罕见。

unload.definitionEn: to remove things from a vehicle or ship after it has taken them somewhere
unload.sentence: It's going to take all afternoon to unload these boxes.
unload.sentenceTrans: 要把这些箱子卸下来得花一个下午的时间。
unload.mnemonic: un由……中弄出 + load装载 → 把东西从车上弄下来 → unload卸货

unnecessary.definition: 不必要的，不需要的，多余的
unnecessary.definitionEn: not needed; more than is needed; (of remarks, etc.) not needed in the situation and likely to be offensive
unnecessary.sentence: Grandma tidied up some unnecessary items.
unnecessary.sentenceTrans: 外婆整理出一些不必要的杂物。
unnecessary.mnemonic: un不 + necess必要 + ary 表示有……性质的 → unnecessary不必要的，无用的

unpleasant.definitionEn: not pleasant or comfortable; not kind, friendly or polite
unpleasant.sentence: There's an unpleasant smell coming out from the refrigerator.
unpleasant.sentenceTrans: 有股难闻的味道从冰箱里冒了出来。
unpleasant.mnemonic: un不 + pleas=please快乐 + ant……的 → unpleasant令人不快的

until.definition: 到……为止；直到（某时刻）为止；  conj.到……为止，直到……才
until.definitionEn: used to indicate the time when something will happen, become true, etc.
until.sentence: He continued working until it got dark.

unusual.definitionEn: different from what is usual or normal
unusual.sentence: That guy has an unusual ability! He can fly!
unusual.sentenceTrans: 这个男人有不寻常的能力！他会飞！
unusual.mnemonic: un不 + usual通常的 → unusual不平常的；与众不同的

unwilling.definition: 不愿意的，不情愿的，勉强的
unwilling.sentence: The dog is unwilling to follow its master.
unwilling.sentenceTrans: 这只狗不愿意跟着它的主人走。
unwilling.mnemonic: un不 + will愿意 + ing...的 → unwilling不愿意的

up.definitionEn: towards or in a higher position; to or at a higher level
up.sentence: My balloon is flying up into the sky!

up-to-date.definition: 时新的，新式的；最新的，现代的
up-to-date.definitionEn: modern; fashionable; having or including the most recent information
up-to-date.sentence: A smart phone is the most up-to-date way to get important information.
up-to-date.sentenceTrans: 智能手机是获取重要信息的最新方式。

upgrade.definitionEn: to make a piece of machinery, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient
upgrade.sentence: I decided to upgrade my wardrobe with some trendy pieces this season.
upgrade.sentenceTrans: 我决定在这个季节用一些流行单品来升级我的衣橱。
upgrade.mnemonic: up向上 + grade步，级 → 向上升级 → 上升，升级

upon.definitionEn: used to emphasize that there is a large number or amount of something
upon.sentence: Once upon a time, there was a temple upon a mountain.
upon.sentenceTrans: 从前有座山，山上有座庙。
upon.mnemonic: up向上 + on在...上面 → upon在...上面

upper.definitionEn: at or near the top of something; located above something else, especially something of the same type or the other of a pair
upper.sentence: You can see the entire city from the upper floors of the building.
upper.sentenceTrans: 从大厦的高层，你可以看到整个城市。

upright.definitionEn: in or into a vertical position
upright.sentence: He sits in an upright position to ease his back.
upright.sentenceTrans: 他用笔直的姿势坐着来减轻背部不适。
upright.mnemonic: up向上 ＋ right直 → upright垂直的，正直的

upset.definition: 苦恼的，沮丧的，心烦意乱的；  v.使苦恼
upset.definitionEn: unhappy or disappointed because of something unpleasant that has happened
upset.sentence: The little boy is upset about his test.
upset.sentenceTrans: 这个小男孩正为考试苦恼。
upset.mnemonic: up向上 + set安置好 → 把底向上放 → upset打翻

upstairs.definition: 往楼上，在楼上；  adj.楼上的；  n.楼上，二楼
upstairs.definitionEn: the floor or floors in a building that are above the ground floor
upstairs.sentence: The dog ran upstairs to eat his food.
upstairs.mnemonic: upstair在楼上 ＋ s表副词 → upstairs在楼上，往楼上

upward.definitionEn: towards a higher place or position
upward.sentence: The pilot tried to pull the aircraft into an upward climb.
upward.sentenceTrans: 飞行员试着驾驶飞机向上爬升。
upward.mnemonic: up向上 + ward向... → upward向上的

upwards.definitionEn: in a direction from lower to higher
upwards.sentence: The roller coaster was going upwards along the track very fast.
upwards.sentenceTrans: 过山车正沿着轨道向上飞驰。
upwards.mnemonic: up向上 + wards表副词，向... → 向下，朝上

urban.definitionEn: connected with a town or city
urban.sentence: I like urban environments, especially the night scenes.
urban.sentenceTrans: 我喜欢都市的环境，尤其是夜景。
urban.mnemonic: urb城市 + an…的 → urban城市的

urbanisation.sentence: A guide explained urbanisation while pointing at cranes above the new station.
urbanisation.sentenceTrans: 一名向导指着新车站上方的起重机讲解都市化。

urbanise.definitionEn: impart urban habits, ways of life, or responsibilities upon
urbanise.sentence: Many farming areas were urbanised in the past twenty years, with new roads and tall buildings.
urbanise.sentenceTrans: 许多农业地区在过去二十年里被城镇化，建起了新道路和高楼。

urbanization.definitionEn: the process by which towns and cities are formed and become larger as more and more people begin living and working in central areas
urbanization.sentence: Modern China's urbanization is turning what used to be rural areas into cities.
urbanization.sentenceTrans: 现代中国的城市化就是将过去的农村地区变成城市。
urbanization.mnemonic: urban城市的 ＋ ization名词后缀，...化 → urbanization都市化

urbanize.definitionEn: to make an area of countryside or a village into a town or part of one
urbanize.sentence: The government is spending a lot of money to urbanize some parts of China.
urbanize.sentenceTrans: 政府花费了大量资金以推动中国某些地区的城镇化进程。
urbanize.mnemonic: urban城市的 ＋ ize动词后缀，使…化 → urbanize使都市化

urge.definition: 催促；强烈要求；  n.强烈的愿望
urge.definitionEn: to advise or try hard to persuade somebody to do something
urge.sentence: The mother urged her little one to hurry up and have dinner while it's still warm.
urge.sentenceTrans: 妈妈催促她的小宝贝赶快吃晚饭，趁还热的时候。

urgent.definitionEn: very important and needing immediate attention
urgent.sentence: The cat’s most urgent need now is to pee.
urgent.sentenceTrans: 这只猫现在迫切需要上厕所。
urgent.mnemonic: urg紧急 ＋ ent具有...性质的 → urgent紧急的；强求的

us.definitionEn: used when the speaker or writer and another or others are the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
us.sentence: All of us are enjoying the party.
us.sentenceTrans: 我们所有人在派对上都很开心。

usage.definitionEn: the way in which words are used in a language; the fact of something being used; how much something is used
usage.sentence: The teacher wrote the correct usage of the word on the board.
usage.sentenceTrans: 老师在黑板上写了这个单词的正确用法。
usage.mnemonic: us用 + age状态 → 用的状态 → usage用法；惯例

use.definition: 使用，利用，消耗；  n.使用权（读作/juːs/）；用途，效用
use.definitionEn: to do something with a machine, a method, an object, etc. for a particular purpose
use.sentence: I use a pencil to draw a picture.

used.definition: 旧的；习惯的，惯常的；二手的，使用过的
used.sentence: Used plastic bottles can be recycled.
used.sentenceTrans: 用过的塑料瓶可以回收利用。

useful.definitionEn: that can help you to do or achieve what you want; good; of the right standard
useful.sentence: A Swiss Army knife contains many different useful tools.
useful.sentenceTrans: 一把瑞士军刀有许多不同且实用的工具。
useful.mnemonic: use用 + ful可…的 → useful有用的

usual.definitionEn: that happens or is done most of the time or in most cases
usual.sentence: As per usual, he becomes sleepy in the afternoon.
usual.sentenceTrans: 通常，他下午就开始犯困。
usual.mnemonic: usu用 + al...的 → 平时经常用的 → usual通常的

usually.definitionEn: in the way that is usual or normal; most often
usually.sentenceTrans: 我们通常在十二点吃午饭。
usually.mnemonic: usual通常的 + ly副词后缀 → usually通常地，惯常地

utilise.definitionEn: (formal) to use something, especially for a practical purpose
utilise.sentence: We utilise recycled aluminum cans to make new ones.
utilise.sentenceTrans: 我们利用回收铝罐制造新的。

utility.definitionEn: a service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply; (formal) the quality of being useful; a piece of computer software that performs a particular task
utility.sentence: Utility measures satisfaction from consuming goods and services.
utility.sentenceTrans: 效用衡量消费商品和服务的满意度。
utility.mnemonic: util用 + ity名词后缀，状态 → utility公用事业，有用

utilize.definitionEn: to use something, especially for a practical purpose
utilize.sentence: It's better to utilize waste than to throw it away.
utilize.sentenceTrans: 废物再利用总比把它扔掉要好。
utilize.mnemonic: ut用 + ilize动词后缀，……化 → utilize利用

utmost.definition: 最大的，极度的；最远的；  n.极限
utmost.definitionEn: of the highest point or degree that can be reached
utmost.sentence: I drive to the utmost extent; it is so fast.
utmost.sentenceTrans: 我把车开到了最大速度，真是太快了。
utmost.mnemonic: ut=out向外 + most最多的 → utmost极度的

utter.definitionEn: to make a sound with your voice; to say something
utter.sentence: Utter whiteness is the color of these apples.

vacant.definition: 空的，未被占用的；空缺的
vacant.definitionEn: (of a seat, hotel room, house, etc.) empty; not being used
vacant.sentence: There is a vacant seat between those two people.
vacant.sentenceTrans: 那两个人之间有一个空位。

vacation.definitionEn: a period of time spent travelling or resting away from home
vacation.sentence: The girl took a vacation on the beach.
vacation.mnemonic: vac空 + ation表名词 → vacation假期

vague.definition: 含糊的，模糊的；不明确的
vague.definitionEn: not clear in a person’s mind; not having or giving enough information or details about something; (of a person’s behaviour) suggesting a lack of clear thought or attention; not having a clear shape
vague.sentence: This sign is too vague! I have no idea what it means.
vague.sentenceTrans: 这个路标太混乱了，我不知道它到底是什么意思。

vain.definition: 徒劳的；徒然的，没用的；自负的
vain.definitionEn: too proud of your own appearance, abilities or achievements
vain.sentence: Throw away the chocolate, or your efforts to lose weight will be in vain.
vain.sentenceTrans: 扔掉那块巧克力，不然你为减肥所做的努力就白费了。

valid.definition: 有效的，正式认可的；合理的，有根据的
valid.definitionEn: that is legally or officially acceptable; that is accepted by the system
valid.sentence: The official stamp showed that the document was valid.
valid.sentenceTrans: 这枚公章证明这份文件是有效的。

valley.definitionEn: an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it; the land that a river flows through
valley.sentence: A small stream flows through the valley.

valuable.definition: 宝贵的，有价值的；值钱的；  n.（复数）贵重物品
valuable.definitionEn: very useful or important; worth a lot of money
valuable.sentence: My grandfather left me valuable jewelry.
valuable.sentenceTrans: 我的祖父给我留下了贵重的珠宝。
valuable.mnemonic: valu=value价值 + able形容词后缀 → valuable有价值的

value.definitionEn: (not used in the progressive tenses) to think that somebody/something is important
value.sentence: Which do you value more—the economy or the environment?
value.sentenceTrans: 经济和环境，你更重视哪个呢？

van.definitionEn: a covered vehicle with no side windows in its back half, usually smaller than a lorry/truck, used for carrying goods or people
van.sentence: Food vans on the street have the cheapest and best food!
van.sentenceTrans: 街边的流动食品车有着最物美价廉的食物！

vanish.definition: 消失，绝迹；突然不见；消灭；  v.使消失；使不见
vanish.definitionEn: to disappear suddenly and/or in a way that you cannot explain
vanish.sentence: The magician waved the wand and the woman vanished.
vanish.sentenceTrans: 魔术师挥动了一下魔杖，那位女士就消失了。
vanish.mnemonic: van空 + ish动词后缀 → 凭空消失了 → vanish突然不见，消失

vapor.definitionEn: a mass of very small drops of liquid in the air, for example steam
vapor.sentence: Water turns into vapor when we boil it.
vapor.sentenceTrans: 水加热之后会变成蒸汽。

vapour.definitionEn: a mass of very small drops of liquid in the air, for example steam
vapour.sentence: Water vapour arose from the boiling pool.
vapour.sentenceTrans: 水蒸气从沸腾的池塘中升起。

variable.definition: 可变的；易变的，可变的；  n.【计】变量
variable.definitionEn: often changing; likely to change; able to be changed
variable.sentence: Individual responses to the same medication can be highly variable due to genetic and metabolic differences.
variable.sentenceTrans: 由于遗传和代谢差异，个体对同一种药物的反应可能非常多变。
variable.mnemonic: vari=vary变化 + able形容词后缀 → 易变的

variety.definitionEn: a form of theatre or television entertainment that consists of a series of short performances, such as singing, dancing and funny acts
variety.sentence: There is a wide variety of tomatoes; they are different in color.
variety.sentenceTrans: 番茄有很多种类，颜色各不相同。
variety.mnemonic: vari变化 + ety名词后缀 → variety变化，多样化

various.definitionEn: having many different features; several different
various.sentence: We saw various types of fish during our dive.
various.sentenceTrans: 潜水时，我们看到了各种各样的鱼。
various.mnemonic: vari变化 + ous形容词后缀 → various不相同的

vary.definition: 相异；（根据情况）变化；使多样化
vary.definitionEn: (of a group of similar things) to be different from each other in size, shape, etc.
vary.sentence: Each cup on the table varies in color and size.
vary.sentenceTrans: 桌上的每个杯子颜色和大小各不相同。

vast.definitionEn: extremely large in area, size, amount, etc.
vast.sentence: This vast desert looks impossible to pass.
vast.sentenceTrans: 这片辽阔的沙漠看上去不可能穿越。

vegetable.definitionEn: a plant or plant part that is eaten as food
vegetable.sentence: These are just a few of the fresh, ripe vegetables in my garden.
vegetable.sentenceTrans: 这只是我花园里一部分新鲜成熟的蔬菜。

vegetarian.definitionEn: a person who does not eat meat or fish
vegetarian.sentence: They became vegetarians because they couldn’t find anything else to eat.
vegetarian.sentenceTrans: 僵尸成了素食者，因为他们找不到别的东西吃了。
vegetarian.mnemonic: veget=vegetable蔬菜 + arian表形容词或名词，…的（人） → vegetarian素食的（人）

vehicle.definition: 车辆；交通工具；传播媒介；工具，手段
vehicle.definitionEn: a thing that is used for transporting people or goods from one place to another, such as a car or lorry/truck
vehicle.sentence: The vehicle drove off with a container.
vehicle.sentenceTrans: 那辆车载着一个集装箱开走了。
vehicle.mnemonic: veh带来 + icle=le表名词 → 开车把人带来 → vehicle车辆，机动车

venture.definition: 冒险；  n.（商业）冒险；投机，风险投资
venture.definitionEn: to go somewhere even though you know that it might be dangerous or unpleasant
venture.sentence: The boys venture deep into the forest.
venture.mnemonic: vent来 + ure表名词 → 来冒险一试 → venture冒险

verb.definitionEn: a word or group of words that expresses an action (such as eat), an event (such as happen) or a state (such as exist)
verb.sentence: "Dance" can be a verb because it's an action word.
verb.sentenceTrans: “跳舞”可以是一个动词，因为它是一个表示动作的词。

verbal.definitionEn: relating to words; spoken, not written; relating to verbs
verbal.sentence: Thanks to her great verbal skills, she delivered a brilliant presentation.
verbal.sentenceTrans: 多亏她良好的语言表达能力，她发表了精彩的演讲。
verbal.mnemonic: verb词语 + al形容词后缀 → verbal词语的

verge.definition: 边缘；边界；  v.濒临；接近
verge.sentence: The verge of the road is covered with lovely blue flowers.
verge.sentenceTrans: 路的边缘长满了可爱的蓝色花朵。

verify.definitionEn: to prove, show, find out, or state that (something) is true or correct
verify.sentence: This card can verify the man's identity.
verify.sentenceTrans: 这个证件可以证实此人的身份。
verify.mnemonic: veri真实 ＋ fy使... → 使真实 → verify核实

verse.definitionEn: writing that is arranged in lines, often with a regular rhythm or pattern of rhyme
verse.sentence: Li Bai’s poem is made up of four verses.

version.definitionEn: a form of something that is slightly different from an earlier form or from other forms of the same thing
version.sentence: This book has many different versions.
version.sentenceTrans: 这本书有很多不同的版本。
version.mnemonic: vers转 + ion表名词 → 把原文转换成另一版本 → version翻译，译文

versus.definitionEn: used to show that two teams or sides are against each other
versus.sentence: The superhero versus the female agent will be a good fight to watch.
versus.sentenceTrans: 这场战斗是超级英雄对阵女特工，值得一看。

vertical.definitionEn: (of a line, pole, etc.) going straight up or down from a level surface or from top to bottom in a picture, etc.
vertical.sentence: In the past, courts have been reluctant to block or unwind such deals, known as vertical acquisitions.
vertical.sentenceTrans: 在过去，法院通常不愿阻止或撤销这类被称为垂直并购的交易。
vertical.mnemonic: vert转变 + ical…的 → 转变成直的 → vertical垂直

very.definitionEn: used before adjectives, adverbs and determiners to mean ‘in a high degree’ or ‘extremely’

vessel.definitionEn: a large ship or boat; a container used for holding liquids, such as a bowl, cup, etc.; a tube that carries blood through the body of a person or an animal, or liquid through the parts of a plant
vessel.sentence: The vessel with loads of containers is moving on the ocean.
vessel.sentenceTrans: 满载集装箱的轮船正在海上航行。

veteran.definition: 老兵；经验丰富的人，老手；  adj.老练的
veteran.definitionEn: a person who has been a soldier, sailor, etc. in a war
veteran.sentence: This veteran has fought in many wars.
veteran.mnemonic: veter老 + an名词后缀，表示人 → veteran老兵

veto.definitionEn: to refuse to accept or do what somebody has suggested
veto.sentence: Her mom suggested that yellow dress to her, but she vetoed it.
veto.sentenceTrans: 她妈妈给她推荐了那条黄色连衣裙，但是被她否决了。

via.definitionEn: by means of a particular person, system, etc.; through a place
via.sentence: We left Guangzhou, taking the bus to Beijing via Wuhan.
via.sentenceTrans: 我们离开了广州，乘大巴经武汉去北京。

vibrate.definitionEn: shake, quiver, or throb; move back and forth rapidly, usually in an uncontrolled manner
vibrate.sentence: The smartphone vibrates when it rings.
vibrate.sentenceTrans: 这个智能手机响的时候还会振动。
vibrate.mnemonic: vibr动摇，颤抖 + ate表动词，使...成为 → vibrate（使）振动

vice.definitionEn: criminal activities that involve sex or drugs
vice.sentence: Both smoking and gambling are vices. You should quit them.
vice.sentenceTrans: 抽烟和赌博都是恶习，你们应该戒掉。

victim.definitionEn: a person who has been attacked, injured or killed as the result of a crime, a disease, an accident, etc.
victim.sentence: The family are victims of the flood, and they are now homeless.
victim.sentenceTrans: 这一家人是这次洪灾的受害者，现在他们无家可归了。

victorious.definitionEn: having won a victory; that ends in victory
victorious.sentence: He was victorious in the competition, taking first prize.
victorious.sentenceTrans: 他在比赛中获得了胜利，取得了第一名。
victorious.mnemonic: victor=victory胜利 + ious=ous形容词后缀 → victorious胜利的

victory.definitionEn: success in defeating an opponent or enemy
victory.sentence: The V-shaped gesture is the symbol of victory.
victory.mnemonic: vict征服，战胜 + ory表名词 → victory胜利

video.definitionEn: a short film or recording of an event, made using digital technology and viewed on a computer, especially over the Internet; a short film made by a pop or rock band to be shown with a song when it is played on television or online
video.sentence: Her job is to record the show on video.
video.sentenceTrans: 她的工作是制作演出的录像。
video.mnemonic: vid=see看 + eo后缀 → video视频，录像

view.definition: 风景，景色；观点，看法；  v.看待；观看，收看
view.definitionEn: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful countryside; used when you are talking about whether you can see something or whether something can be seen in a particular situation.
view.sentence: What an amazing view from the top of the hill!
view.sentenceTrans: 从山顶看到的风景太棒啦！

viewpoint.definitionEn: a way of thinking about a subject; a direction or place from which you look at something
viewpoint.sentence: The man is thinking about his viewpoints and is ready to write them down.
viewpoint.sentenceTrans: 这个男人正在思考他的观点并准备写下来。
viewpoint.mnemonic: view看 ＋ point点 → viewpoint观点，看法

vigor.sentence: She always approaches her work with great vigor, which makes her an asset to our team.
vigor.sentenceTrans: 她总是充满活力地投入工作，这使得她成为我们团队的宝贵财富。
vigor.mnemonic: vig生命 + or表名词 → vigor精力

vigorous.definitionEn: very active, determined or full of energy
vigorous.sentence: He is always vigorous and he never gets tired.
vigorous.sentenceTrans: 路飞总是精力充沛，似乎永远也不会累。
vigorous.mnemonic: vig生命 + orous...的 → vigorous精力旺盛的

vigour.sentence: My daily exercise gives me a lot of vigour and strength.
vigour.sentenceTrans: 每天运动使我充满活力和力量。
vigour.mnemonic: vig=life生命 + our=or名词词根 → vigour活力，元气

village.definitionEn: a very small town located in a country area
village.sentence: I lived in a remote mountain village.
village.sentenceTrans: 我住在一个遥远的小山村里。
village.mnemonic: vill=villa茅房，别墅 + age场所，物品 → village村庄

vinegar.definitionEn: a sour-tasting liquid made from malt or wine that is used to improve the taste of food
vinegar.sentence: Shanxi Province is famous for its vinegar.
vinegar.mnemonic: vin葡萄酒 + egar酸的 → vinegar醋

violate.definitionEn: to go against or refuse to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
violate.sentence: The bird's behavior violated the sign's rules.
violate.sentenceTrans: 鸟儿的行为违反了这个标牌上的规定。

violence.definitionEn: violent behaviour that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
violence.sentence: The youngsters shouldn't settle the problem by using violence.
violence.sentenceTrans: 年轻人不该用暴力解决问题。
violence.mnemonic: viol力量 + ence表名词  → 暴力，暴行

violent.definitionEn: involving or caused by physical force that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
violent.sentence: Some violent pictures in this cartoon will have a negative effect on the boy.
violent.sentenceTrans: 这部动画片中的一些暴力画面会对这个男孩产生负面影响。
violent.mnemonic: viol暴力 + ent形容词后缀 → violent暴力的，粗暴的

violin.definitionEn: a musical instrument with strings, that you hold under your chin and play with a bow
violin.sentence: She can play the violin well.

violinist.definition: 小提琴演奏者，小提琴家
violinist.definitionEn: a person who plays the violin
violinist.sentence: The young violinist impressed us with his great talent.
violinist.sentenceTrans: 这位年轻的小提琴家以其极高的天赋给我们留下了深刻的印象。
violinist.mnemonic: violin小提琴 + ist从事某种职业的人 → violinist小提琴手

virtual.definitionEn: made to appear to exist by the use of computer software, for example on the Internet
virtual.sentence: They are driving a virtual car.
virtual.sentenceTrans: 他们正在驾驶一辆虚拟汽车。

virtually.definitionEn: almost or very nearly, so that any slight difference is not important
virtually.sentence: The man was virtually on the point of striking gold.
virtually.sentenceTrans: 这个人几乎快要挖到黄金了。

virtue.definition: 美德，高尚的道德；好处，优点
virtue.definitionEn: a particular good quality or habit
virtue.sentence: Her kindness is a virtue she shows every day.
virtue.sentenceTrans: 她的美德体现在日常善举之中。

virus.definitionEn: a living thing, too small to be seen without a microscope, that causes infectious disease in people, animals and plants

visa.definitionEn: a stamp or mark put in your passport by officials of a foreign country that gives you permission to enter, pass through or leave their country
visa.sentence: I've got my visa ready, and now I can travel around the world!
visa.sentenceTrans: 我拿到了我的签证，现在我可以环游世界啦！
visa.mnemonic: vis看 + a → 审视，审查 → 审查后的签证 → visa签证，签准

visible.definition: 明显的，看得见的；看得见的
visible.sentence: The cake is visible in the right box.
visible.sentenceTrans: 右边盒子里的蛋糕是可见的。
visible.mnemonic: vis看 + ible形容词后缀，可…的 → visible看得见的，可见的

vision.definitionEn: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position
vision.sentence: The eye doctor said that my vision is excellent.
vision.sentenceTrans: 眼科医生说我的视力非常好。
vision.mnemonic: vis看 + ion表名词 → vision视力，眼界

visit.definition: 参观，访问；  n.访问参观，游览
visit.definitionEn: to go to see a person or a place for a period of time
visit.sentence: We visited the history museum today.
visit.sentenceTrans: 今天我们去参观了历史博物馆。

visitor.definition: 访问者，来宾；访问者，参观者
visitor.definitionEn: a person who visits a person or place
visitor.sentence: I think we have a visitor at the door.
visitor.mnemonic: visit参观 + or表示人 → visitor参观者，观光者

visual.definitionEn: of or connected with seeing or sight
visual.sentence: The debate over the dress color is actually a visual trick.
visual.sentenceTrans: 关于裙子颜色的争论实际上是一个视觉游戏。
visual.mnemonic: vis看 + ual表形容词 → visual视觉的

visualise.definitionEn: view the outline of by means of an X-ray
visualise.sentence: Imagine the future you want and visualise it every day.
visualise.sentenceTrans: 想象你想要的未来，并每天去想象它。

visualize.definitionEn: to make something visible to the eye
visualize.sentence: We can visualize a solution to the problem.
visualize.sentenceTrans: 我们可以设想出一个解决问题的方案。
visualize.mnemonic: visual看得见的 + ize动词后缀：使 → visualize使形象化

vital.definition: 必不可少的，至关重要的；有活力的；生死攸关的
vital.definitionEn: necessary or essential in order for something to succeed or exist
vital.sentence: Water is vital to living beings.
vital.sentenceTrans: 水对生物来说是必不可少的。
vital.mnemonic: vit生命 + al形容词后缀 → vital有活力的；重要的

vitamin.definitionEn: a natural substance found in food that is an essential part of what humans and animals eat to help them grow and stay healthy. There are many different vitamins.
vitamin.sentence: Fruits such as oranges and grapes are rich in vitamin C.
vitamin.sentenceTrans: 橙子、葡萄这类水果富含维生素C。
vitamin.mnemonic: vita生命 + min小要素 → 生命要素 → vitamin维生素

vivid.definition: 生动的，清晰的（记忆、描述）；（颜色）鲜艳的，强烈的（颜色、光）
vivid.definitionEn: (of memories, a description, etc.) producing very clear pictures in your mind
vivid.sentence: This painting is a vivid representation of a horse.
vivid.sentenceTrans: 这幅画是对马的生动再现。
vivid.mnemonic: viv生命 + id…形容词后缀，具有…性质的 → 有生命的 → vivid活泼的；生动的

vocabulary.definitionEn: all the words in a particular language; all of the words known and used by a person
vocabulary.sentence: This software will help increase your English vocabulary!
vocabulary.sentenceTrans: 这个软件会帮你增加你的英语词汇量。
vocabulary.mnemonic: vocabul=vocable词 + ary表名词 → vocabulary词汇

vocation.definitionEn: a type of work or way of life that you believe is especially suitable for you
vocation.sentence: These vocations play different roles in our society.
vocation.sentenceTrans: 这些职业在我们的社会中扮演着不同的角色。
vocation.mnemonic: voc呼喊，声，召集 + ation表名词 → [受到]召唤 → vocation使命，职业

vocational.definitionEn: connected with the skills, knowledge, etc. that you need to have in order to do a particular job
vocational.sentence: I learned how to drive this in vocational school.
vocational.sentenceTrans: 我是在职业学校学会如何驾驶这个的。
vocational.mnemonic: vocation职业 + al…的 → 叫喊的 → 职业的，行业的

voice.definitionEn: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing
voice.sentence: She has such a wonderful voice - no wonder so many people buy her music!
voice.sentenceTrans: 她有如此美妙的嗓音，难怪这么多人买她的歌。

volleyball.definitionEn: a game in which two teams of six players use their hands to hit a large ball backwards and forwards over a high net while trying not to let the ball touch the ground on their own side
volleyball.sentence: The women's volleyball player hit the ball over the net vigorously.
volleyball.sentenceTrans: 这位女子排球运动员用力地把球击过网。

volt.definitionEn: a unit for measuring the force of an electric current
volt.sentence: The cable has 220 volts of electricity.

voltage.sentence: “Be careful, this machine has a high voltage.”
voltage.mnemonic: volt电压 + age表示集合名词、总称 → voltage电压

volume.definitionEn: the amount of sound that is produced by a television, radio, etc.
volume.sentence: I turned the volume up to listen to the radio.
volume.sentenceTrans: 我把收音机音量调大来听广播。
volume.mnemonic: vol旋转，卷 + ume表物 → 卷起来的东西 → volume卷，册

voluntary.definitionEn: done willingly, not because you are forced
voluntary.sentence: Giving blood is 100% voluntary: Nobody will force you to do it.
voluntary.sentenceTrans: 献血是百分之百自愿的，没人会强迫你去做。
voluntary.mnemonic: volunt自愿，意愿 + ary形容词后缀 → voluntary志愿的，自愿的

volunteer.definitionEn: to offer to do something without being forced to do it or without getting paid for it
volunteer.sentence: Volunteers are cleaning up the public environment.
volunteer.sentenceTrans: 志愿者们正在清理公共环境。
volunteer.mnemonic: volunt自愿，意愿 + eer表示人 → volunteer志愿者

vote.definitionEn: to show formally by marking a paper or raising your hand which person you want to win an election, or which plan or idea you support; to choose somebody/something for a position or an award by voting; to say that something is good or bad; to agree to give somebody/yourself something by voting
vote.sentence: Voting is a fair way for selection.
vote.sentenceTrans: 投票是一种公平的选举方式。
vote.mnemonic: vot发誓 + e → 投票前需要发誓以示诚实 → vote投票

voyage.definition: 航海，航行；  v.航海；航行
voyage.definitionEn: a long journey, especially by sea or in space
voyage.sentence: The ship Titanic sank on its first voyage.
voyage.sentenceTrans: “泰坦尼克号”在首航中便沉没了。
voyage.mnemonic: voy道路 + age表状态 → 一直在路上 → voyage航海，航行

vulnerable.definitionEn: weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
vulnerable.sentence: The vulnerable baby required unwavering attention and care.
vulnerable.sentenceTrans: 脆弱的婴儿需要得到无微不至的关注和照顾。
vulnerable.mnemonic: vulner创伤 + able表形容词 → 容易被创伤的 → vulnerable脆弱的

wage.definition: 工资，薪水；  v.开展，进行（战争、运动）
wage.definitionEn: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week, for work or services
wage.sentence: The worker was so happy when she got her wages.
wage.sentenceTrans: 这个工人拿到工资的时候很开心。

waist.definitionEn: the area around the middle of the body between the ribs and the hips, often narrower than the areas above and below
waist.sentence: The man put the measuring tape around his waist.
waist.sentenceTrans: 这个人在腰上围了一条软尺。

wait.definitionEn: to stay where you are or delay doing something until somebody/something comes or something happens
wait.sentence: She is waiting for her flight.

waiter.definition: 侍者，服务员；（餐馆的）男服务员
waiter.definitionEn: a person whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant, etc.
waiter.sentence: The young man is a waiter in a restaurant.
waiter.sentenceTrans: 这个年轻的小伙子是一家餐馆的服务员。
waiter.mnemonic: wait等待 + er名词后缀 → 等待着的人 → waiter侍者

waitress.definitionEn: a woman whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant, etc.
waitress.sentence: Can you ask the waitress to bring the bill?
waitress.sentenceTrans: 你能让女服务员把账单拿来吗？
waitress.mnemonic: wait等待 + ress女性 → waitress女服务员

wake.definitionEn: to stop sleeping; to make somebody stop sleeping
wake.sentence: The alarm woke up the man.

waken.definitionEn: to wake, or make somebody wake, from sleep
waken.sentence: The alarm clock wakens me at 6 o'clock every day.
waken.sentenceTrans: 闹钟每天都在六点的时候把我叫醒。
waken.mnemonic: wake唤醒 + en表动词 → waken弄醒

walk.definitionEn: to spend time walking for pleasure
walk.sentence: Many people are walking on the road.

walkman.definitionEn: A Walkman is a small cassette player with light headphones which people carry around so that they can listen to music, for example while they are travelling
walkman.sentence: This Walkman uses a cassette tape to play music.
walkman.sentenceTrans: 这款随声听需要一盘磁带才能播放音乐。

wall.definitionEn: a long vertical solid structure, made of stone, brick or concrete, that surrounds, divides or protects an area of land
wall.sentence: This wall is made up of oddly shaped bricks.
wall.sentenceTrans: 这道墙由形状不规则的砖砌成。

wallet.definitionEn: a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic used for keeping paper money and credit cards in; a flat leather, plastic or cardboard case for carrying documents in
wallet.sentence: I left my wallet at the store.
wallet.sentenceTrans: 我把钱包忘在商店里了。

wander.definitionEn: to move around or go to different places usually without having a particular purpose or direction
wander.sentence: The couple are casually wandering amidst the maple trees.
wander.sentenceTrans: 这对恋人正在枫叶林里悠闲地漫步。

want.definitionEn: to have a desire or a wish for something
want.sentence: The young couple really want a baby.
want.sentenceTrans: 这对年轻夫妇很想要个孩子。

war.definition: 战争；  v.打仗，作战，对抗
war.definitionEn: a situation in which two or more countries or groups of people fight against each other over a period of time
war.sentence: Follow me into battle and we shall win this war!
war.sentenceTrans: 跟着我加入战斗，我们一定会赢得这场战争！

warm.definitionEn: at a fairly high temperature in a way that is pleasant, rather than being hot or cold
warm.sentence: The weather cooled off, so we made a fire to keep warm.
warm.sentenceTrans: 天气变凉了，所以我们生火取暖。

warn.definitionEn: to tell somebody about something, especially something dangerous or unpleasant that is likely to happen, so that they can avoid it; to strongly advise somebody to do or not to do something in order to avoid danger or punishment
warn.sentence: The sign warned the bone about the danger of being eaten.
warn.sentenceTrans: 这个标牌警告骨头有被吃掉的危险。

warning.definitionEn: a statement, an event, etc. telling somebody that something bad or unpleasant may happen in the future so that they can try to avoid it
warning.sentence: After the tree fell onto the road, they put a warning sign in front of it.
warning.sentenceTrans: 树倒在路上之后，他们在树前面放了一块警告牌。
warning.mnemonic: warn警告 + ing表示……的 → warning警告的

wash.definitionEn: to make something/somebody clean using water and usually soap
wash.sentence: My grandpa is washing the clothes.

waste.definition: 废物，垃圾；浪费；  v.浪费；  adj.废弃的
waste.definitionEn: materials that are no longer needed and are thrown away
waste.sentence: A lot of waste has been dumped in the field.
waste.sentenceTrans: 许多废物被倒在这片地上。

watch.definition: 观看，注视；注意；留神观察；小心，当心，留意；  n.手表；监视
watch.definitionEn: a device that shows what time it is and that you wear on your wrist or carry in a pocket
watch.sentence: There were two little dogs watching the television.
watch.sentenceTrans: 两只小斑点狗在看电视。

water.definitionEn: a liquid without colour, smell or taste that falls as rain, is in lakes, rivers and seas, and is used for drinking, washing, etc.
water.sentence: Would you like a glass of ice water?

waterproof.definitionEn: that does not let water through or that cannot be damaged by water
waterproof.sentence: Luckily, this kind of shoes is waterproof.
waterproof.sentenceTrans: 幸运的是，这种鞋子是防水的。
waterproof.mnemonic: water水 + proof防……的 → waterproof防水的

wave.definition: 海浪，波浪；挥手；  v.挥手，招手；上下起伏，左右摇晃
wave.definitionEn: an area of moving water that is raised above the main surface of an ocean, a lake, etc.
wave.sentence: The waves are washing off the drawing on the beach.
wave.sentenceTrans: 海浪就快把海滩上的画冲掉了。

way.definitionEn: a road, path or street for travelling along
way.sentence: There's a way across the field.
way.sentenceTrans: 这儿有一条路穿过田地。

we.definitionEn: I and another person or other people; I and you

weak.definitionEn: having little physical power or ability :not strong
weak.sentence: He's so weak that he can't even lift this tiny weight.
weak.sentenceTrans: 他真的是太虚弱了，竟然连这么轻的重量都举不起来。

weaken.definitionEn: to make something less physically strong; to become less physically strong; to make somebody/something less strong or powerful; to become less strong or powerful
weaken.sentence: His eating disorder and insufficient food intake obviously weakened him.
weaken.sentenceTrans: 饮食失调和摄入不足明显使他变得虚弱了。
weaken.mnemonic: weak虚弱的 + en表动词 → weaken削弱，变弱

weakness.definitionEn: difficulty in resisting something/somebody that you like very much
weakness.sentence: Vampires' weakness is that they are afraid of sunshine.
weakness.sentenceTrans: 吸血鬼的弱点是害怕阳光。
weakness.mnemonic: weak虚弱的 + ness表名词 → weakness懦弱，虚弱

wealth.definitionEn: a large amount of money, property, etc. that a person or country owns
wealth.sentence: He is a man of great wealth.
wealth.sentenceTrans: 他是一个拥有大量财富的人。
wealth.mnemonic: weal幸福 + th抽象名词后缀 → wealth财富

wealthy.definitionEn: having a lot of money, possessions, etc.
wealthy.sentence: I'm so wealthy that I bathe in money.
wealthy.sentenceTrans: 我太有钱了，我在钱里沐浴。
wealthy.mnemonic: wealth财富 + y……的 → 富裕的

weapon.definitionEn: an object such as a knife, gun, bomb, etc. that is used for fighting or attacking somebody
weapon.sentence: There are a number of different kinds of weapons on the floor.
weapon.sentenceTrans: 地板上有很多种不同种类的武器。

wear.definition: 穿，戴；  n.磨损；穿戴物，衣物
wear.definitionEn: to have something on your body as a piece of clothing, a decoration, etc.
wear.sentence: She loves to wear white coats.

weary.definition: 疲倦的，困乏的，令人厌倦的；  v.使厌倦；  v.疲倦，厌烦
weary.definitionEn: very tired, especially after you have been working hard or doing something for a long time; making you feel tired or bored; no longer interested in or enthusiastic about something
weary.sentence: He had a weary look on his face.
weary.sentenceTrans: 他脸上带着疲倦的神情。

weather.definitionEn: the state of the air and atmosphere at a particular time and place :the temperature and other outside conditions (such as rain, cloudiness, etc.) at a particular time and place
weather.sentence: The weather was different when we went back to that place.
weather.sentenceTrans: 我们再回到那个地方的时候，天气不一样了。
weather.mnemonic: we吹 + ther后缀 → 吹风等天气 → weather天气

weave.definitionEn: to make cloth, a carpet, a basket, etc. by crossing threads or strips across, over and under each other by hand or on a machine called a loom
weave.sentence: The elder is weaving a basket.

web.definitionEn: a fine net of threads made by a spider to catch insects
web.sentence: I am in a complex web of relationships.
web.sentenceTrans: 我处在一个复杂的关系网中。

website.definitionEn: a place connected to the Internet, where a company or an organization, or an individual person, puts information
website.sentence: The company website is up and running.
website.sentenceTrans: 公司网站上线并开始运行。

wedding.definitionEn: a marriage ceremony, and the meal or party that usually follows it
wedding.sentence: The couple held their wedding ceremony on the grass.
wedding.sentenceTrans: 这对夫妻在草地上举行了他们的婚礼。
wedding.mnemonic: wed嫁，娶 + ding名词后缀 → wedding婚礼，婚宴，结婚典礼

wednesday.definitionEn: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday
wednesday.sentence: I have an appointment on Wednesday.

week.definitionEn: a period of seven days, either from Monday to Sunday or from Sunday to Saturday
week.sentence: They are talking about the week's plan.
week.sentenceTrans: 他们在谈论这周的计划。

weekday.definitionEn: any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday
weekday.sentence: He works on weekdays, from Monday to Friday.
weekday.sentenceTrans: 他在工作日上班，从星期一上到星期五。
weekday.mnemonic: week一周 + day日子 → 一周里除了周末 → 工作日

weekly.definition: 一周一次地；  adj.每周的，一周一次的；  n.周报，周刊
weekly.sentence: This TV show is updated weekly.
weekly.sentenceTrans: 这个电视节目每周更新一次。
weekly.mnemonic: week周 + ly表副词，每……地 → 每周的

weep.definition: 哭泣，流泪；流出，渗出；  n.哭泣
weep.definitionEn: to cry, usually because you are sad
weep.sentence: I could feel his sadness when I saw him weeping.
weep.sentenceTrans: 当我看到他在哭泣时，我能感受到他的悲伤。

weigh.definitionEn: to measure how heavy somebody/something is, usually by using scales
weigh.sentence: Please weigh the apples and pears for me.
weigh.sentenceTrans: 请替我称一下苹果和梨的重量。

weight.definition: 重量，分量；砝码；重物；  v.使负重
weight.definitionEn: how heavy somebody/something is, which can be measured in, for example, kilograms or pounds; the fact of being heavy
weight.sentence: The weight of the apples you chose is 2 kilos.
weight.sentenceTrans: 你所选的苹果的重量是2千克。
weight.mnemonic: weigh称量 + t名词后缀 → weight重量

welcome.definition: 欢迎；  adj.受欢迎的；  n.欢迎
welcome.definitionEn: to say hello to somebody in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere
welcome.sentence: He stood at the door to welcome the student.
welcome.sentenceTrans: 他站在门口欢迎这位学生。

welfare.definitionEn: practical or financial help that is provided, often by the government, for people or animals that need it
welfare.sentence: The organization aims to improve the welfare of animals.
welfare.sentenceTrans: 这个组织旨在提升动物的福利。

well.definition: 令人满意地；  adj.健康的；  n.水井；  int.好吧
well.definitionEn: in a good state or position; in good health
well.sentence: She can play the piano very well.

well-being.definitionEn: the state of being happy, healthy, or successful
well-being.sentence: Meditation and yoga are good for your well-being.
well-being.sentenceTrans: 冥想和瑜伽有助于保持健康。

well-known.definition: 众所周知的；有名的，著名的
well-known.definitionEn: known about by a lot of people; (of a fact) generally known and accepted
well-known.sentence: It is a well-known fact that smoking is bad for our health.
well-known.sentenceTrans: 众所周知，吸烟有害人体健康。

west.definition: 西，西方，西部；  adj.西的，西方的；  adv.向西方
west.definitionEn: the direction where the sun sets :the direction that is the opposite of east
west.sentence: On the compass, "W" stands for west.

western.definition: 西方的；西部的；  n.西方人
western.definitionEn: located in the west or facing west; connected with the west part of the world, especially Europe and N America
western.sentence: These dresses are typical western wedding dresses.
western.sentenceTrans: 这些裙子是典型的西式婚纱。
western.mnemonic: west西方 + ern……方向的 → western西方的

wet.definitionEn: covered or soaked with water or another liquid；not dry
wet.sentence: He got wet because of the rain.

what.definitionEn: used in questions to ask for particular information about somebody/something

whatever.definitionEn: any or every; anything or everything
whatever.sentence: The man shrugs his shoulders and says: "whatever."
whatever.sentenceTrans: 他耸了耸肩说道：“无所谓。”
whatever.mnemonic: what什么 + ever究竟 → whatever无论什么

wheat.definitionEn: a plant grown for its grain that is used to produce the flour for bread, cakes, pasta, etc.; the grain of this plant
wheat.sentence: The golden wheat rippled in the breeze.
wheat.sentenceTrans: 金黄色的小麦在微风中荡漾。

wheel.definitionEn: one of the round objects under a car, bicycle, bus, etc. that turns when it moves
wheel.sentence: The wheels of these bicycles are the same size.
wheel.sentenceTrans: 这些自行车的轮子大小相同。

when.definitionEn: (used in questions) at what time; on what occasion
when.sentence: When will you leave tomorrow? In the morning or in the evening?
when.sentenceTrans: 你明天什么时候走？早上还是晚上？

whenever.definition: 无论何时；每当；  adv.不论何时
whenever.definitionEn: at any time that; on any occasion that
whenever.sentence: You can call customer service whenever you want.
whenever.sentenceTrans: 无论何时，你都可以呼叫客服。
whenever.mnemonic: when何时 + ever究竟 → whenever无论何时，随时

where.definition: 什么地方，哪里，在哪里，……的（地方）
where.definitionEn: in or to what place or situation; used after words or phrases that refer to a place or situation to mean ‘at, in or to which’; the place or situation in which
where.sentence: Do you know where we are?
where.sentenceTrans: 你知道我们现在在哪儿么？

whereas.definition: 然而，但是，尽管；【法】鉴于，就……而论
whereas.definitionEn: used to compare or contrast two facts
whereas.sentence: The line chart shows one thing, whereas the bar chart shows the other.
whereas.sentenceTrans: 折线图显示的是一回事，而柱状图显示的则是另一回事。
whereas.mnemonic: where在哪 + as如此 → whereas然而，但是，尽管

wherever.definition: 无论在哪里；在任何地方；  adv.无论在哪里
wherever.definitionEn: in any place; in all places that; in all cases that
wherever.sentence: Wherever you want your package to go, we can deliver it.
wherever.sentenceTrans: 无论你想让你的包裹去哪儿，我们都能送达。

whether.definitionEn: used to show that something is true in either of two cases
whether.sentence: The mother still doesn't know whether it's a boy or a girl.
whether.sentenceTrans: 这位母亲还不知道宝宝是男是女。
whether.mnemonic: whe=who谁 + ther比较级后缀 → 是两人中的谁 → whether是否

which.definitionEn: used in questions to ask somebody to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number; used to be exact about the thing or things that you mean; used to give more information about something
which.sentence: The teacher asked the girl which pen was hers.
which.sentenceTrans: 老师问女孩哪一支笔是她的。

whichever.definition: 无论哪个；  pron.无论哪些
whichever.definitionEn: used to say what feature or quality is important in deciding something
whichever.sentence: I will have whichever drink is the most delicious.
whichever.sentenceTrans: 无论哪种饮料，我都要喝最好喝的。
whichever.mnemonic: which哪个 + ever究竟 → whichever无论哪一个，任何一个

while.definition: 当……的时候，在...期间；然而；  n.一会儿，一段时间；一段时间
while.definitionEn: at the same time as something else is happening
while.sentenceTrans: 他睡觉的时候会打呼噜。

whip.definition: 鞭打，抽打；猛地移动，急走，急冲；  n.抽打
whip.definitionEn: to hit a person or an animal hard with a whip, as a punishment or to make them go faster or work harder
whip.sentence: The guy whips his horses to make them run faster.
whip.sentenceTrans: 那人鞭打他的马儿让它们跑得更快。

whisky.definitionEn: a strong alcoholic drink made from malted grain. It is sometimes drunk with water and/or ice.
whisky.sentence: I prefer whisky over any other hard drink.
whisky.sentenceTrans: 烈酒里面我最喜欢威士忌。

whisper.definition: 小声说，耳语，低语；低声低语地讲，悄悄地说；  n.私语；沙沙声，飒飒声
whisper.definitionEn: to speak very quietly to somebody so that other people cannot hear what you are saying
whisper.sentence: The little boy is whispering something to his grandfather.
whisper.sentenceTrans: 这个小男孩正和他的爷爷说悄悄话。
whisper.mnemonic: whisp轻语 + er表拟声动作 → whisper低语，作沙沙声

whistle.definition: 口哨（声），哨子（声）；汽笛声，警笛声；  v.吹口哨
whistle.definitionEn: a small metal or plastic tube that you blow to make a loud high sound, used to attract attention or as a signal; the sound made by blowing a whistle; the sound that you make by forcing your breath out when your lips are closed

white.definitionEn: having the color of fresh snow or milk
white.sentence: There is a white piece of paper on the table.

who.definitionEn: used in questions to ask about the name, identity or function of one or more people; used to show which person or people you mean; used to give more information about somebody
who.sentence: No one knows who he is.

whoever.definition: 无论是谁，不管谁，任何人
whoever.sentence: Whoever comes to the party has to show their invitation card.
whoever.sentenceTrans: 无论谁来参加这场聚会，都必须出示邀请函。
whoever.mnemonic: who谁 + ever究竟 → whoever无论谁，任何人

whole.definition: 整个的；完整的，完好无损的；全部的，所有的；  n.全部；整体
whole.sentence: The boy ate the whole watermelon by himself.
whole.sentenceTrans: 男孩自己吃了一整个西瓜。

whom.definitionEn: used instead of ‘who’ as the object of a verb or preposition
whom.sentence: Do you know whom the reporters are discussing?
whom.sentenceTrans: 你知道记者们在讨论谁吗？

whose.definitionEn: used in questions to ask who something belongs to
whose.sentence: Whose phone and umbrella are those?
whose.sentenceTrans: 这是谁的手机和雨伞啊？

why.definitionEn: used in questions to ask the reason for or purpose of something
why.sentence: He shrugged and spread his hands as if to ask, "Why?"
why.sentenceTrans: 他耸耸肩、摊开手，仿佛在问：“为什么？”

wicked.definition: 邪恶的，恶毒的；淘气的，恶作剧的；缺德的
wicked.sentence: The wicked witch possesses powerful magic.
wicked.sentenceTrans: 这位邪恶的女巫有着强大法力。

wide.definition: 宽的，宽阔的；广泛的；  adv.尽可能远地
wide.sentence: The sofa is wide enough for many people.
wide.sentenceTrans: 这张沙发很宽，足够坐很多人。

widely.definitionEn: by a lot of people; in or to many places
widely.sentence: The color red is widely used during the Spring Festival celebrations.
widely.sentenceTrans: 欢度春节时，处处可见红色。

widen.definitionEn: to become wider; to make something wider
widen.sentence: This road was too narrow, so now we have to widen it.
widen.sentenceTrans: 这条路太窄了，所以现在我们要把它加宽。
widen.mnemonic: wid宽的 + en表动词 → widen 加宽，变宽

widespread.definition: 分布广的；普遍的，广泛的
widespread.definitionEn: existing or happening over a large area or among many people
widespread.sentence: My love story quickly became widespread through the Internet.
widespread.sentenceTrans: 通过网络，我的爱情故事很快就传开了。
widespread.mnemonic: wide广泛的 + spread展开 → widespread分布广的，普遍的

widow.definitionEn: a woman whose husband has died and who has not married again
widow.sentence: The poor woman became a widow after her husband's death.
widow.sentenceTrans: 那个可怜的女人在她丈夫死后就成了寡妇。

width.definitionEn: the measurement from one side of something to the other; how wide something is; the distance between the two long sides of a swimming pool
width.sentence: They are expanding the width of the road.
width.sentenceTrans: 他们正在扩大道路的宽度。
width.mnemonic: wid=wide宽的 + th抽象名词 → width宽度

wife.definitionEn: a married woman; the woman someone is married to
wife.sentence: The man looked at the wedding photo and missed his wife.
wife.sentenceTrans: 男人看着结婚照片，思念他的妻子。

wild.definition: 自然生长的，野生的；野性的；狂热的；荒芜的；疯狂的
wild.definitionEn: living or growing in natural conditions; not kept in a house or on a farm
wild.sentence: The wild kid is making a big mess in the dining room.
wild.sentenceTrans: 这个熊孩子把餐厅搞得一团糟。

wildlife.definition: 野生生物；  adj.野生动植物的
wildlife.definitionEn: animals, birds, insects, etc. that are wild and live in a natural environment
wildlife.sentence: Wildlife reserves are created to keep animals safe.
wildlife.sentenceTrans: 建立野生动物保护区是为了让动物安全。
wildlife.mnemonic: wild野生的 + life生命 → wildlife野生动植物

will.definitionEn: used for talking about or predicting the future

willing.definitionEn: ready or pleased to help and not needing to be persuaded; done or given in an enthusiastic way
willing.sentence: The man is willing to be at his boss's service.
willing.sentenceTrans: 这个人愿意听从老板的吩咐。
willing.mnemonic: will愿意 + ing名词后缀 → willing愿意的

willingness.definitionEn: the quality of being happy and ready to do something
willingness.sentence: The boy shows his willingness to answer the question by raising his hand.
willingness.sentenceTrans: 这个男孩举手表示愿意回答这个问题。
willingness.mnemonic: will心愿 + ing名词后缀 + ness表名词，行为或状态 → willingness心甘情愿

win.definitionEn: to be the most successful in a competition, race, battle, etc.; to get something as the result of a competition, race, election, etc.; to achieve or get something that you want, especially by your own efforts
win.sentence: She won the position by her amazing interview performance.
win.sentenceTrans: 她靠出色的面试表现赢得了这个岗位。

wind.definition: 风；  v.（道路、河流等）蜿蜒曲折；缠绕
wind.definitionEn: a natural movement of air outside; breath as needed in physical exertion or in speech
wind.sentence: The wind is blowing the leaves.

window.definitionEn: an opening in the wall or roof of a building, car, etc., usually covered with glass, that allows light and air to come in and people to see out; the glass in a window
window.sentence: She withdraws money from the cash department window in the bank.
window.sentenceTrans: 她从银行的现金业务窗口取到了钱。

wine.definition: 葡萄酒；果酒；  v.喝酒；  v.请...喝酒
wine.definitionEn: an alcoholic drink made from the juice of grapes that has been left to ferment
wine.sentence: Red wine is made from high quality grapes.
wine.sentenceTrans: 红葡萄酒是用优质葡萄酿制的。

wing.definitionEn: one of the parts of the body of a bird, insect or bat that it uses for flying
wing.sentence: Mommy, I want the doll with the butterfly wings.
wing.sentenceTrans: 妈妈，我想要那个带蝴蝶翅膀的洋娃娃。

winner.definitionEn: a person, a team, an animal, etc. that wins something;  a thing or person that is successful or likely to be successful; a goal or point that causes a team or a person to win a game

winter.definitionEn: the coldest season of the year that is after autumn and before spring
winter.sentence: It always snows heavily here in winter.
winter.mnemonic: wint水，潮湿 + er名词后缀，人或事物 → 有很多冰和水的季节 → winter冬季

wipe.definitionEn: to remove dirt, liquid, etc. from something by using a cloth, your hand, etc.
wipe.sentence: The bride wipes away the tears from the groom's face.
wipe.sentenceTrans: 新娘拭去了新郎脸上的泪水。

wire.definition: 电线，电缆，导线，金属丝，金属线；  v.接通电源；将……连接到
wire.definitionEn: a thread of metal that is covered with plastic, rubber, etc., and used to send or receive electricity or electrical signals
wire.sentence: It's a bird sitting on a wire.

wisdom.definitionEn: the ability to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have; the knowledge that a society or culture has gained over a long period of time
wisdom.sentence: The old man's wisdom comes from books.
wisdom.sentenceTrans: 这位老人的智慧来自于博览群书。
wisdom.mnemonic: wis=wise智慧的 + dom状态或领域 → wisdom智慧

wise.definition: 有智慧的，博学的；明智的
wise.definitionEn: having or showing wisdom or knowledge usually from learning or experiencing many things
wise.sentence: My college professor is quite wise about many things.

wish.definition: 愿望，心愿；  v.祝愿；希望，想要
wish.definitionEn: a desire or a feeling that you want to do something or have something
wish.sentence: The little boy made a wish in front of the dragon.
wish.sentenceTrans: 小悟空在神龙面前许下了愿望。

wit.definition: 智力，才智；机智；风趣，措辞巧妙的能力
wit.definitionEn: your ability to think quickly and clearly and to make good decisions; an ability to say or write things that are clever and usually funny
wit.sentence: The wit of that little boy fascinates us.
wit.sentenceTrans: 那个小男孩的机智让我们感到惊叹。

with.definition: 有，以，用，同……一起，由于，和……一致，赞成，关于，就
with.definitionEn: in the company or presence of somebody/something; having or carrying something; using something; including

withdraw.definitionEn: to take money out of a bank account
withdraw.sentence: I'd like to withdraw 500 dollars from the machine.
withdraw.sentenceTrans: 我想从这台机器里取500美元。
withdraw.mnemonic: with向后，相反 + draw拉 → 向相反拉 → withdraw撤消，撤退

withdrawal.definitionEn: the act of taking money out of a bank account
withdrawal.sentence: I made a withdrawal from my bank account.
withdrawal.sentenceTrans: 我从我的银行账户里取了一笔钱。
withdrawal.mnemonic: with向后，相反 + draw拉 + al表名词后缀 → withdrawal撤退

within.definitionEn: before a particular period of time has passed; during a particular period of time
within.sentence: There is light coming from within.
within.mnemonic: with和，与 + in里面 → within在内部

without.definition: 没有，不；  adv.在没有（某种不言而喻的东西）的情况下，在缺乏的情况下
without.sentence: I feel so lonely without you.
without.mnemonic: with和，与 + out离开，不在  → without没有

withstand.definitionEn: to be strong enough not to be hurt or damaged by extreme conditions, the use of force, etc.
withstand.sentence: The shield is solid enough to withstand the enemy's attack.
withstand.sentenceTrans: 大锤的护盾太结实了，挡住敌人的进攻不在话下。
withstand.mnemonic: with向后，相反 + stand站 → 向相反的方向站 → withstand抵抗，反抗

witness.definition: 目击者；  v.目击，亲眼看见
witness.definitionEn: a person who sees something happen and is able to describe it to other people
witness.sentence: The little girl is the only witness of the accident.
witness.sentenceTrans: 小女孩是这场事故的唯一目击者。
witness.mnemonic: wit智慧 + ness表名词 → 目击者

wolf.definition: 狼（复数wolves）；残忍凶狠的人；  v.狼吞虎咽地吃
wolf.definitionEn: a large wild animal that is similar to a dog and that often hunts in groups
wolf.sentence: Even though a wolf looks a bit like a dog, it is actually much more dangerous.
wolf.sentenceTrans: 尽管狼看起来有点儿像狗，但其实它们要危险得多。

woman.sentence: My grandmother is such an elegant woman!
woman.sentenceTrans: 我的奶奶是一个多么优雅的女人啊！

wonder.definition: 想知道，想弄明白；  n.惊奇，惊异；奇迹，奇观
wonder.definitionEn: to think about something and try to decide what is true, what will happen, what you should do, etc.
wonder.sentence: He was wondering what was in the box.
wonder.sentenceTrans: 他想知道箱子里是什么。

wonderful.sentence: Many people have wonderful things to say about this English learning app.
wonderful.sentenceTrans: 人们对这款英语学习应用有极好的评价。
wonderful.mnemonic: wonder奇迹，神奇 + ful形容词后缀 → wonderful极好的

wood.definitionEn: the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of; this material when it is used to build or make things with, or as a fuel; an area of trees, smaller than a forest
wood.sentence: Wood can be used to build houses.
wood.sentenceTrans: 木材可以用来建造房屋。

wooden.definition: 木制的，木质的；呆笨的，死板的
wooden.sentence: All of the kitchenware in this set is wooden.
wooden.sentenceTrans: 这套厨具全都是木制的。
wooden.mnemonic: wood木头 + en由……制成的 → 木制的

wool.definitionEn: the soft fine hair that covers the body of sheep, goats and some other animals; long thick thread made from animal’s wool, used for knitting; cloth made from animal’s wool, used for making clothes, etc.
wool.sentence: This sweater is made of high-quality wool.
wool.sentenceTrans: 这件毛衣是由高品质羊毛制成的。

woolen.definition: 羊毛的；毛纺的；  n.毛织品
woolen.sentence: He wanted to make a woolen scarf.
woolen.mnemonic: wool羊毛 + en由……制成的 → woolen羊毛制的

woollen.definition: 毛纺的；羊毛（制）的；  n.毛织品
woollen.sentence: Since the 1960s, several new techniques have been researched and applied in woollen production.
woollen.sentenceTrans: 20世纪60年代以来，毛纺生产中已经研究和应用了一些新技术。
woollen.mnemonic: wooll羊毛 + en表示由…制成的，含有…质的，似…的 → woollen羊毛制的

word.definitionEn: a single unit of language which means something and can be spoken or written
word.sentence: The word on the paper was written in black ink.
word.sentenceTrans: 纸上的词是用黑墨水写的。

work.definition: 工作；作品，著作；  v.工作，劳动，干活；运转，运行；起作用，有效果，奏效
work.definitionEn: to do things as part of your job
work.sentence: They are doing their work on the farm.

worker.definitionEn: (often in compounds) a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work; a person who is employed in a company or industry, especially somebody who does physical work rather than organizing things or managing people
worker.sentence: The worker was ready to work.

workforce.definitionEn: all the people who work for a particular company, organization, etc.; all the people in a country or an area who are available for work
workforce.sentence: The city's workforce accounts for about 60 percent of the population.
workforce.sentenceTrans: 这座城市的劳动力约占总人口的 60%。

workplace.definitionEn: the office, factory, etc. where people work
workplace.sentence: I spend five days a week at my workplace.
workplace.sentenceTrans: 一周我花五天在工作场所。

workshop.definition: 车间，工场，工作室；研讨会，工作坊
workshop.definitionEn: a room or building in which things are made or repaired using tools or machinery; a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience
workshop.sentence: I left my car at the workshop for repair.
workshop.sentenceTrans: 我把我的车留在车间修理。
workshop.mnemonic: work工作 + shop工厂 → workshop车间

world.definitionEn: the earth, with all its countries, peoples and natural features
world.sentence: His dream is to travel around the world.
world.mnemonic: wor人 + ld年龄，生长 → 人类的生长存在 → world世界

worldwide.definition: 在世界各地，遍及全球地
worldwide.definitionEn: affecting all parts of the world
worldwide.sentenceTrans: 互联网连接的用户遍布世界各地。
