worldwide.mnemonic: world世界 + wide宽的 → worldwide全世界的

worm.definitionEn: a long thin creature with no bones or legs, that lives in soil; the young form of an insect when it looks like a short worm

worried.definition: 发愁的，担心的，烦恼的；  v.担忧（worry的过去式和过去分词）
worried.definitionEn: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen and therefore feeling unhappy and afraid
worried.sentence: She looks worried. She must be in some trouble.
worried.sentenceTrans: 她看起来愁容满面。她一定有什么麻烦。
worried.mnemonic: worr=worry担心 + ied形容词后缀 → worried担心的

worry.definitionEn: to think about problems or fears :to feel or show fear and concern because you think that something bad has happened or could happen
worry.sentence: She worries about the safety of the child.

worse.definition: 更坏地，更恶劣地；  adj.更坏的，更恶劣的；  n.更坏的事，更恶劣的事
worse.definitionEn: less well; more seriously or severely; used to introduce a statement about something that is more serious or unpleasant than things already mentioned
worse.sentence: The company is performing worse and worse.
worse.sentenceTrans: 这家公司的业绩越来越差。

worship.definition: 崇拜，爱戴；做礼拜，拜神；  n.礼拜，礼拜仪式；崇拜，敬仰
worship.definitionEn: to show respect for God or a god, especially by saying prayers, singing, etc. with other people in a religious building; to love and admire somebody very much, especially so much that you cannot see their faults
worship.sentence: In ancient times, Chinese farmers used to worship the god of earth.
worship.sentenceTrans: 在古代，中国农民常常敬拜土地公公。
worship.mnemonic: wor值得敬仰的 + ship表示条件、行动、地位、关系等 -> worship崇拜

worst.definition: 最坏地；最糟地；  adj.最差的，最坏的；  n.最坏的事
worst.definitionEn: (superlative of bad) of the poorest quality or lowest standard; worse than any other person or thing of a similar kind
worst.sentence: I think rainy days are the worst type of weather.
worst.sentenceTrans: 我认为下雨天是最糟糕的天气。

worth.definitionEn: having a value in money, etc.
worth.sentence: My house is worth two hundred thousand dollars.
worth.sentenceTrans: 我的房子值二十万美元。

worthless.definitionEn: having no practical or financial value
worthless.sentence: The broken coin is worthless; you can't buy anything with it.
worthless.sentenceTrans: 硬币碎裂了后变得毫无价值，你用它买不到任何东西。
worthless.mnemonic: worth价值 + less无……的 → worthless无价值的，无用的

worthwhile.definitionEn: important, enjoyable, interesting, etc.; worth spending time, money or effort on
worthwhile.sentence: Studying English words with this app is definitely worthwhile!
worthwhile.sentenceTrans: 用这款应用学英语单词绝对超值哦！
worthwhile.mnemonic: worth有...价值 + while一段时间 → worthwhile值得的

worthy.definitionEn: having the qualities that deserve somebody/something; having qualities that deserve your respect, attention or admiration
worthy.sentence: She is worthy of respect as she sacrificed herself for others.
worthy.sentenceTrans: 她舍己为人的精神值得尊敬。
worthy.mnemonic: worth价值，价格 + y形容词后缀 → worthy值得...的

would.definitionEn: used as the past form of will when reporting what somebody has said or thought
would.sentence: He said if he earned a million dollars he would buy a house.
would.sentenceTrans: 他说如果他挣了一百万美元，他就会买一栋房子。

wound.definition: 伤口（读作/wuːnd/）；  v.伤害；缠绕（wind的过去式）（读作/waʊnd/）
wound.definitionEn: an injury that is caused when a knife, bullet, etc., cuts or breaks the skin
wound.sentence: She has a small wound on her knee.
wound.sentenceTrans: 她膝盖上有一个小伤口。

wrap.definition: 裹，包，捆；覆盖；用……缠绕；  n.外衣；围巾；包裹材料
wrap.definitionEn: to cover something completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present; to cover something/somebody in material, for example in order to protect it/them
wrap.sentence: She wrapped the gift with some colorful paper.
wrap.sentenceTrans: 她用彩色的纸把礼物包了起来。

wreck.definition: 破坏，毁坏；  n.失事；残骸
wreck.definitionEn: a ship that has sunk or that has been very badly damaged
wreck.sentence: The hurricane wrecked dozens of coastal villages last night.
wreck.sentenceTrans: 昨晚的飓风摧毁了数十个沿海村落。

wrist.definitionEn: the joint between the hand and the arm
wrist.sentence: The basketball player injured his wrist.
wrist.sentenceTrans: 这名篮球运动员的手腕受伤了。

write.definitionEn: to make letters or numbers on a surface, especially using a pen or a pencil
write.sentence: Let me write down these things.

writer.definitionEn: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.
writer.sentence: Who do you prefer out of these famous foreign writers?
writer.sentenceTrans: 在这些著名的外国作家中，你最喜欢谁？

writing.definitionEn: a group of pieces of writing, especially by a particular person or on a particular subject; books, articles, etc. in general
writing.sentence: She is a writer and good at writing.
writing.sentenceTrans: 她是一个作家，擅长写作。
writing.mnemonic: writ写作 + ing名词后缀 → 写出来的东西 → writing著作，作品

wrong.sentence: Press the red button if you think the answer is wrong.
wrong.sentenceTrans: 如果你认为回答错误，就按下红色按钮。

x-ray.sentence: The doctor took an x-ray of my leg to see if it was broken.
x-ray.sentenceTrans: 医生给我的腿拍了 X 光片，看看是否骨折。

yard.definition: 院子，庭院；码（长度单位，等于3英尺或0.9144米）
yard.definitionEn: an area outside a building, usually with a hard surface and a surrounding wall
yard.sentence: What a large yard! We can have a barbecue.
yard.sentenceTrans: 这个院子真大！我们可以烤烧烤。

year.definitionEn: the period from 1 January to 31 December, that is 365 or 366 days, divided into 12 months
year.sentence: There are 12 months in a year.

yearly.definition: 每年的，一年一度的；  n.年刊
yearly.definitionEn: happening once a year or every year; paid, valid or calculated for one year
yearly.sentence: The yearly rental of the house is 2,350 dollars.
yearly.sentenceTrans: 这房子的年租金是2350美元。
yearly.mnemonic: year年 + ly表副词，每……地 → yearly每年地

yellow.definitionEn: having the colour of lemons or butter
yellow.sentence: Look at this big yellow sunflower.
yellow.sentenceTrans: 瞧这朵黄色的大向日葵。

yes.definition: 答话时表示正确或真实
yes.definitionEn: an answer that shows that you agree with an idea, a statement, etc.; a person who says ‘yes’
yes.sentence: Yes, I promise to be a good boy.
yes.sentenceTrans: 好，我保证做一个好男孩！

yesterday.sentence: Today is Saturday, so yesterday was Friday.
yesterday.sentenceTrans: 今天是周六，所以昨天就是周五。
yesterday.mnemonic: yester昨日 + day一天 → yesterday昨天

yet.definitionEn: used in negative sentences and questions to talk about something that has not happened but that you expect to happen
yet.sentence: I studied hard, yet I still failed the exam.
yet.sentenceTrans: 我学习很努力，但考试还是没及格。

yield.definition: 出产（作物）；  v.弯曲；屈服；让行；  n.收益
yield.definitionEn: to produce or provide something, for example a profit, result or crop
yield.sentence: The fields yielded many carrots this year.
yield.sentenceTrans: 这片土地今年产出了很多胡萝卜。

you.definitionEn: used as the subject or object of a verb or after a preposition to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to

young.definition: 年轻的，年纪小的；没有经验的；  n.青年人；（动物的）崽
young.definitionEn: having lived or existed for only a short time; not fully developed
young.sentence: These young women are so excited for the coming holiday.
young.sentenceTrans: 假期就要到了，这些年轻的女孩很是激动。

your.definitionEn: of or belonging to the person or people being spoken or written to
your.sentence: Don't forget your umbrella. It might rain.
your.sentenceTrans: 不要忘了你的雨伞，可能会下雨。

yours.definitionEn: used at the end of a letter before signing your name
yours.sentence: The car is yours now—drive safe!
yours.sentenceTrans: 这辆车现在是你的了，安全驾驶！

yourself.definitionEn: (the reflexive form of you) used when the person or people being spoken to both cause and are affected by an action
yourself.sentence: Look at yourself in the mirror.
yourself.mnemonic: your你的 ＋ self自己 → yourself你自己

yourselves.definitionEn: used when the person or people being spoken to both cause and are affected by an action
yourselves.sentence: Look at yourselves in the mirror!
yourselves.sentenceTrans: 看看镜子里的你们自己吧！

youth.definitionEn: young people considered as a group
youth.sentence: Youth is the symbol of hope.
youth.mnemonic: you青春活力，生命力 + th抽象名词后缀 → youth青春；青年

zero.sentence: The result of 1 minus 1 is zero.

zone.definition: 地带，空间，地区，区域，范围；  v.将…划为特殊区域
zone.definitionEn: one of the sections in a city or town that is used for a particular purpose
zone.sentence: Our school is in this zone.

zoo.definitionEn: a place where many kinds of wild animals are kept for the public to see and where they are studied, bred and protected
zoo.sentence: There are so many animals in the zoo!
zoo.sentenceTrans: 动物园里有好多动物啊！
